en: Florinia returns to the scene of action in Obsidia, combatting the plants threatening to destroy the area!

key: The murderer is rumored to be the leader of the devious Team Meteor, who successfully escaped the scene.
en: The murderer is rumored to be the leader of the devious Team Meteor, who successfully escaped the scene.

key: But our latest report says these earthquakes were never a real problem.
en: But our latest report says these earthquakes were never a real problem.
ja: しかし　最新の報告によれば　その地震は　そもそも　問題ではなかったのです

key: Instead, behind it all was the dastardly Team Meteor!
en: Instead, behind it all was the dastardly Team Meteor!
ja: その裏にいたのは　あの　悪らつな　メテオだん!

key: So this means Team Meteor was responsible for shutting down the city years ago!
en: So this means Team Meteor was responsible for shutting down the city years ago!
ja: つまり　何年も前に　この街を　止めたのは　メテオだん　だったのです!

key: But what could they hope to gain from it?!
en: But what could they hope to gain from it?!
ja: でも　それで　彼らに　何の得が!?

key: Except this isn't the greatest news at all-- in fact it's terrible!
en: Except this isn't the greatest news at all-- in fact it's terrible!
ja: ……とはいえ　これが　最大のニュース　というわけでは　ありません―― むしろ　最悪です!

key: There's been a kidnapping, and you'll never guess the victim!
en: There's been a kidnapping, and you'll never guess the victim!
ja: 誘拐事件が　起きました。被害者が　誰か　当てられますか!

key: It's me!
en: It's me!
ja: わたしです!

key: Waste your time not on questioning how this is aired. Somebody help me!
en: Waste your time not on questioning how this is aired. Somebody help me!
ja: なぜ放送できているのか　なんて　考えている暇は　ありません。誰か　助けて!

key: But for those of you really wondering...
en: But for those of you really wondering...
ja: でも　どうしても　気になる方のために……

key: Recently, an explosion has rocked the peak of Tanzan Mountain!
en: Recently, an explosion has rocked the peak of Tanzan Mountain!
ja: 先ごろ　タンザン山の　頂上を　爆発が　揺るがしました!

key: Officials are still investigating the cause, but rumors trickling down the mountain as they come suggest this could be another one of Team Meteor's schemes!
en: Officials are still investigating the cause, but rumors trickling down the mountain as they come suggest this could be another one of Team Meteor's schemes!
ja: 当局は　原因を　調査中ですが　山から降りてくる　うわさによれば　これも　メテオだんの　たくらみの　一つかもしれません!

key: Allegedly, the dastardly team appears to have held a base up there, but if indeed it was their base that was destroyed, then why?
en: Allegedly, the dastardly team appears to have held a base up there, but if indeed it was their base that was destroyed, then why?
ja: あの悪らつな組織は　山頂に　基地を　構えていたとされますが　破壊されたのが　本当に　自分たちの基地なら　いったい　なぜ?

key: Could they have terminated their own facility for security?
en: Could they have terminated their own facility for security?
ja: 秘密を守るため　自ら　しせつを　処分したのでしょうか?

key: Were they attacked?
en: Were they attacked?
ja: それとも　攻撃を　受けたのか?

key: Or did something go horribly, horribly wrong?
en: Or did something go horribly, horribly wrong?
ja: あるいは　何かが　とんでもなく　まずい方向へ　転がったのでしょうか?

key: It has been drama ALL over the place here at the Vanhanen Castle! First I was kidnapped, and now Luna too!
en: It has been drama ALL over the place here at the Vanhanen Castle! First I was kidnapped, and now Luna too!
ja: ヴァンハネン城は　もう　大さわぎでした! まず　わたしが　誘拐され　今度は　ルナまで!

key: Chaos, I tell you!
en: Chaos, I tell you!
ja: 混とん　というほか　ありません!

key: This is hardly even a news story!
en: This is hardly even a news story!
ja: もはや　ニュースにも　なりません!

key: It would be more of one, but I'm off to search for my darling.
en: It would be more of one, but I'm off to search for my darling.
ja: 本当は　もっと　語りたいのですが　わたしは　愛しい人を　探しに　行かなくては

key: Will I even find her!?
en: Will I even find her!?
ja: 見つけられるのでしょうか!?

key: With things settling back down, it's nice to get to sit back and do a real news story for once!
en: With things settling back down, it's nice to get to sit back and do a real news story for once!
ja: ようやく落ち着いてきて　久しぶりに　まともなニュースを　お届けできるのは　うれしいことです!

key: So much doom and gloom in the past few episodes!
en: So much doom and gloom in the past few episodes!
ja: ここ数回は　暗い話ばかり　でしたから!

key: Let's focus on something more positive!
en: Let's focus on something more positive!
ja: もっと　明るい話に　目を向けましょう!

key: Recently, a mysterious person rescued from the depths of a secret ancient underground ruin--
en: Recently, a mysterious person rescued from the depths of a secret ancient underground ruin--
ja: 先ごろ　秘密の古代地下遺せきの　奥深くから　救出された　謎の人物が――

key: Wow, that sounds like something out of a manga or video game!--
en: Wow, that sounds like something out of a manga or video game!--
ja: うわあ　まるで　マンガか　ゲームの話みたいですね!――

key: ...Has taken on the ambitious job of personally restoring Reborn City to its former glory!
en: ...Has taken on the ambitious job of personally restoring Reborn City to its former glory!
ja: ……リボーンシティを　かつての栄光へと　自ら　立て直すという　大それた仕事に　乗り出しました!

key: A recent meeting saw Reborn League manager Ame, along with League Leaders Julia and Florinia, join together to fix up this broken city once and for all!
en: A recent meeting saw Reborn League manager Ame, along with League Leaders Julia and Florinia, join together to fix up this broken city once and for all!
ja: 先日の会合では　リボーンリーグの運営　アメと　リーグリーダーの　ジュリア　フロリニアが　手を組み　この壊れた街を　いよいよ　直そうと　動きだしました!

key: However, these sorts of efforts have been historically unsuccessful.
en: However, these sorts of efforts have been historically unsuccessful.
ja: しかし　この手の試みは　歴史上　ことごとく　失敗してきました

key: Could Reborn City finally be Reborn?
en: Could Reborn City finally be Reborn?
ja: リボーンシティは　ついに　よみがえるのでしょうか?

key: Or will this be just another fleeting pipe dream?
en: Or will this be just another fleeting pipe dream?
ja: それとも　これも　はかない　夢物語に　終わるのでしょうか?

key: I'm here in Calcenon City with Dragon Leader Saphira where a sudden showdown has just taken form!
en: I'm here in Calcenon City with Dragon Leader Saphira where a sudden showdown has just taken form!
ja: わたしは　いま　カルセノンシティで　ドラゴンリーダーの　サファイラと　ご一緒しています。突然の　対決の　火ぶたが　切られました!

key: As most know, the cities of Calcenon and Labradorra sit right next to each other.
en: As most know, the cities of Calcenon and Labradorra sit right next to each other.
ja: ご存じのとおり　カルセノンと　ラブラドラの街は　すぐ隣どうし　です

key: But in a sudden uprising, the evil organization, Team Meteor, has completely seized control of Labradorra City!
en: But in a sudden uprising, the evil organization, Team Meteor, has completely seized control of Labradorra City!
ja: しかし　突然の　ほう起により　悪の組織　メテオだんが　ラブラドラシティを　完全に　制圧しました!

key: Most citizens were safely evacuated, but some are still being held as hostages!
en: Most citizens were safely evacuated, but some are still being held as hostages!
ja: 住民の多くは　無事　避難しましたが　いまも　人質として　とらわれている人が　います!

key: However, a resistance is taking shape in Calcenon City on the part of some of Reborn's strongest Trainers!
en: However, a resistance is taking shape in Calcenon City on the part of some of Reborn's strongest Trainers!
ja: しかし　カルセノンシティでは　リボーン屈指の　強豪トレーナーたちによる　抵抗の動きが　起きています!

key: Saphira, what are your thoughts on this scenario?
en: Saphira, what are your thoughts on this scenario?
ja: サファイラ　この状況を　どうお考えですか?

key: SAPHIRA: I'm not interested in negotiating with them.
en: SAPHIRA: I'm not interested in negotiating with them.
ja: サファイラ: 交渉するつもりは　ない

key: We'll find a way around the barrier and take back the hostages.
en: We'll find a way around the barrier and take back the hostages.
ja: 障壁を　回りこむ道を　見つけて　人質を　取りもどす

key: GARDEVOIR: The barrier-- that's right!
en: GARDEVOIR: The barrier-- that's right!
ja: サーナイト: 障壁―― そうでした!

key: Team Meteor is employing a special technology...
en: Team Meteor is employing a special technology...
ja: メテオだんは　特殊な技術を　使っているのです……

key: My sources tell me the machine they use is called a PULSE!
en: My sources tell me the machine they use is called a PULSE!
ja: 情報筋によれば　その機械の名は　PULSE!

key: And they've hooked a Mr. Mime up to it, creating a massive forcefield around Labradorra!
en: And they've hooked a Mr. Mime up to it, creating a massive forcefield around Labradorra!
ja: バリヤードを　つないで　ラブラドラ全体を　包む　巨大な力場を　作りだしたのです!

key: SAPHIRA: It isn't their only one.
en: SAPHIRA: It isn't their only one.
ja: サファイラ: それだけでは　ない

key: We know that they're preparing a second PULSE within the city, and they have two more in the surrounding area.
en: We know that they're preparing a second PULSE within the city, and they have two more in the surrounding area.
ja: 街の中で　二つ目の　PULSEを　準備している。周辺にも　あと二つ　ある

key: GARDEVOIR: With these mysterious machines amping up their Pokémon's powers, there's no telling what they'll do next!
en: GARDEVOIR: With these mysterious machines amping up their Pokémon's powers, there's no telling what they'll do next!
ja: サーナイト: この謎の機械が　ポケモンの力を　増幅させている以上　次に何をしてくるか　分かりません!

key: Can anything break the forcefield around Labradorra?
en: Can anything break the forcefield around Labradorra?
ja: ラブラドラを包む　力場を　破る手立ては　あるのでしょうか?

key: What will happen to the resistance in Calcenon?
en: What will happen to the resistance in Calcenon?
ja: カルセノンの　抵抗勢力は　どうなってしまうのでしょう?

key: The situation in Calcenon has gotten even MORE intense!
en: The situation in Calcenon has gotten even MORE intense!
ja: カルセノンの状勢は　さらに　激しさを　増しています!

key: Team Meteor has set up a second PULSE-Pokémon from Labradorra City, and is currently actively attempting to siege the city of Calcenon!
en: Team Meteor has set up a second PULSE-Pokémon from Labradorra City, and is currently actively attempting to siege the city of Calcenon!
ja: メテオだんは　ラブラドラシティから　二体目の　PULSEポケモンを　持ちこみ　いま　カルセノンの街を　攻め落とそうとしています!

key: With their hyper-charged PULSE Clawitzer, those Mega-Launched blasts are wreaking havoc all around the city!
en: With their hyper-charged PULSE Clawitzer, those Mega-Launched blasts are wreaking havoc all around the city!
ja: 過剰に増幅された　PULSEブロスターの　メガランチャーの一撃が　街じゅうを　破壊しつくしています!

key: With the barrier still up, there seems to be no hope of counter-attack!
en: With the barrier still up, there seems to be no hope of counter-attack!
ja: 障壁は　いまだ　健在で　反撃の望みは　ないように　見えます!

key: All is not lost though!
en: All is not lost though!
ja: しかし　まだ　すべてが　終わったわけでは　ありません!

key: Dragon Leader Saphira continues to rebel against Team Meteor as she and her Dragonite try to deflect each attack!
en: Dragon Leader Saphira continues to rebel against Team Meteor as she and her Dragonite try to deflect each attack!
ja: ドラゴンリーダー　サファイラは　カイリューとともに　攻撃を　一つ一つ　はじき返しながら　メテオだんに　抗い続けています!

key: Will she be able to hang in there?
en: Will she be able to hang in there?
ja: 彼女は　もちこたえられるのでしょうか?

key: Or will Meteor's barrage prove too much?!
en: Or will Meteor's barrage prove too much?!
ja: それとも　メテオだんの猛攻が　勝るのでしょうか!?

key: We've got breaking news coming in from Reborn City.
en: We've got breaking news coming in from Reborn City.
ja: リボーンシティから　速報が　入りました

key: We've received an anonymous tip suggesting to us that the dastardly Team Meteor, known for breaking the very region apart...
en: We've received an anonymous tip suggesting to us that the dastardly Team Meteor, known for breaking the very region apart...
ja: 匿名の　情報提供によりますと　地方そのものを　引き裂いてきた　あの悪らつな　メテオだんが……

key: ...Has yet another base inside Reborn City, under everyone's noses!
en: ...Has yet another base inside Reborn City, under everyone's noses!
ja: ……みんなの　すぐ目の前　リボーンシティの中に　また別の基地を　構えているというのです!

key: Although this is not a terrible surprise considering at least three of their previous hideouts within the city limits have already been routed...
en: Although this is not a terrible surprise considering at least three of their previous hideouts within the city limits have already been routed...
ja: 市内にあった　少なくとも三つの　アジトが　すでに　つぶされていることを思えば　さほど　驚くことでは　ないかもしれませんが……

key: City officials are disturbed at the prospect of there being still another one, having believed Meteor to be purged from the city.
en: City officials are disturbed at the prospect of there being still another one, having believed Meteor to be purged from the city.
ja: メテオだんは　街から　一掃されたと　信じていた　市の当局は　まだ残っている　という見通しに　動揺しています

key: The battle between Reborn and Team Meteor rages on!
en: The battle between Reborn and Team Meteor rages on!
ja: リボーンと　メテオだんの　戦いは　まだ　続いているのです!

key: Where could this secret base be?
en: Where could this secret base be?
ja: その秘密基地は　どこに　あるのでしょう?

key: Citizens of Reborn, keep an eye out for any suspicious or hidden places you find that might be exploitable by Team Meteor!
en: Citizens of Reborn, keep an eye out for any suspicious or hidden places you find that might be exploitable by Team Meteor!
ja: リボーンの市民のみなさん　メテオだんに　利用されそうな　あやしい場所　隠れた場所を　見つけたら　気をつけていてください!

key: And as always...
en: And as always...
ja: そして　いつものように……

key: The atmosphere here in Reborn City is absolutely unprecedented!
en: The atmosphere here in Reborn City is absolutely unprecedented!
ja: リボーンシティの　いまの空気は　まさに　前例のないものです!

key: Thanks to an outpouring of new policies by the city center and the inspiration of one of Reborn's Gym Leaders, Adrienn, the city is bursting with life!
en: Thanks to an outpouring of new policies by the city center and the inspiration of one of Reborn's Gym Leaders, Adrienn, the city is bursting with life!
ja: 市の中心部による　新しい政策の　あいつぐ発表と　リボーンのジムリーダーの一人　アドリエンヌの　呼びかけのおかげで　街は　活気に　あふれています!

key: Citizens everywhere have undertaken a massive effort to rebuild and revitalize the ailed metropolis.
en: Citizens everywhere have undertaken a massive effort to rebuild and revitalize the ailed metropolis.
ja: あちこちで　市民が　この病んだ大都市を　建て直し　よみがえらせるための　大がかりな取り組みに　乗り出しました

key: Here on the scene, we're just finishing up some of the structural repairs, and are moving on to make some aesthetic improvements!
en: Here on the scene, we're just finishing up some of the structural repairs, and are moving on to make some aesthetic improvements!
ja: 現場では　建物の修復が　ちょうど　終わりかけ　これから　見た目を　整える作業に　移るところです!

key: It's something like you would not believe, folks!
en: It's something like you would not believe, folks!
ja: みなさん　信じられないような　光景ですよ!

key: I'm still waiting for the giant demon of despair to burst forth from the cracks below and ruin everything, since that seems to be how things go here!
en: I'm still waiting for the giant demon of despair to burst forth from the cracks below and ruin everything, since that seems to be how things go here!
ja: この街のことだから　どうせ　地の底の裂け目から　絶望の大悪魔が　飛びだしてきて　全部　台なしにするんじゃないかと　まだ　身構えていますけどね!

key: But could this really be a new chapter in Reborn's book?
en: But could this really be a new chapter in Reborn's book?
ja: でも　これは　本当に　リボーンの物語の　新しい章に　なるのでしょうか?

key: Reborn City needs YOUR help!
en: Reborn City needs YOUR help!
ja: リボーンシティは　あなたの力を　必要としています!

key: Do you have a passion for tinkering?
en: Do you have a passion for tinkering?
ja: ものをいじるのが　好きですか?

key: Making things?
en: Making things?
ja: 作るのが　好き?

key: Organization?
en: Organization?
ja: まとめるのが　得意?

key: Helping others?
en: Helping others?
ja: 人の役に立ちたい?

key: Or do you just want to make a difference in the world?
en: Or do you just want to make a difference in the world?
ja: それとも　ただ　世界を　変えてみたい?

key: Then stop by your local Grand Hall today to register with the City Reconstruction Project and find out how YOU can make a difference!
en: Then stop by your local Grand Hall today to register with the City Reconstruction Project and find out how YOU can make a difference!
ja: それなら　今日　お近くの　大ホールへ! 市街再建計画に　登録して　あなたに　何ができるかを　確かめてください!

key: With your help and our efforts combined, we can make Reborn the shining city it was always meant to be, one brick at a time!
en: With your help and our efforts combined, we can make Reborn the shining city it was always meant to be, one brick at a time!
ja: あなたの力と　わたしたちの努力が　合わされば　れんが一つ分ずつ　リボーンを　本来あるべき　輝く街に　できるのです!

key: ...Eh? A demonstration?
en: ...Eh? A demonstration?
ja: ……え? 実演?

key: What do you mean, you want ME to move those bricks?
en: What do you mean, you want ME to move those bricks?
ja: わたしに　あのれんがを　運べって　どういうこと?

key: I'm a Gardevoir, not a Machoke! Leave that kind of work to the Pokémon that are designed for it!
en: I'm a Gardevoir, not a Machoke! Leave that kind of work to the Pokémon that are designed for it!
ja: わたしは　サーナイトであって　ゴーリキーでは　ありません! そういう仕事は　それ向きのポケモンに　まかせてください!

key: What do you mean, that's offensive?!
en: What do you mean, that's offensive?!
ja: 失礼だ　ですって!?

key: Look, you're the one who wanted me to do this commercial!
en: Look, you're the one who wanted me to do this commercial!
ja: だいたい　このコマーシャルを　やれと　言ったのは　そちらでしょう!

key: Ughhh, you're still gonna pay me anyway, right?
en: Ughhh, you're still gonna pay me anyway, right?
ja: うぅ……　それでも　報酬は　ちゃんと　出るんですよね?

key: And here it is-- Reborn is CHAMPIONLESS!
en: And here it is-- Reborn is CHAMPIONLESS!
ja: さあ　お伝えします―― リボーンに　チャンピオンが　いなくなりました!

key: You heard right!
en: You heard right!
ja: お聞きのとおりです!

key: Reborn Champion and League Manager Ame has suddenly resigned from her position after an official address to the board of directors at the Grand Hall.
en: Reborn Champion and League Manager Ame has suddenly resigned from her position after an official address to the board of directors at the Grand Hall.
ja: リボーンチャンピオンで　リーグ運営の　アメが　大ホールでの　理事会への正式な声明のあと　突然　その座を　退きました

key: The full address has not yet been made public,
en: The full address has not yet been made public,
ja: 声明の全文は　まだ　公表されていませんが

key: But sources say that Ame cited slight physical health concerns as the reason for her departure.
en: But sources say that Ame cited slight physical health concerns as the reason for her departure.
ja: 関係者によれば　アメは　わずかな体調の不安を　退任の理由として　挙げたとのことです

key: As the original force behind the reopening of the Reborn League and the subsequent repopulation of our fair region, Ame will be missed dearly.
en: As the original force behind the reopening of the Reborn League and the subsequent repopulation of our fair region, Ame will be missed dearly.
ja: リボーンリーグの再開と　その後の　この地方の人口回復を　もたらした　立て役者として　アメの不在は　深く　惜しまれます

key: Her time defending the Champion title was short-lived but fiercely guarded by the Reborn Leaders who collectively did not allow a single challenger through!
en: Her time defending the Champion title was short-lived but fiercely guarded by the Reborn Leaders who collectively did not allow a single challenger through!
ja: チャンピオンの座を　守った期間は　短かったものの　リボーンのリーダーたちが　結束して　挑戦者を　ただの一人も　通さなかったのです!

key: Talk about a challenge!
en: Talk about a challenge!
ja: まさに　難関でした!

key: But rest assured, Trainers, the Reborn League is as open as ever, and there is no better time to take up arms!
en: But rest assured, Trainers, the Reborn League is as open as ever, and there is no better time to take up arms!
ja: でも　安心してください　トレーナーのみなさん。リボーンリーグは　これまでどおり　開かれています。挑むなら　いまです!

key: Management of the Reborn League has passed to capable new hands:
en: Management of the Reborn League has passed to capable new hands:
ja: リボーンリーグの運営は　新たな　頼もしい手に　引きつがれました

key: Adrienn Flores, Reborn League Fairy Gym Leader and RCRP Administrator,
en: Adrienn Flores, Reborn League Fairy Gym Leader and RCRP Administrator,
ja: リボーンリーグ　フェアリージムリーダーで　RCRP管理者の　アドリエンヌ・フローレス

key: And Victoria Marlow, Reborn League Reserve Fighting Gym Leader and Head Instructor of Apophyll Academy!
en: And Victoria Marlow, Reborn League Reserve Fighting Gym Leader and Head Instructor of Apophyll Academy!
ja: そして　リボーンリーグ　かくとうジムの　控えリーダーで　アポフィルアカデミー主任教官の　ヴィクトリア・マーロウ　です!

key: These two have been irreplaceable in Reborn City's rejuvenation, and the Reborn League shall surely fall safely back into order under their guidance.
en: These two have been irreplaceable in Reborn City's rejuvenation, and the Reborn League shall surely fall safely back into order under their guidance.
ja: この二人は　リボーンシティの再生に　欠かせない存在でした。リボーンリーグも　二人の導きのもとで　必ず　安泰でしょう

key: And for all of you challengers wondering about that Champion spot...
en: And for all of you challengers wondering about that Champion spot...
ja: そして　チャンピオンの座が　気になっている　挑戦者のみなさん……

key: Reborn's next Champion...
en: Reborn's next Champion...
ja: リボーンの　次のチャンピオンは……

key: ...could be you!
en: ...could be you!
ja: ……あなたかも　しれません!

key: The first Trainer who is able to collect all 18 Badges and navigate Victory Road to the Hall of Fame will become Reborn's Champion!
en: The first Trainer who is able to collect all 18 Badges and navigate Victory Road to the Hall of Fame will become Reborn's Champion!
ja: 18個のバッジを　すべて集め　チャンピオンロードを　抜けて　殿堂にたどり着いた　最初のトレーナーが　リボーンのチャンピオンと　なります!

key: Do YOU have what it takes?
en: Do YOU have what it takes?
ja: あなたに　その力が　ありますか?

key: Serial disappearances continue in the Carnelia Region as Agate slumbers on!

key: GARDEVOIR: Because I always fall asleep when I try. Oops~
en: GARDEVOIR: Because I always fall asleep when I try. Oops~
ja: サーナイト: だって　やろうとすると　いつも　寝てしまうんです。あらら〜

key: Today, we have an interview with Reborn's own Steel Leader, Titania.
en: Today, we have an interview with Reborn's own Steel Leader, Titania.
ja: 今日は　リボーンが誇る　はがねリーダー　ティタニアへの　インタビューです

key: So, Titania, tell us about yourself!
en: So, Titania, tell us about yourself!
ja: さあ　ティタニア　ご自身のことを　聞かせてください!

key: TITANIA: Not interested.
en: TITANIA: Not interested.
ja: ティタニア: 興味ない

key: GARDEVOIR: Not interested?
en: GARDEVOIR: Not interested?
ja: サーナイト: 興味ない?

key: How can you not be interest-- Hey, where do you think you're going?!
en: How can you not be interest-- Hey, where do you think you're going?!
ja: どうして　興味が―― ちょっと　どこへ行くつもりですか!?

key: Come back here, or--
en: Come back here, or--
ja: もどってきなさい　さもないと――

key: And she's gone.
en: And she's gone.
ja: ……行ってしまいました

key: ...So, Titania, tell us about yourself.
en: ...So, Titania, tell us about yourself.
ja: ……さて　ティタニア　ご自身のことを　聞かせてください

key: GARDEVOIR: Well, Gardevoir, I'm glad you asked.
en: GARDEVOIR: Well, Gardevoir, I'm glad you asked.
ja: サーナイト: ええ　サーナイト　聞いてくれて　うれしいわ

key: I really couldn't be happier that I, Titania, was chosen to be featured on your show.
en: I really couldn't be happier that I, Titania, was chosen to be featured on your show.
ja: この　あたしが　あなたの番組に　取り上げてもらえるなんて　これ以上の　幸せは　ないわね

key: How gracious of you.
en: How gracious of you.
ja: なんて　ありがたいこと

key: As you can clearly see, I am Titania, and I love refusing interviews and walking out on perfectly good publicity jumps from gracious interviewers!
en: As you can clearly see, I am Titania, and I love refusing interviews and walking out on perfectly good publicity jumps from gracious interviewers!
ja: ご覧のとおり　あたしは　ティタニアで　インタビューを断って　親切な取材相手からの　またとない宣伝の機会を　蹴って出ていくのが　大好きなの!

key: Ugh!
en: Ugh!
ja: もう!

key: So! Today I'm joined by Reborn's Rock Gym Leader, Hardy!
en: So! Today I'm joined by Reborn's Rock Gym Leader, Hardy!
ja: さて! 今日は　リボーンの　いわジムリーダー　ハーディに　来てもらいました!

key: So Hardy, I hear you're pretty adamant when it comes to defending Rock-types, right?
en: So Hardy, I hear you're pretty adamant when it comes to defending Rock-types, right?
ja: ハーディ　あなたは　いわタイプを　守ることに　かなり　こだわりがあると　聞きましたが

key: Why is that?
en: Why is that?
ja: それは　なぜ?

key: HARDY: Aye. Here's the deal, you remember back in the old days before all this Steel-type stuff, aite?
en: HARDY: Aye. Here's the deal, you remember back in the old days before all this Steel-type stuff, aite?
ja: ハーディ: ああ。こういうことさ。はがねタイプなんてもんが　出てくる前の　昔を　覚えてるか?

key: See, back then, Rock was a well known champ of defense.
en: See, back then, Rock was a well known champ of defense.
ja: あのころ　いわは　防御の王者として　名を　とどろかせてた

key: You know there ain't nothin' that was gonna break it.
en: You know there ain't nothin' that was gonna break it.
ja: あれを　破れるもんなんて　なかったんだ

key: But then this whole Steel nonsense comes along, suddenly Rock is like old news, everyone's too caught up with the shiny new.
en: But then this whole Steel nonsense comes along, suddenly Rock is like old news, everyone's too caught up with the shiny new.
ja: ところが　はがねなんて　もんが　出てきたとたん　いわは　過去の遺物あつかい。みんな　新しくて　ピカピカなやつに　夢中さ

key: But here's the thing, mate, Rock's still as solid as ever.
en: But here's the thing, mate, Rock's still as solid as ever.
ja: でもな　いわは　いまでも　変わらず　固いままなんだよ

key: It didn't change, it didn't get worse and it never was.
en: It didn't change, it didn't get worse and it never was.
ja: 変わっちゃいない。弱くなってもいないし　そもそも　弱かったこともない

key: It's the underdog, it's the sleeping giant, aye?
en: It's the underdog, it's the sleeping giant, aye?
ja: 負け犬で　眠れる巨人ってやつさ　だろ?

key: So I roll with that, and dish out the pain!
en: So I roll with that, and dish out the pain!
ja: だから　オレは　それに乗っかって　痛い目を　見せてやるのさ!

key: GARDEVOIR: Very well said!
en: GARDEVOIR: Very well said!
ja: サーナイト: いいことを　言いますね!

key: You're certainly much more personable than your sister, Titania!
en: You're certainly much more personable than your sister, Titania!
ja: お姉さんの　ティタニアより　ずっと　感じがいいです!

key: HARDY: Yea, that's not much of an accomplishment, yanno?
en: HARDY: Yea, that's not much of an accomplishment, yanno?
ja: ハーディ: いや　それは　大した自まんに　ならねぇだろ?

key: Some sorts of rocks are more personable than she is.
en: Some sorts of rocks are more personable than she is.
ja: そこらの石ころのほうが　あいつより　愛想がいいぜ

key: GARDEVOIR: I agree!
en: GARDEVOIR: I agree!
ja: サーナイト: 同感です!

key: In fact, she should just never be mentioned ever, because she doesn't deserve it!
en: In fact, she should just never be mentioned ever, because she doesn't deserve it!
ja: むしろ　あの人の話は　二度と　しないほうがいい。その価値も　ありませんから!

key: HARDY: Um, did I miss somethin'?
en: HARDY: Um, did I miss somethin'?
ja: ハーディ: あー　オレ　何か　聞きのがしたか?

key: GARDEVOIR: No! Nothing! It was Titania who missed out!
en: GARDEVOIR: No! Nothing! It was Titania who missed out!
ja: サーナイト: いいえ! 何も! 聞きのがしたのは　ティタニアのほうです!

key: Today, I'm interviewing one of Reborn's best and most beautiful Leaders, Luna!
en: Today, I'm interviewing one of Reborn's best and most beautiful Leaders, Luna!
ja: 今日は　リボーンで　最も優れて　最も美しいリーダーの一人　ルナに　インタビューします!

key: Luna, dear? Why don't you tell the audience a bit about yourself?
en: Luna, dear? Why don't you tell the audience a bit about yourself?
ja: ルナ　ご自身のことを　視聴者に　少し　話してくれますか?

key: LUNA: Very well. Ah, hello?
en: LUNA: Very well. Ah, hello?
ja: ルナ: いいわ。ああ　こんにちは

key: My name is Luna, and I am a Trainer of Dark-type Pokémon.
en: My name is Luna, and I am a Trainer of Dark-type Pokémon.
ja: わたしの名前は　ルナ。あくタイプのポケモンの　トレーナーです

key: I think Dark is an absolutely lovely type.
en: I think Dark is an absolutely lovely type.
ja: あくは　とても　愛しいタイプだと　思うの

key: Within the shade of uncertainty, anything becomes possible.
en: Within the shade of uncertainty, anything becomes possible.
ja: 不確かさの　かげの中では　どんなことも　可能になる

key: It's the type of pure imagination.
en: It's the type of pure imagination.
ja: 純すいな　想像力の　タイプなのよ

key: That aside, I live in my father's castle.
en: That aside, I live in my father's castle.
ja: それはさておき　わたしは　父の城に　住んでいます

key: My mother is a famous model, and they're both Leaders, too.
en: My mother is a famous model, and they're both Leaders, too.
ja: 母は　有名なモデルで　二人とも　リーダーでもあるの

key: I suppose something like that must just run in our blood.
en: I suppose something like that must just run in our blood.
ja: そういうものは　血に　流れているのでしょうね

key: I'm blessed to have such wonderful parents and friends!
en: I'm blessed to have such wonderful parents and friends!
ja: こんなに　すばらしい両親と　友だちに　めぐまれて　幸せです!

key: Of course my best friend is, well, you, Gardevoir!
en: Of course my best friend is, well, you, Gardevoir!
ja: もちろん　いちばんの友だちは　そう　あなたよ　サーナイト!

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh, Luna, you're so sweet~
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh, Luna, you're so sweet~
ja: サーナイト: まあ　ルナ　やさしいのね〜

key: Unlike some other Leaders I can think of...
en: Unlike some other Leaders I can think of...
ja: どこかの　リーダーたちとは　大ちがい……

key: Honestly, the others could learn a thing or two from you!
en: Honestly, the others could learn a thing or two from you!
ja: 本当に　ほかの人たちも　あなたを　見習うべきです!

key: LUNA: Is that so? Well, I wouldn't say that.
en: LUNA: Is that so? Well, I wouldn't say that.
ja: ルナ: そうかしら? わたしは　そうは　思わない

key: I simply try to be as kind to everyone as I can.
en: I simply try to be as kind to everyone as I can.
ja: ただ　できるかぎり　みんなに　やさしくしようと　しているだけ

key: Obviously each person has their own differences.
en: Obviously each person has their own differences.
ja: 人には　それぞれ　ちがいがあって　当たり前

key: That's just a small part of what makes us all so individually wonderful.
en: That's just a small part of what makes us all so individually wonderful.
ja: それこそが　みんなを　一人ひとり　すばらしくしているものの　ほんの一部なのよ

key: GARDEVOIR: As bright-eyed as ever-- ironic as that may be to say about a Dark-type Trainer!
en: GARDEVOIR: As bright-eyed as ever-- ironic as that may be to say about a Dark-type Trainer!
ja: サーナイト: 相変わらず　まなざしが　明るいですね―― あくタイプのトレーナーに　言うのも　おかしな話ですけど!

key: Thanks for your time, Luna~
en: Thanks for your time, Luna~
ja: お時間　ありがとう　ルナ〜

key: Today we've got a special interview with a certain DJ Arclight!
en: Today we've got a special interview with a certain DJ Arclight!
ja: 今日は　かの　DJアークライトの　特別インタビューです!

key: Arclight, you've made a name for yourself on the radio, and now TV programs too, but do you care to introduce yourself?
en: Arclight, you've made a name for yourself on the radio, and now TV programs too, but do you care to introduce yourself?
ja: アークライト　あなたは　ラジオで　名を上げて　いまでは　テレビ番組にも。自己紹介を　お願いできますか?

key: ARC: For sure. DJ Arclight coming to you live!
en: ARC: For sure. DJ Arclight coming to you live!
ja: アーク: もちろん。DJアークライトが　生でお届けするぜ!

key: You all know the Nightclub up on Castelia Street.
en: You all know the Nightclub up on Castelia Street.
ja: カステリア通りの　ナイトクラブは　知ってるだろ

key: That's my playground.
en: That's my playground.
ja: あそこが　オレの遊び場さ

key: And what's a nightclub without some beats, right?
en: And what's a nightclub without some beats, right?
ja: ナイトクラブに　ビートがなきゃ　始まらないだろ?

key: That's where I come in.
en: That's where I come in.
ja: そこで　オレの出番ってわけだ

key: GARDEVOIR: Have you been in the music industry for long?
en: GARDEVOIR: Have you been in the music industry for long?
ja: サーナイト: 音楽の世界には　長いのですか?

key: ARC: Ever since I was bangin' on my mom's table at dinnertime.
en: ARC: Ever since I was bangin' on my mom's table at dinnertime.
ja: アーク: 夕飯どきに　母さんのテーブルを　たたいてたころからな

key: GARDEVOIR: What got you interested in music?
en: GARDEVOIR: What got you interested in music?
ja: サーナイト: 音楽に　興味を持ったきっかけは?

key: ARC: To be straight with it, I don't see what gets people out of it.
en: ARC: To be straight with it, I don't see what gets people out of it.
ja: アーク: 正直に言うとな　音楽から　抜けだせる人間のほうが　オレには　分からねぇ

key: Music is what makes life worth living!
en: Music is what makes life worth living!
ja: 音楽こそ　人生を　生きる価値のあるものに　してくれるんだ!

key: GARDEVOIR: Well, isn't that lovely!
en: GARDEVOIR: Well, isn't that lovely!
ja: サーナイト: まあ　すてきですね!

key: Any final words for our viewers?
en: Any final words for our viewers?
ja: 視聴者に　最後に　ひとこと　ありますか?

key: ARC: Yeah, all you aspiring Trainers out there, you keep up on your dreams, you don't let go.
en: ARC: Yeah, all you aspiring Trainers out there, you keep up on your dreams, you don't let go.
ja: アーク: ああ　トレーナーを　目指してる　みんな。夢を　追い続けろ　手放すな

key: Best way to be an Ace Member is to clear the Elite Four, so I'll be hopin' to see all of you reallll soon.
en: Best way to be an Ace Member is to clear the Elite Four, so I'll be hopin' to see all of you reallll soon.
ja: エースメンバーになる　いちばんの近道は　四天王を　抜けることだ。近いうちに　みんなに　会えるのを　楽しみにしてるぜ

key: Give 'em hell!
en: Give 'em hell!
ja: ぶちかましてやれ!

key: GARDEVOIR: Well said! And thank you for your time, your honorable DJness.
en: GARDEVOIR: Well said! And thank you for your time, your honorable DJness.
ja: サーナイト: お見事! お時間　ありがとうございました　DJさま

key: I'm here live with one of the newest additions to the Reborn Leader line-up!
en: I'm here live with one of the newest additions to the Reborn Leader line-up!
ja: リボーンのリーダー陣に　新たに加わった　その一人と　生中継で　お届けします!

key: She's young, she's hot!
en: She's young, she's hot!
ja: 若くて　イケてる!

key: It's the brand-new Poison Leader, Aya!
en: It's the brand-new Poison Leader, Aya!
ja: 新しい　どくタイプリーダー　アヤです!

key: AYA: Why are you in our living room?
en: AYA: Why are you in our living room?
ja: アヤ: なんで　うちの居間に　いるの?

key: GARDEVOIR: So, Aya! How does it feel to finally be a Gym Leader?
en: GARDEVOIR: So, Aya! How does it feel to finally be a Gym Leader?
ja: サーナイト: さて　アヤ! ついに　ジムリーダーになった　お気持ちは?

key: AYA: No, really. Who are you?
en: AYA: No, really. Who are you?
ja: アヤ: いや　本当に。あんた　誰?

key: What are all these cameras--
en: What are all these cameras--
ja: このカメラの山は　何――

key: Where's Mom?
en: Where's Mom?
ja: 母さんは　どこ?

key: Mom?!
en: Mom?!
ja: 母さん!?

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh, she just stepped out for a minute.
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh, she just stepped out for a minute.
ja: サーナイト: ああ　ちょっと　席を外しているだけですよ

key: AYA: No, that can't be.
en: AYA: No, that can't be.
ja: アヤ: いや　ありえない

key: She's always in here. She doesn't leave.
en: She's always in here. She doesn't leave.
ja: 母さんは　いつも　ここにいる。出ていかないの

key: It's a little weird, really.
en: It's a little weird, really.
ja: ちょっと　変なくらいにね

key: MOM?! ARE YOU UPSTAIRS?
en: MOM?! ARE YOU UPSTAIRS?
ja: 母さん!? 二階に　いるの?

key: GARDEVOIR: She wouldn't give us permission for this, but I never miss a meeting, so we just had someone keep her busy.
en: GARDEVOIR: She wouldn't give us permission for this, but I never miss a meeting, so we just had someone keep her busy.
ja: サーナイト: 許可は　もらえそうになかったので　わたしは　取材を逃さない主義でしてね　人を使って　足止めしてもらいました

key: AYA: Um, what. You can't just do that, you--
en: AYA: Um, what. You can't just do that, you--
ja: アヤ: え　何それ。そんなこと　勝手に――

key: GARDEVOIR: So Aya! Tell us about yourself!
en: GARDEVOIR: So Aya! Tell us about yourself!
ja: サーナイト: さあ　アヤ! ご自身のことを　聞かせてください!

key: AYA: Where's the phone? I'm calling the police.
en: AYA: Where's the phone? I'm calling the police.
ja: アヤ: 電話　どこ。警察　呼ぶから

key: GARDEVOIR: Excuse me!? I am a celebrity!
en: GARDEVOIR: Excuse me!? I am a celebrity!
ja: サーナイト: 何ですって!? わたしは　有名人ですよ!

key: And here I am, generously trying to expand your career, and this is how you treat me?!
en: And here I am, generously trying to expand your career, and this is how you treat me?!
ja: こうして　あなたの経歴を　広げてあげようと　しているのに　その仕打ちですか!?

key: AYA: Yeah, there's this crazy talking Pokémon in my house.
en: AYA: Yeah, there's this crazy talking Pokémon in my house.
ja: アヤ: はい　うちの中に　変なしゃべるポケモンが　いるんです

key: She just appeared.
en: She just appeared.
ja: 急に　現れて

key: I dunno.
en: I dunno.
ja: さあ　知らない

key: GARDEVOIR: You actually called them!
en: GARDEVOIR: You actually called them!
ja: サーナイト: 本当に　呼んだんですね!

key: How dare you!
en: How dare you!
ja: よくも!

key: Do you know the things I could say about you on live television?!
en: Do you know the things I could say about you on live television?!
ja: 生放送で　あなたのことを　どれだけ　しゃべれるか　分かってるんですか!?

key: AYA: Yeah, I think she's threatening me now.
en: AYA: Yeah, I think she's threatening me now.
ja: アヤ: はい　いま　脅されてるみたいです

key: Uhhh, we're out in the Wasteland, but I think the address was corroded off of the building.
en: Uhhh, we're out in the Wasteland, but I think the address was corroded off of the building.
ja: えっと　ここ　荒れ地なんですけど　建物の住所は　さびて　消えてると思う

key: You'll find it.
en: You'll find it.
ja: 見れば　分かります

key: Yeah.
en: Yeah.
ja: はい

key: GARDEVOIR: Do I need to tell the world about your secret relationship with Hardy?!
en: GARDEVOIR: Do I need to tell the world about your secret relationship with Hardy?!
ja: サーナイト: ハーディとの　秘密の関係を　世界に　バラしましょうか!?

key: AYA: You-- what?! There is no--
en: AYA: You-- what?! There is no--
ja: アヤ: あんた―― は? そんなもの――

key: Get out of my house!
en: Get out of my house!
ja: うちから　出ていって!

key: GARDEVOIR: Ahaha! You'd better do just as I say or I'll tell everyone just how 'Hardy' he can get--
en: GARDEVOIR: Ahaha! You'd better do just as I say or I'll tell everyone just how 'Hardy' he can get--
ja: サーナイト: あははっ! 言うとおりに　しないと　あの人が　どれだけ「ハーディ」に　なれるか　みんなに　話しますよ――

key: Hey, watch the eyes when you're clawing at me!
en: Hey, watch the eyes when you're clawing at me!
ja: ちょっと　引っかくなら　目は　やめて!

key: Today I'm meeting with one of Reborn's strongest Trainers!
en: Today I'm meeting with one of Reborn's strongest Trainers!
ja: 今日は　リボーン屈指の強豪トレーナーの一人に　会いに来ました!

key: She's big! She's bad-ass!
en: She's big! She's bad-ass!
ja: でかくて! 荒っぽくて!

key: And she's set to tear you a new one--
en: And she's set to tear you a new one--
ja: あなたを　ぼこぼこにする　気まんまんで――

key: ANNA: Hey! I'm not any of those things!
en: ANNA: Hey! I'm not any of those things!
ja: アンナ: ちょっと! アンナ　そんなの　どれも　ちがうよ!

key: GARDEVOIR: Only joking!
en: GARDEVOIR: Only joking!
ja: サーナイト: 冗談ですよ!

key: Everyone say "hi" to Anna!
en: Everyone say "hi" to Anna!
ja: みなさん　アンナに　あいさつを!

key: ANNA: And Nostra! Don't forget her~
en: ANNA: And Nostra! Don't forget her~
ja: アンナ: ノストラも! わすれないでね〜

key: GARDEVOIR: Yes, Nostra too...
en: GARDEVOIR: Yes, Nostra too...
ja: サーナイト: はい　ノストラも……

key: Wouldn't want to forget her...
en: Wouldn't want to forget her...
ja: わすれるわけには　いきませんね……

key: Anyway! Anna, you may not be big or bad-ass, but if your rank is any indication, you sure know how to battle.
en: Anyway! Anna, you may not be big or bad-ass, but if your rank is any indication, you sure know how to battle.
ja: それはさておき! アンナ　でかくも　荒っぽくも　ないけれど　その順位を見るかぎり　戦い方は　よく　分かっているようですね

key: Tell us, what's your secret?
en: Tell us, what's your secret?
ja: 教えてください　その秘けつは?

key: How can you be so talented at such a young age?
en: How can you be so talented at such a young age?
ja: そんなに　幼いのに　どうして　そこまで　うまいのですか?

key: ANNA: Huh? I'm not sure I understand the question.
en: ANNA: Huh? I'm not sure I understand the question.
ja: アンナ: ふぇ? しつもんの　いみが　よく　わかんないや

key: Because it doesn't matter how old you are as long as you're good at something, right?
en: Because it doesn't matter how old you are as long as you're good at something, right?
ja: だって　なにかが　じょうずなら　いくつでも　かんけいないよね?

key: There are talented people who are old, so it only makes sense that there would be talented people who are also young.
en: There are talented people who are old, so it only makes sense that there would be talented people who are also young.
ja: としを　とってて　じょうずなひとが　いるんだから　わかくて　じょうずなひとが　いても　あたりまえだよ

key: GARDEVOIR: Surprisingly wise words!
en: GARDEVOIR: Surprisingly wise words!
ja: サーナイト: 意外にも　賢いお言葉!

key: Or I guess we shouldn't be surprised by now.
en: Or I guess we shouldn't be surprised by now.
ja: いえ　いまさら　驚くことでは　ないのかも

key: Tell us, how did you earn your position?
en: Tell us, how did you earn your position?
ja: 教えてください　その地位は　どうやって　手に入れたのですか?

key: ANNA: Oh, Mr. Shadow recommended me for it and Nostra helped me beat all the competition!
en: ANNA: Oh, Mr. Shadow recommended me for it and Nostra helped me beat all the competition!
ja: アンナ: あのね　かげのおじさんが　すいせんしてくれて　ノストラが　みんなに　かつのを　てつだってくれたの!

key: I owe it all to my friends!
en: I owe it all to my friends!
ja: ぜんぶ　ともだちの　おかげだよ!

key: GARDEVOIR: A shadow and a doll...
en: GARDEVOIR: A shadow and a doll...
ja: サーナイト: 影と　人形……

key: Right...
en: Right...
ja: そうですか……

key: Well, your talent certainly is undeniable.
en: Well, your talent certainly is undeniable.
ja: まあ　あなたの才能は　まちがいなく　本物ですね

key: ANNA: Miss, have we met before?
en: ANNA: Miss, have we met before?
ja: アンナ: おねえさん　まえに　あったこと　ある?

key: GARDEVOIR: I'm sorry, what?
en: GARDEVOIR: I'm sorry, what?
ja: サーナイト: すみません　何ですって?

key: ANNA: I think we met before.
en: ANNA: I think we met before.
ja: アンナ: まえに　あったきが　するの

key: Nostra thinks so too.
en: Nostra thinks so too.
ja: ノストラも　そういってる

key: GARDEVOIR: Well, it's only natural that I should seem familiar!
en: GARDEVOIR: Well, it's only natural that I should seem familiar!
ja: サーナイト: まあ　見覚えがあって　当然です!

key: I am, after all, a celebrity.
en: I am, after all, a celebrity.
ja: なにしろ　わたしは　有名人ですから

key: ANNA: Oh, you are? That's so cool!
en: ANNA: Oh, you are? That's so cool!
ja: アンナ: え　そうなの? すごーい!

key: I thought you were just a random Gardevoir who wanted to talk.
en: I thought you were just a random Gardevoir who wanted to talk.
ja: ただ　おはなししたいだけの　サーナイトさんかと　おもってた

key: GARDEVOIR: You... haven't heard of me?
en: GARDEVOIR: You... haven't heard of me?
ja: サーナイト: わたしのこと……　知らなかったのですか?

key: ANNA: Nu-uh.
en: ANNA: Nu-uh.
ja: アンナ: しらなーい

key: Today we have Reborn City's newest, and, in a way, oldest celebrity with us.
en: Today we have Reborn City's newest, and, in a way, oldest celebrity with us.
ja: 今日は　リボーンシティで　いちばん新しくて　ある意味では　いちばん古い有名人を　おむかえしています

key: Please welcome the Coral Ward Gym Leader, Adrienn!
en: Please welcome the Coral Ward Gym Leader, Adrienn!
ja: コーラルワードの　ジムリーダー　アドリエンヌです!

key: ADRIENN: Thank you.
en: ADRIENN: Thank you.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ありがとう

key: GARDEVOIR: Let's catch up our listeners from outside Reborn City.
en: GARDEVOIR: Let's catch up our listeners from outside Reborn City.
ja: サーナイト: リボーンシティの外の　視聴者にも　おさらいしましょう

key: Recently you've undertaken a huge number of renovation projects, which no doubt everyone within the city limits has noticed.
en: Recently you've undertaken a huge number of renovation projects, which no doubt everyone within the city limits has noticed.
ja: あなたは　最近　たくさんの改修計画に　取りくんでいて　市内の人なら　誰もが　気づいているはずです

key: Tell us, after being trapped in time for more than a decade, what inspired you to take on this enormous workload?
en: Tell us, after being trapped in time for more than a decade, what inspired you to take on this enormous workload?
ja: 教えてください　十年以上も　時に閉じこめられていたあとで　この大仕事に　乗り出そうと　思ったきっかけは?

key: ADRIENN: When I grew up-- or rather, in the time I grew up--
en: ADRIENN: When I grew up-- or rather, in the time I grew up--
ja: アドリエンヌ: わたしが　育ったころ―― というか　わたしが　育った時代には――

key: This whole time distortion thing is confusing...
en: This whole time distortion thing is confusing...
ja: この　時のゆがみの話は　ややこしいわね……

key: Back then, Reborn was a region renowned for its beauty, and the city matched that acre for acre.
en: Back then, Reborn was a region renowned for its beauty, and the city matched that acre for acre.
ja: あのころの　リボーンは　美しさで　名高い地方で　街も　すみずみまで　それに　ふさわしかった

key: Since I came back, I've seen so many ways how Reborn City is just not what it once was.
en: Since I came back, I've seen so many ways how Reborn City is just not what it once was.
ja: もどってきてから　リボーンシティが　かつての姿とは　まるでちがうことを　いくつも　目にしたわ

key: It's shocking-- painful even.
en: It's shocking-- painful even.
ja: 衝撃だった―― つらいくらいに

key: So, it's only natural that I'm going to do everything I can to fix it.
en: So, it's only natural that I'm going to do everything I can to fix it.
ja: だから　直すために　できることは　何でもする。当たり前のことよ

key: GARDEVOIR: Well said! Aren't you cute, always playing the good samaritan!
en: GARDEVOIR: Well said! Aren't you cute, always playing the good samaritan!
ja: サーナイト: お見事! いつも　善き隣人を　演じて　かわいらしいこと!

key: "I will protect you, Gardevoir!"
en: "I will protect you, Gardevoir!"
ja: 「わたしが　守るよ　サーナイト!」

key: ADRIENN: Ahaha, can't we let that go by now?
en: ADRIENN: Ahaha, can't we let that go by now?
ja: アドリエンヌ: あははっ　もう　その話は　やめてくれない?

key: GARDEVOIR: Nope!
en: GARDEVOIR: Nope!
ja: サーナイト: いやです!

key: "I will restore the city!" It's adorable, really!
en: "I will restore the city!" It's adorable, really!
ja: 「わたしが　街を　立て直す!」 本当に　かわいらしい!

key: ADRIENN: Do I really sound like that? You're starting to embarrass me.
en: ADRIENN: Do I really sound like that? You're starting to embarrass me.
ja: アドリエンヌ: わたし　本当に　そんな話し方? 恥ずかしくなってきたわ

key: GARDEVOIR: Good! That's my job, you know?
en: GARDEVOIR: Good! That's my job, you know?
ja: サーナイト: いいですね! それが　わたしの仕事ですから

key: ADRIENN: No, I um, didn't know, actually.
en: ADRIENN: No, I um, didn't know, actually.
ja: アドリエンヌ: いえ　その　知らなかったわ

key: I thought this was a formal interview?
en: I thought this was a formal interview?
ja: これ　正式な　インタビューだと　思っていたのだけど?

key: GARDEVOIR: It is! It's so formal!
en: GARDEVOIR: It is! It's so formal!
ja: サーナイト: そうですよ! とっても　正式です!

key: It's the formal-est!
en: It's the formal-est!
ja: 史上　いちばん　正式です!

key: There hasn't been a more formal interview yet!
en: There hasn't been a more formal interview yet!
ja: これ以上　正式な　インタビューは　ありません!

key: ADRIENN: Based on the ones I've seen, I would believe that...
en: ADRIENN: Based on the ones I've seen, I would believe that...
ja: アドリエンヌ: これまで見たものから　察するに　そうでしょうね……

key: GARDEVOIR: What? What's that supposed to mean?!
en: GARDEVOIR: What? What's that supposed to mean?!
ja: サーナイト: え? どういう意味ですか!?

key: Now listen here, before you go saying that, let me explain you a thing!
en: Now listen here, before you go saying that, let me explain you a thing!
ja: いいですか　そんなことを　言う前に　一つ　説明させてください!

key: Wait, first... Cut, cut!
en: Wait, first... Cut, cut!
ja: 待って　その前に……　カット　カット!

key: Today we have a special report with Gym Leader Florinia of the Onyx Ward!
en: Today we have a special report with Gym Leader Florinia of the Onyx Ward!
ja: 今日は　オニキスワードの　ジムリーダー　フロリニアの　特別リポートです!

key: Many Trainers are well-acquainted with Florinia as the headmistress of the Onyx Trainers' School.
en: Many Trainers are well-acquainted with Florinia as the headmistress of the Onyx Trainers' School.
ja: 多くのトレーナーは　オニキストレーナーズスクールの　校長として　フロリニアを　よく知っています

key: Tell us, Florinia, how exactly did you manage to secure a position so prestigious at your age?
en: Tell us, Florinia, how exactly did you manage to secure a position so prestigious at your age?
ja: 教えてください　フロリニア　その若さで　これほど　名誉ある地位を　どうやって　得たのですか?

key: FLORINIA: Principality of the school was requested following the acceptance of the Gym Leader position.
en: FLORINIA: Principality of the school was requested following the acceptance of the Gym Leader position.
ja: フロリニア: 学校の運営権は　ジムリーダーの職を　受諾したのち　申請したものである

key: The conversion of city-public property was acknowledged as necessary to be forfeit for the foundation of the Reborn League,
en: The conversion of city-public property was acknowledged as necessary to be forfeit for the foundation of the Reborn League,
ja: リボーンリーグ設立のため　市の公共財産の転用は　必要な措置として　承認された

key: Thus, what was once solely a school became solely a Gym.
en: Thus, what was once solely a school became solely a Gym.
ja: よって　かつて　学校のみであったものが　ジムのみと　なった

key: Upon gaining control of the facility, and proper permissions following, the institution was hybridized.
en: Upon gaining control of the facility, and proper permissions following, the institution was hybridized.
ja: しせつの管理権を得て　所定の許可が　下りたのち　当機関は　両者を　併せ持つ形へと　改められた

key: GARDEVOIR: I see! So in other words, it was your idea to combine them!
en: GARDEVOIR: I see! So in other words, it was your idea to combine them!
ja: サーナイト: なるほど! つまり　二つを　合わせたのは　あなたの発案　ということですね!

key: You must have a real passion for education to be willing to take that on yourself!
en: You must have a real passion for education to be willing to take that on yourself!
ja: それを　自ら　引き受けるとは　よほど　教育に　情熱が　あるのでしょう!

key: FLORINIA: Passion is an irrelevant factor.
en: FLORINIA: Passion is an irrelevant factor.
ja: フロリニア: 情熱は　無関係な要素である

key: The operation is necessary, and this speaker is able to function adequately.
en: The operation is necessary, and this speaker is able to function adequately.
ja: 本作業は必要であり、この話者は十分に機能している。

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh? Does that mean you don't enjoy the work?
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh? Does that mean you don't enjoy the work?
ja: サーナイト: あら、それはつまり、この仕事を楽しんでいないということですか?

key: FLORINIA: Enjoyment is a triviality.
en: FLORINIA: Enjoyment is a triviality.
ja: フロリニア: 楽しみとはささいなことだ。

key: Only function matters.
en: Only function matters.
ja: 機能することだけが重要である。

key: GARDEVOIR: How boring!
en: GARDEVOIR: How boring!
ja: サーナイト: つまらないですね!

key: Surely there must be something you enjoy doing, Florinia?
en: Surely there must be something you enjoy doing, Florinia?
ja: 何か楽しいと思うことが、きっとあるはずでしょう、フロリニア?

key: FLORINIA: Personal emotion is too confounding of a condition to reach that assumption safely.
en: FLORINIA: Personal emotion is too confounding of a condition to reach that assumption safely.
ja: フロリニア: 個人的な感情は、その仮定に安全にたどり着くにはあまりに混乱を招く条件である。

key: And misinterpretation of human emotion can lead to severe risk.
en: And misinterpretation of human emotion can lead to severe risk.
ja: そして人間の感情の誤解は、重大な危険につながりかねない。

key: This writer has already lost too much at its hand; thus, as logically directed, the risk is avoided.
en: This writer has already lost too much at its hand; thus, as logically directed, the risk is avoided.
ja: この話者はすでにその手で多くを失った。ゆえに論理的な指示に従い、危険を回避する。

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh my, this is juicy!
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh my, this is juicy!
ja: サーナイト: あら、これは興味深いですね!

key: So you were hurt by someone in the past and that's why you ignore your emotions-- is that what I'm understanding?
en: So you were hurt by someone in the past and that's why you ignore your emotions-- is that what I'm understanding?
ja: つまり過去に誰かに傷つけられて、それで感情を無視していると、そういうことでしょうか?

key: FLORINIA: That is a sufficent abstract, yes.
en: FLORINIA: That is a sufficent abstract, yes.
ja: フロリニア: それは十分な要約だ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Lovely! Do tell, what happened?
en: GARDEVOIR: Lovely! Do tell, what happened?
ja: サーナイト: すてきです! ぜひ聞かせてください、何があったのですか?

key: FLORINIA: The conclusion will not be forthcoming.
en: FLORINIA: The conclusion will not be forthcoming.
ja: フロリニア: 結論は述べない。

key: The previous analysis is sufficient.
en: The previous analysis is sufficient.
ja: 先の分析で十分である。

key: Good bye.
en: Good bye.
ja: さようなら。

key: GARDEVOIR: What? I say when the interview ends, not you!
en: GARDEVOIR: What? I say when the interview ends, not you!
ja: サーナイト: 何ですって? インタビューの終わりを決めるのはわたしです、あなたではありません!

key: Darn it! This was finally getting good!
en: Darn it! This was finally getting good!
ja: もう、せっかく面白くなってきたところなのに!

key: I'm here right now with someone very special to me personally.
en: I'm here right now with someone very special to me personally.
ja: さあ、今日はわたしにとって特別な方とご一緒します。

key: Say hello to Reborn's Ice Gym Leader and former model, Serra Voclain!
en: Say hello to Reborn's Ice Gym Leader and former model, Serra Voclain!
ja: リボーンのアイスジムリーダーであり元モデルの、セラ・ヴォクランさんです!

key: SERRA: Goodness, Gardevoir, this is a surprise.
en: SERRA: Goodness, Gardevoir, this is a surprise.
ja: セラ: あら、サーナイト、驚いたわ。

key: I assumed you'd come back home to collect your belongings, not for this.
en: I assumed you'd come back home to collect your belongings, not for this.
ja: てっきり荷物を取りに帰ってきたのかと思っていたけれど、そうではないのね。

key: GARDEVOIR: What's the matter? You seem almost disappointed!
en: GARDEVOIR: What's the matter? You seem almost disappointed!
ja: サーナイト: どうかしましたか? 少しがっかりしているようですけど!

key: SERRA: No, not in the least.
en: SERRA: No, not in the least.
ja: セラ: いいえ、まったく。

key: Neither by the interview nor by you not collecting your things.
en: Neither by the interview nor by you not collecting your things.
ja: インタビューのことでも、荷物を取りに来なかったことでもないわ。

key: Lord knows no one else is using those rooms.
en: Lord knows no one else is using those rooms.
ja: どうせあの部屋を使う人なんて、もう誰もいないもの。

key: It's just been a long time since I've had a public interview.
en: It's just been a long time since I've had a public interview.
ja: ただ、公の場でインタビューを受けるのは久しぶりだと思っただけ。

key: It's not a feeling I'd expected to miss.
en: It's not a feeling I'd expected to miss.
ja: 恋しく思うなんて、思ってもみなかったけれど。

key: GARDEVOIR: That's right, you gave up your career for your son before. Do you regret doing that?
en: GARDEVOIR: That's right, you gave up your career for your son before. Do you regret doing that?
ja: サーナイト: そうでしたね、息子さんのためにキャリアを手放したのでしたね。後悔していますか?

key: SERRA: It's hard to say.
en: SERRA: It's hard to say.
ja: セラ: 何とも言えないわね。

key: I think the best way to put it is-- although I do feel remorse for what I've lost, I wouldn't change my decision even if I could.
en: I think the best way to put it is-- although I do feel remorse for what I've lost, I wouldn't change my decision even if I could.
ja: 失ったものへの未練がないと言えばうそになるけれど、もう一度選べたとしても、同じ決断をすると思うわ。

key: There are more important things than passions and careers.
en: There are more important things than passions and careers.
ja: 情熱やキャリアより大事なものが、あるもの。

key: GARDEVOIR: You mean your son, of course. How touching!
en: GARDEVOIR: You mean your son, of course. How touching!
ja: サーナイト: もちろん息子さんのことですね。感動的です!

key: But, tell me, how do you respond to the recent developments wherein he's fallen in with the terrorist organization Team Meteor?
en: But, tell me, how do you respond to the recent developments wherein he's fallen in with the terrorist organization Team Meteor?
ja: でも教えてください、彼がテロ組織チームメテオに加わったという最近の報道について、どうお考えですか?

key: SERRA: I'm sorry.
en: SERRA: I'm sorry.
ja: セラ: ごめんなさい。

key: He's what?
en: He's what?
ja: 彼が、何ですって?

key: GARDEVOIR: In his recent exploits, it seems likely he's been working under and assisting Team Meteor in destroying the region!
en: GARDEVOIR: In his recent exploits, it seems likely he's been working under and assisting Team Meteor in destroying the region!
ja: サーナイト: 最近の動きを見る限り、彼はチームメテオの下でこの地方を壊す手伝いをしているようです!

key: SERRA: He's--
en: SERRA: He's--
ja: セラ: 彼が――

key: ...Gardevoir, take me to Bennett.
en: ...Gardevoir, take me to Bennett.
ja: ……サーナイト、ベネットのところに連れていって。

key: GARDEVOIR: Ah, in time, but let's finish the interview first?
en: GARDEVOIR: Ah, in time, but let's finish the interview first?
ja: サーナイト: ああ、そのうちに。でもまずはインタビューを終わらせません?

key: SERRA: Gardevoir.
en: SERRA: Gardevoir.
ja: セラ: サーナイト。

key: Take me to Bennett.
en: Take me to Bennett.
ja: ベネットのところに連れていって。

key: GARDEVOIR: ...Yes, missus.
en: GARDEVOIR: ...Yes, missus.
ja: サーナイト: ……分かりました、奥様。

key: I'm here today at the homestead and gymstead of one of Reborn's most popular Trainers, Ms. Amaria Fiore!
en: I'm here today at the homestead and gymstead of one of Reborn's most popular Trainers, Ms. Amaria Fiore!
ja: さあ今日は、リボーンで最も人気のあるトレーナーのおひとり、アマリア・フィオーレさんの自宅兼ジムにお邪魔しています!

key: Unfortunately, and in a surprise twist for our Interview Intermission, Amaria is actually not available for comment right now...
en: Unfortunately, and in a surprise twist for our Interview Intermission, Amaria is actually not available for comment right now...
ja: 残念ながら、そして今回の中継にとって驚きの展開なのですが、アマリアさんはただいまコメントをいただける状態にありません……

key: ...seeing as she is currently setting up for battle!
en: ...seeing as she is currently setting up for battle!
ja: ……というのも、まさに戦闘の準備中でいらっしゃるからです!

key: There's been quite a lot going on in this bubbly beauty's life, but luckily, your truest friend, Gossip Gardevoir, is here to catch up to speed.
en: There's been quite a lot going on in this bubbly beauty's life, but luckily, your truest friend, Gossip Gardevoir, is here to catch up to speed.
ja: このはつらつとした美女の人生には色々なことがありましたが、幸いにも、あなたの一番の味方、ゴシップサーナイトが最新情報をお届けします。

key: See, after a recent accident of questionably self- inflicted causes, Ms. Fiore here has developed a sudden textbook case of retrograde amnesia,
en: See, after a recent accident of questionably self- inflicted causes, Ms. Fiore here has developed a sudden textbook case of retrograde amnesia,
ja: あるちょっと怪しい自業自得の事故のあと、フィオーレさんには教科書どおりの逆行性健忘の症状が現れました。

key: And as such has forgotten everything that's occurred in recent events, including things that should have been precious to her and her loved ones.
en: And as such has forgotten everything that's occurred in recent events, including things that should have been precious to her and her loved ones.
ja: そのため、大切な人たちとの出来事も含め、最近起きたことをすべて忘れてしまっているのです。

key: The battle that's taking place today is not between her and a challenger, but between her and a representative of the Reborn League,
en: The battle that's taking place today is not between her and a challenger, but between her and a representative of the Reborn League,
ja: 本日行われる戦いは、挑戦者との対戦ではなく、彼女とリボーンリーグの代表者との一戦。

key: To assess if she is still able to retain her position despite her condition!
en: To assess if she is still able to retain her position despite her condition!
ja: この状態でもリーダーの座を保てるかどうかを見極めるためのものです!

key: Everything is on the line for Amaria today! If it proves that her battling ability went down the drain with her memory, she could find herself out of a job in a snap!
en: Everything is on the line for Amaria today! If it proves that her battling ability went down the drain with her memory, she could find herself out of a job in a snap!
ja: 今日のアマリアさんにとって、すべてがかかっています! もし記憶と一緒に戦闘の腕まで失っていたとしたら、あっという間に職を失うことになりかねません!

key: Let's cut to the battlefield now and see how she's doing!
en: Let's cut to the battlefield now and see how she's doing!
ja: それでは早速、戦場の様子を見てみましょう!

key: Oh, there's nothing happening? Have they not started yet?
en: Oh, there's nothing happening? Have they not started yet?
ja: あら、何も起きていない? まだ始まっていないのでしょうか?

key: ...What do you mean, they already finished!?
en: ...What do you mean, they already finished!?
ja: ……もう終わったって、どういうことですか!?

key: I was still giving the intro! What kind of battle was that?!
en: I was still giving the intro! What kind of battle was that?!
ja: まだ紹介の途中だったのに! 一体どんな戦いだったんですか?!

key: O-oh. I... I see.
en: O-oh. I... I see.
ja: あ……そ、そうですか。

key: Well, folks,
en: Well, folks,
ja: さて、皆さん、

key: In a turn of events that is at once altogether unsurprising yet unexpected,
en: In a turn of events that is at once altogether unsurprising yet unexpected,
ja: いつものことながら意外でもあり、予想どおりでもある展開ですが、

key: In the time it took me to preface the battle, Amaria has already beaten her opponent for a flawless six-zero shutout victory!
en: In the time it took me to preface the battle, Amaria has already beaten her opponent for a flawless six-zero shutout victory!
ja: わたしが戦いの前置きをしている間に、アマリアさんはすでに相手を6-0の完封で下していました!

key: Gotta hand it to the woman of the water, she sure knows how to cling onto her talent even when she loses everything else!
en: Gotta hand it to the woman of the water, she sure knows how to cling onto her talent even when she loses everything else!
ja: さすが水の女性、すべてを失ってもその才能だけはしっかりつかんで離さないというわけですね!

key: And that, my dear viewers, is exactly proof as to why she is one of Reborn's most famous Gym Leaders!
en: And that, my dear viewers, is exactly proof as to why she is one of Reborn's most famous Gym Leaders!
ja: そしてそれこそが、彼女がリボーン屈指の有名ジムリーダーである理由に他なりません!

key: Today we're meeting Julia Wilde in a quaint cafe to get a bite-- and a scoop.
en: Today we're meeting Julia Wilde in a quaint cafe to get a bite-- and a scoop.
ja: 今日はジュリア・ワイルドさんと、こぢんまりしたカフェでランチをご一緒しながら、話を聞かせていただきます。

key: Here she comes now--
en: Here she comes now--
ja: さあ、いらっしゃいました――

key: She strolls through the door, swag in every step and saffron seifuku in full bloom,
en: She strolls through the door, swag in every step and saffron seifuku in full bloom,
ja: ドアを抜けてさっそうと歩いてくるその足取りには自信があふれ、サフラン色のセーラー服が満開です。

key: She rocks a pair of shades like it's nobody's business and they just have to deal with it.
en: She rocks a pair of shades like it's nobody's business and they just have to deal with it.
ja: サングラスをこれ見よがしにかけていて、周りはそれに付き合わされるしかありません。

key: The girl's got style, the girl's got class, she's coming this way--
en: The girl's got style, the girl's got class, she's coming this way--
ja: スタイルも、気品も兼ね備えた彼女がこちらへ向かってきます――

key: ...And she crashed.
en: ...And she crashed.
ja: ……そして、激突しました。

key: Julia, helloooo? I'm over here!
en: Julia, helloooo? I'm over here!
ja: ジュリアさん、もしもーし? こっちですよ!

key: JULIA: Huh...
en: JULIA: Huh...
ja: ジュリア: え……

key: GARDEVOIR: Just where were you looking?! You walked right into that table!
en: GARDEVOIR: Just where were you looking?! You walked right into that table!
ja: サーナイト: 一体どこを見て歩いていたんですか?! あのテーブルに思いっきりぶつかりましたよ!

key: JULIA: Oh... Good morning...
en: JULIA: Oh... Good morning...
ja: ジュリア: あ……おはようございます……

key: GARDEVOIR: Wait, were you wearing those shades just to hide the fact that your eyes were closed as you were walking?!
en: GARDEVOIR: Wait, were you wearing those shades just to hide the fact that your eyes were closed as you were walking?!
ja: サーナイト: 待って、そのサングラスって、目を閉じて歩いていたのを隠すためにかけていたんですか?!

key: JULIA: Well, duh... How else am I gonna sleepwalk without anyone noticing?
en: JULIA: Well, duh... How else am I gonna sleepwalk without anyone noticing?
ja: ジュリア: だって、そうでもしないと、誰にも気づかれずに寝ぼけ歩きなんてできないでしょ?

key: GARDEVOIR: I'm not so sure that's quite how sleepwalking works, dear.
en: GARDEVOIR: I'm not so sure that's quite how sleepwalking works, dear.
ja: サーナイト: 寝ぼけ歩きって、そういう仕組みじゃないと思いますけど。

key: JULIA: Hey, who's the expert here? You or me?
en: JULIA: Hey, who's the expert here? You or me?
ja: ジュリア: ちょっと、専門家はどっちよ? あんた? それともアタシ?

key: I don't see you sleepwalking into any tables!
en: I don't see you sleepwalking into any tables!
ja: あんたがテーブルに突っ込んで寝ぼけ歩きしてるとこ、見たことないし!

key: GARDEVOIR: As if I would!
en: GARDEVOIR: As if I would!
ja: サーナイト: するわけないでしょう!

key: So much for class... Go on, pick up that chair and sit down.
en: So much for class... Go on, pick up that chair and sit down.
ja: 気品もどこへやら……ほら、その椅子を拾って座ってください。

key: So, Julia, I understand you have somewhat of a fixation with blowing things up.
en: So, Julia, I understand you have somewhat of a fixation with blowing things up.
ja: さて、ジュリアさん、何でも爆発させるのがお好きだとか。

key: JULIA: It's just a hobby!
en: JULIA: It's just a hobby!
ja: ジュリア: ただの趣味だってば!

key: GARDEVOIR: Could you tell us how that got started?
en: GARDEVOIR: Could you tell us how that got started?
ja: サーナイト: どうやって始まったのか、聞かせてもらえますか?

key: JULIA: Yeah!
en: JULIA: Yeah!
ja: ジュリア: うん!

key: Okay, so, when I was younger, I dated this guy named Rod-- actually, was it Rod? Maybe that was Ringo... I always get them mixed up. Anyways--
en: Okay, so, when I was younger, I dated this guy named Rod-- actually, was it Rod? Maybe that was Ringo... I always get them mixed up. Anyways--
ja: えっとね、アタシが若かったころ、ロッドって名前の男とつき合ってたの――って、ロッドだっけ? リンゴだったかも……いつも混ざっちゃうんだよね。とにかく――

key: So, we were out at the park this one time and he keeps like, checking his phone, right? So, at one point he steps into the restroom and I check it too,
en: So, we were out at the park this one time and he keeps like, checking his phone, right? So, at one point he steps into the restroom and I check it too,
ja: それである日、公園に一緒にいたんだけど、彼がずっとスマホばっかり気にしてて。で、あるときトイレに立ったから、アタシもこっそり見てみたの。

key: To like, see what was so important that he was taking time away from me-- anyway, it turned out he was texting this other girl, and you know,
en: To like, see what was so important that he was taking time away from me-- anyway, it turned out he was texting this other girl, and you know,
ja: 何がそんなに大事で、アタシから気をそらしてたのかなって――そしたら、他の女に浮気メッセージ送ってたわけ。それでさ、

key: There's really only one logical thing to do in a situation like that, right?
en: There's really only one logical thing to do in a situation like that, right?
ja: そういうときって、やることなんてひとつしかないでしょ?

key: Which is to open up his phone and change around a couple wires and have a Pokémon jolt up the battery, just to make it glitch out, give a little spook, right?
en: Which is to open up his phone and change around a couple wires and have a Pokémon jolt up the battery, just to make it glitch out, give a little spook, right?
ja: つまり、彼のスマホを開けて中の配線をちょっといじって、ポケモンに電池をビリっとやらせて、故障させて、ちょっとびっくりさせてやるってこと。

key: I mean, that's what anyone would do.
en: I mean, that's what anyone would do.
ja: だって、誰だってそうするでしょ。

key: So, he gets back from the bathroom and starts up the phone and he doesn't expect a thing, but I'm just sitting there like ":3c"
en: So, he gets back from the bathroom and starts up the phone and he doesn't expect a thing, but I'm just sitting there like ":3c"
ja: それで彼がトイレから戻ってきて、何も疑わずスマホの電源を入れたの。アタシはただ「:3c」って顔で座ってたんだけど、

key: And then, suddenly the whole device sparks and the screen melts and he screams and throws it away and it hits a wall and BOOM!
en: And then, suddenly the whole device sparks and the screen melts and he screams and throws it away and it hits a wall and BOOM!
ja: 突然、機械全体から火花が散って画面が溶けて、彼が悲鳴あげて放り投げて、壁にぶつかってドーン!

key: I hadn't felt that excited in years!
en: I hadn't felt that excited in years!
ja: あんなに興奮したの、何年ぶりだったか!

key: Like, blowing things up is WAY more fun than guys.
en: Like, blowing things up is WAY more fun than guys.
ja: ほんと、爆発って男よりずっと楽しいから。

key: But if you COMBINE the two, it's even better!
en: But if you COMBINE the two, it's even better!
ja: でも両方組み合わせたら、もっと最高なんだよね!

key: Not that I'm trying to blow any guys up... But you know, the look on their faces is just priceless!
en: Not that I'm trying to blow any guys up... But you know, the look on their faces is just priceless!
ja: 別に男を爆発させようとしてるわけじゃないけど……でも、あの顔、最高なんだから!

key: GARDEVOIR: I'm... sure it is.
en: GARDEVOIR: I'm... sure it is.
ja: サーナイト: それは……そうでしょうね。

key: Listen, have you considered professional therapy?
en: Listen, have you considered professional therapy?
ja: ちなみに、専門のカウンセリングは考えたことがありますか?

key: JULIA: Therapy? Me?
en: JULIA: Therapy? Me?
ja: ジュリア: カウンセリング? アタシが?

key: Oh, no, I'm not really good at giving advice and helping people. I'm flattered you think so though!
en: Oh, no, I'm not really good at giving advice and helping people. I'm flattered you think so though!
ja: ううん、人にアドバイスするの得意じゃないし。でも、そう思ってくれるのはうれしいな!

key: Anyway, I thought the whole kaboom-thing might come up today,
en: Anyway, I thought the whole kaboom-thing might come up today,
ja: そういえば、今日はこの爆発の話が出るかもって思って、

key: So I prepared a demonstration!
en: So I prepared a demonstration!
ja: デモンストレーションを用意してきたの!

key: Do you wanna see?
en: Do you wanna see?
ja: 見たい?

key: GARDEVOIR: NO.
en: GARDEVOIR: NO.
ja: サーナイト: いいえ。

key: -beep-
en: -beep-

key: GARDEVOIR: Uh.
en: GARDEVOIR: Uh.
ja: サーナイト: あの。

key: Today I'm here in Calcenon City to interview the smoldering beauty famed for the flames-- Charlotte Belrose!
en: Today I'm here in Calcenon City to interview the smoldering beauty famed for the flames-- Charlotte Belrose!
ja: 今日はカルセノンシティで、炎の美女として名高い、シャルロット・ベルローズさんにインタビューします!

key: Charlotte, thanks for taking the time to talk to me today.
en: Charlotte, thanks for taking the time to talk to me today.
ja: シャルロットさん、今日はお時間をいただきありがとうございます。

key: CHARLOTTE: Sure thing, Gardevoir. In fact, I should be thanking you.
en: CHARLOTTE: Sure thing, Gardevoir. In fact, I should be thanking you.
ja: シャルロット: いいよ、サーナイト。むしろこっちがお礼を言いたいくらい。

key: We're in ground zero and things are about as boring as they can be up here.
en: We're in ground zero and things are about as boring as they can be up here.
ja: グラウンドゼロにいると、退屈すぎて死にそうだったから。

key: It's always a pleasure to take some time out of my day to embarrass someone on public TV.
en: It's always a pleasure to take some time out of my day to embarrass someone on public TV.
ja: 一日のうち少しでも時間を割いて、テレビで誰かに恥をかかせるのって、なかなか楽しいものね。

key: GARDEVOIR: That's-- No, wait, that's my job.
en: GARDEVOIR: That's-- No, wait, that's my job.
ja: サーナイト: それは――いいえ、待って、それはわたしの仕事です。

key: CHARLOTTE: By 'someone' I meant myself.
en: CHARLOTTE: By 'someone' I meant myself.
ja: シャルロット: 「誰か」って言ったのは、自分のことだけど。

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh! Well, no need to be embarrassed, darling.
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh! Well, no need to be embarrassed, darling.
ja: サーナイト: あら! 恥ずかしがる必要なんてありませんよ、ダーリン。

key: I must admit, you didn't seem like the shy type.
en: I must admit, you didn't seem like the shy type.
ja: てっきり、恥ずかしがり屋なタイプじゃないと思っていました。

key: CHARLOTTE: I'm not.
en: CHARLOTTE: I'm not.
ja: シャルロット: 違うし。

key: GARDEVOIR: Well-- okay.
en: GARDEVOIR: Well-- okay.
ja: サーナイト: そう――分かりました。

key: Whatever the case, don't worry, I'm sure you'll do fine!
en: Whatever the case, don't worry, I'm sure you'll do fine!
ja: とにかく、心配しないで、きっとうまくいきますよ!

key: CHARLOTTE: I'm not worried either.
en: CHARLOTTE: I'm not worried either.
ja: シャルロット: べつに心配もしてないけど。

key: I wasn't even serious about embarrassing myself.
en: I wasn't even serious about embarrassing myself.
ja: 自分を恥ずかしがらせるつもりも、そもそもなかったし。

key: But it's nice that you try and think of the comfort levels of your guests once in a while.
en: But it's nice that you try and think of the comfort levels of your guests once in a while.
ja: でも、たまにはゲストの気持ちも考えようとするのね、感心感心。

key: GARDEVOIR: Of course! That's just what a good hostess should-- Wait, what do you mean, "Once in a while"?
en: GARDEVOIR: Of course! That's just what a good hostess should-- Wait, what do you mean, "Once in a while"?
ja: サーナイト: もちろんです! それが良い司会者として当然の――待って、「たまには」ってどういう意味ですか?

key: CHARLOTTE: I've seen your past interviews.
en: CHARLOTTE: I've seen your past interviews.
ja: シャルロット: 過去のインタビュー、全部見たことあるから。

key: You normally just act all high and mighty while you put someone else on blast.
en: You normally just act all high and mighty while you put someone else on blast.
ja: いつも偉そうな態度で、誰かをつるし上げてばっかりじゃない。

key: Am I wrong?
en: Am I wrong?
ja: 違う?

key: GARDEVOIR: Of course you're wrong!
en: GARDEVOIR: Of course you're wrong!
ja: サーナイト: もちろん違います!

key: CHARLOTTE: That's funny, because I distinctly remember you tearing into Aya in a previous episode.
en: CHARLOTTE: That's funny, because I distinctly remember you tearing into Aya in a previous episode.
ja: シャルロット: 面白いね、だって前の回でアヤに食ってかかってたの、はっきり覚えてるけど。

key: Threatening to tell the world about her relationship?
en: Threatening to tell the world about her relationship?
ja: 彼女の交際関係を世間にバラすって脅してたよね?

key: That doesn't seem very courteous to me.
en: That doesn't seem very courteous to me.
ja: それって、あんまり礼儀正しいとは思えないけど。

key: GARDEVOIR: She called the police!
en: GARDEVOIR: She called the police!
ja: サーナイト: 彼女が警察を呼んだからです!

key: CHARLOTTE: You're right, that was rude of her.
en: CHARLOTTE: You're right, that was rude of her.
ja: シャルロット: たしかに、それは彼女も失礼だったね。

key: Almost as rude as you being in her house without permission.
en: Almost as rude as you being in her house without permission.
ja: でも、許可も取らずに人の家に入り込んだあんたも、ほとんど同じくらい失礼だと思うけど。

key: GARDEVOIR: And still not half as rude as you're being right now!
en: GARDEVOIR: And still not half as rude as you're being right now!
ja: サーナイト: それを言うなら、今のあなたの態度の方がよっぽど失礼です!

key: CHARLOTTE: Oh, you're right.
en: CHARLOTTE: Oh, you're right.
ja: シャルロット: ああ、たしかに。

key: My apologies, Gardevoir, I thought that you would be more supportive of your fans who've watched so many of your past TV appearances.
en: My apologies, Gardevoir, I thought that you would be more supportive of your fans who've watched so many of your past TV appearances.
ja: ごめんね、サーナイト。過去の出演回をたくさん見てきたファンには、もっと優しいのかと思ってた。

key: I guess this is just how much we mean to you though.
en: I guess this is just how much we mean to you though.
ja: でも、あたし達もその程度の扱いってことなんだね。

key: GARDEVOIR: That's not what I'm saying! Ugh!
en: GARDEVOIR: That's not what I'm saying! Ugh!
ja: サーナイト: そういう意味じゃありません! もう!

key: CHARLOTTE: You've got such a short fuse. Do you really get along well with the sponsors this way?
en: CHARLOTTE: You've got such a short fuse. Do you really get along well with the sponsors this way?
ja: シャルロット: すぐ怒るね。それでスポンサーとうまくやっていけてるの?

key: GARDEVOIR: That's none of your business!
en: GARDEVOIR: That's none of your business!
ja: サーナイト: それはあなたには関係ありません!

key: CHARLOTTE: Do you want to know what I think?
en: CHARLOTTE: Do you want to know what I think?
ja: シャルロット: あたしの考え、聞きたい?

key: I think you're lying.
en: I think you're lying.
ja: うそをついてると思う。

key: GARDEVOIR: Lying?
en: GARDEVOIR: Lying?
ja: サーナイト: うそ、ですか?

key: Okay, sure, this sounds good.
en: Okay, sure, this sounds good.
ja: はいはい、いいでしょう。

key: Tell me, almighty, wise Charlotte.
en: Tell me, almighty, wise Charlotte.
ja: 教えてください、偉大で賢いシャルロットさん。

key: What am I lying about?
en: What am I lying about?
ja: わたしが何についてうそをついているというんですか?

key: CHARLOTTE: You're lying to yourself.
en: CHARLOTTE: You're lying to yourself.
ja: シャルロット: 自分自身にうそをついてるんだよ。

key: You know the truth about why this show is funded.
en: You know the truth about why this show is funded.
ja: この番組がなぜ成り立ってるか、あんたも本当は分かってるはず。

key: It's because you're a character.
en: It's because you're a character.
ja: あんたがキャラクターだからだよ。

key: GARDEVOIR: A character? Like in a game or something? That's ridiculous.
en: GARDEVOIR: A character? Like in a game or something? That's ridiculous.
ja: サーナイト: キャラクター? ゲームか何かみたいな話ですか? ばかばかしい。

key: CHARLOTTE: You're sold to the public masses as a foolish, incompetent reporter character.
en: CHARLOTTE: You're sold to the public masses as a foolish, incompetent reporter character.
ja: シャルロット: あんたは、間抜けで無能なレポーターキャラとして、世間に売られてるの。

key: The only value in these interviews comes from your buffoonery.
en: The only value in these interviews comes from your buffoonery.
ja: このインタビューの価値は、あんたのおどけっぷりだけにあるんだよ。

key: Why else wouldn't it be edited out?
en: Why else wouldn't it be edited out?
ja: じゃなきゃ、あんな失態、編集でカットされてるはずでしょ?

key: But you have this egocentric streak that lashes back when prodded.
en: But you have this egocentric streak that lashes back when prodded.
ja: でも、あんたにはつつかれると反発する自己中心的な一面があるよね。

key: If you were really playing a character, you wouldn't be so sensitive.
en: If you were really playing a character, you wouldn't be so sensitive.
ja: 本当にキャラを演じてるだけなら、そんなに敏感にならないはず。

key: You'd have an understanding that the you on TV is different than who you really are.
en: You'd have an understanding that the you on TV is different than who you really are.
ja: テレビの中のあんたと、本当のあんたは別物だって理解してるはずだから。

key: But you don't.
en: But you don't.
ja: でも、あんたはそうじゃない。

key: Because you're every bit as impulsive and incompetent as you appear.
en: Because you're every bit as impulsive and incompetent as you appear.
ja: だって、あんたは見た目どおり、衝動的で無能だから。

key: But the worst part is,
en: But the worst part is,
ja: でも一番ひどいのはね、

key: You won't admit it even when you know it.
en: You won't admit it even when you know it.
ja: 分かってるのに、それを認めようとしないところ。

key: Even if you're impulsive, you're not so stupid as to not have thought about your own shows.
en: Even if you're impulsive, you're not so stupid as to not have thought about your own shows.
ja: いくら衝動的でも、自分の番組について何も考えないほど、あんたはバカじゃないでしょ。

key: You realized that you were just being used and made fun of, but you wanted to believe you were actually a famous person people cared about.
en: You realized that you were just being used and made fun of, but you wanted to believe you were actually a famous person people cared about.
ja: 自分が利用されて、笑いものにされてるって気づいてたはずなのに、それでも本物の有名人として愛されてるんだって、そう信じたかったんだよね。

key: So you've been playing make-believe with your own success this whole time.
en: So you've been playing make-believe with your own success this whole time.
ja: だからずっと、自分の成功ごっこを続けてきたんだ。

key: GARDEVOIR: That's nonsense...
en: GARDEVOIR: That's nonsense...
ja: サーナイト: そんなの、でたらめです……

key: CHARLOTTE: Is it?
en: CHARLOTTE: Is it?
ja: シャルロット: そうかな?

key: Look me in the eyes and tell me I'm wrong.
en: Look me in the eyes and tell me I'm wrong.
ja: あたしの目を見て、間違ってるって言ってみて。

key: We're here today with one of Reborn's Elite Four...
en: We're here today with one of Reborn's Elite Four...
ja: 今日お迎えしたのは、リボーン四天王のおひとり……

key: She's powerful...
en: She's powerful...
ja: 力強く……

key: She's ferocious...
en: She's ferocious...
ja: どう猛で……

key: And she's four feet and three inches of pure battling skill!
en: And she's four feet and three inches of pure battling skill!
ja: そして身長わずか130センチほどにして、生粋のバトルセンスを持つお方!

key: Let's hear it for Heather Molinar!
en: Let's hear it for Heather Molinar!
ja: 拍手をどうぞ、ヘザー・モリナーさんです!

key: Heather, thanks so much for joining us on the show!
en: Heather, thanks so much for joining us on the show!
ja: ヘザーさん、番組にお越しいただきありがとうございます!

key: HEATHER: Thanks for having me, Gardevoir!
en: HEATHER: Thanks for having me, Gardevoir!
ja: ヘザー: 呼んでくれてありがと、サーナイト!

key: It's a nice change for someone to recognize strength when they see it!
en: It's a nice change for someone to recognize strength when they see it!
ja: 強さを見て、ちゃんと認めてくれる人がいるのって、いい気分だしね!

key: GARDEVOIR: Those are some mighty words for such a tiny person!
en: GARDEVOIR: Those are some mighty words for such a tiny person!
ja: サーナイト: そんな小さな体で、なんとも力強い言葉ですね!

key: But certainly your status threatens to back those words up nicely.
en: But certainly your status threatens to back those words up nicely.
ja: でも、あなたの実績を見れば、その言葉にも十分な裏づけがありそうです。

key: Can you tell us where you think your strength comes from?
en: Can you tell us where you think your strength comes from?
ja: 強さの秘けつは、どこにあると思いますか?

key: HEATHER: Well, obviously, it comes from my Pokémon.
en: HEATHER: Well, obviously, it comes from my Pokémon.
ja: ヘザー: そりゃ、あたしのポケモンからでしょ。

key: And...
en: And...
ja: それと……

key: I guess, my friends too.
en: I guess, my friends too.
ja: あたしの友達も、かな。

key: GARDEVOIR: Your friends? Whoever could you mean?
en: GARDEVOIR: Your friends? Whoever could you mean?
ja: サーナイト: お友達ですか? 一体どなたのことでしょう?

key: HEATHER: Well, there were a couple Trainers who wanted to help me out after I ran away from home.
en: HEATHER: Well, there were a couple Trainers who wanted to help me out after I ran away from home.
ja: ヘザー: えっと、家出したあと、助けてくれようとした人たちが何人かいてね。

key: Cain, even though he's weird.
en: Cain, even though he's weird.
ja: カインは、変な人だけどね。

key: And \PN keeps showing up everywhere...
en: And \PN keeps showing up everywhere...
ja: それに\PNもいっつもどこにでも現れるし……

key: Even I know things wouldn't have worked out this well without them.
en: Even I know things wouldn't have worked out this well without them.
ja: あたしだって、あの人たちがいなかったらこんなにうまくいってなかったって分かってるよ。

key: But mostly...
en: But mostly...
ja: でも一番は……

key: I mean my friend, Shelly.
en: I mean my friend, Shelly.
ja: 友達のシェリーのことかな。

key: We met after I got mad at my dad and took off for a few days before.
en: We met after I got mad at my dad and took off for a few days before.
ja: パパに怒って何日か家出したときに知り合ったの。

key: She hid me in her Gym and we had a lot of fun playing together...
en: She hid me in her Gym and we had a lot of fun playing together...
ja: 彼女がジムに匿ってくれて、一緒にいっぱい遊んで楽しかった……

key: Well, I had fun, at least.
en: Well, I had fun, at least.
ja: まあ、楽しかったのはあたしだけかもだけど。

key: I guess we just always did what I wanted.
en: I guess we just always did what I wanted.
ja: いつも、あたしのやりたいことばっかりやってた気がする。

key: But she was there to help me after things got bad too.
en: But she was there to help me after things got bad too.
ja: でも、うまくいかなくなったときも、彼女はちゃんと助けてくれた。

key: I guess she liked me too, for whatever reason.
en: I guess she liked me too, for whatever reason.
ja: なんでかは分かんないけど、あたしのことも好きでいてくれたんだと思う。

key: I don't really get it, but...
en: I don't really get it, but...
ja: よく分かんないけど……

key: I wanna try and make it back up to her.
en: I wanna try and make it back up to her.
ja: 彼女には、ちゃんと恩を返したいの。

key: She was really nice to me and I was selfish.
en: She was really nice to me and I was selfish.
ja: すごく優しくしてくれたのに、あたしはわがままだったから。

key: So I gotta be a good friend from now on, too.
en: So I gotta be a good friend from now on, too.
ja: だから、これからはちゃんといい友達でいなきゃって思ってる。

key: GARDEVOIR: Admirable words from someone who's been through so much!
en: GARDEVOIR: Admirable words from someone who's been through so much!
ja: サーナイト: これだけの経験をされてきた方の、立派な言葉ですね!

key: It seems like this young Trainer has really found the resolve to grow!
en: It seems like this young Trainer has really found the resolve to grow!
ja: この若きトレーナーは、成長するための強い決意を、本当に見つけたようです!

key: I wonder what that could mean for the future of this battler, too!
en: I wonder what that could mean for the future of this battler, too!
ja: この先、このバトラーがどうなっていくのか、楽しみでなりません!

key: Any certain Trainers out there looking to face the Elite Four soon may just want to watch out!
en: Any certain Trainers out there looking to face the Elite Four soon may just want to watch out!
ja: いずれ四天王に挑もうというトレーナーの皆さんは、気をつけた方がいいかもしれませんよ!

key: HEATHER: Obviously! It's just cuz I'm the princess of the wind!
en: HEATHER: Obviously! It's just cuz I'm the princess of the wind!
ja: ヘザー: 当然でしょ! だってあたし、風の姫だもん!

key: GARDEVOIR: The princess of the wind? However do you mean?
en: GARDEVOIR: The princess of the wind? However do you mean?
ja: サーナイト: 風の姫? それはどういう意味でしょう?

key: HEATHER: My Mom was a Flying-type Trainer too, so that's kind of like being the wind!
en: HEATHER: My Mom was a Flying-type Trainer too, so that's kind of like being the wind!
ja: ヘザー: ママも飛行タイプのトレーナーだったから、それって風みたいなものでしょ!

key: I learned what I could from how she used to battle, and now I'm even stronger than she was!
en: I learned what I could from how she used to battle, and now I'm even stronger than she was!
ja: ママの戦い方から学べるだけ学んだから、今はママよりずっと強いよ!

key: GARDEVOIR: Oh my, even stronger? That's quite a claim!
en: GARDEVOIR: Oh my, even stronger? That's quite a claim!
ja: サーナイト: あら、ママより強いですって? それは大きく出ましたね!

key: HEATHER: But it's true! Cuz she only used Pokémon she thought were cute...
en: HEATHER: But it's true! Cuz she only used Pokémon she thought were cute...
ja: ヘザー: でもほんとだもん! だってママ、かわいいと思ったポケモンしか使わなかったし……

key: Like Salamence!
en: Like Salamence!
ja: ボーマンダとかね!

key: Okay, so it's not exactly the usual "cute"-- but that shouldn't be the determining factor!
en: Okay, so it's not exactly the usual "cute"-- but that shouldn't be the determining factor!
ja: まあ、普通の「かわいい」とはちょっと違うけど――でも、それで判断すべきじゃないでしょ!

key: As a top tier battler, I'm not afraid to use the big, powerful ones!
