en: As a top tier battler, I'm not afraid to use the big, powerful ones!
ja: あたしはトップクラスのバトラーだから、でっかくて強いポケモンだって遠慮なく使うの!

key: Everyone's always like "Whaaat? Why would a little girl want a Pokémon like that?"
en: Everyone's always like "Whaaat? Why would a little girl want a Pokémon like that?"
ja: みんないっつも「え? なんで小さい女の子があんなポケモン使いたがるの?」みたいに言うけど。

key: And they try to pass me off with Buneary or Pikachu or some other crap Fairy trash just because it's pink.
en: And they try to pass me off with Buneary or Pikachu or some other crap Fairy trash just because it's pink.
ja: それでミミロルとかピカチュウとか、ピンクだからってだけで押しつけてくるようなフェアリー系のがらくたを勧めてくるんだよね。

key: Who cares about any of that?!
en: Who cares about any of that?!
ja: そんなの知ったこっちゃないし!

key: I don't need to look cute, I need to kick butt!
en: I don't need to look cute, I need to kick butt!
ja: あたしはかわいく見える必要なんてない、蹴散らせればいいの!

key: And that's exactly what I'm gonna do!
en: And that's exactly what I'm gonna do!
ja: それを、これからやってみせるから!

key: GARDEVOIR: That's quite the fighting spirit!
en: GARDEVOIR: That's quite the fighting spirit!
ja: サーナイト: なんて闘志でしょう!

key: And there you have it, folks-- a girl who's not afraid to take on the whole world with the help of her Pokémon!
en: And there you have it, folks-- a girl who's not afraid to take on the whole world with the help of her Pokémon!
ja: そしてこれが今回のお話です――彼女は、ポケモンと共に世界中を相手にすることさえ恐れない女の子!

key: I feel sorry for whatever stray challenger ends up opposite to her in the arena!
en: I feel sorry for whatever stray challenger ends up opposite to her in the arena!
ja: 対戦相手になる挑戦者には、心から同情いたします!

key: That's all on today's Interview Intermission...
en: That's all on today's Interview Intermission...
ja: 本日の「インタビュー中継」は以上です……

key: That's all on today's Interview Intermission. Until next time!
en: That's all on today's Interview Intermission. Until next time!
ja: 本日の「インタビュー中継」は以上です。それではまた次回!

key: Yo, Reborn City! What's up?! We're here with the Reborn Rundown, giving you a look at the Leaders of the Reborn League!
en: Yo, Reborn City! What's up?! We're here with the Reborn Rundown, giving you a look at the Leaders of the Reborn League!
ja: よお、リボーンシティ! 調子はどうだ?! お届けするのは「リボーン・ラウンドアップ」、リボーンリーグのリーダーたちに迫るぜ!

key: I'm your host, DJ Arclight, now on air!
en: I'm your host, DJ Arclight, now on air!
ja: 俺はホストのDJアークライト、ただいま放送中だ!

key: Let's talk about Julia, the Peridot Ward Leader.
en: Let's talk about Julia, the Peridot Ward Leader.
ja: まずはジュリア、ペリドットワードのリーダーについて話そう。

key: Julia's a bombastic battling babe bursting onto the scene after having graduated from the Onyx Trainers' School.
en: Julia's a bombastic battling babe bursting onto the scene after having graduated from the Onyx Trainers' School.
ja: ジュリアは、オニキストレーナーズスクールを卒業したばかりの、はじけるようなバトルの美女だ。

key: With a history of leading Pokémon and cheerleading teams alike, any challenger is promised an exciting battle against her!
en: With a history of leading Pokémon and cheerleading teams alike, any challenger is promised an exciting battle against her!
ja: ポケモンリーダーとしてもチアリーダーとしても活躍してきた彼女との戦いは、どんな挑戦者にとっても間違いなく見ものだぜ!

key: Her Electric-types fall right in line with this, beating down her competitors with a barrage of her signature "boomies".
en: Her Electric-types fall right in line with this, beating down her competitors with a barrage of her signature "boomies".
ja: それにふさわしいのが、でんきタイプのポケモンたち。彼女の代名詞である「ドカーン」攻撃の連発で相手をなぎ倒す。

key: Sonic Boom and Explosion attacks form the chorus of her routine, so any Trainers planning to take her on should be ready to take some hits!
en: Sonic Boom and Explosion attacks form the chorus of her routine, so any Trainers planning to take her on should be ready to take some hits!
ja: ソニックブームとだいばくはつが、彼女の必殺コンボの主旋律。挑戦するトレーナーは、覚悟しておいた方がいいぜ!

key: Take particular care with her Electrode, whose lightning-fast Speed and set damage takes the battle to a crescendo in a blink!
en: Take particular care with her Electrode, whose lightning-fast Speed and set damage takes the battle to a crescendo in a blink!
ja: 特に注意したいのがマルマイン。稲妻のような素早さと固定ダメージで、あっという間に戦いをクライマックスまで持っていくからな!

key: Let's have a quick review of Head Instructor Florinia, Leader of the Onyx Trainers' School in the Onyx Ward.
en: Let's have a quick review of Head Instructor Florinia, Leader of the Onyx Trainers' School in the Onyx Ward.
ja: 続いては、オニキスワードにあるオニキストレーナーズスクールのリーダー、フロリニア校長についてサクッと見ていこう。

key: Take notes!
en: Take notes!
ja: メモを取れよ!

key: Like any good principal, Florinia takes education and knowledge very seriously.
en: Like any good principal, Florinia takes education and knowledge very seriously.
ja: 優れた校長らしく、フロリニアは教育と知識をとても重んじている。

key: Her fighting style makes use of both weather and terrain to overwhelm her opponents in stall-tactics with residual damage effects.
en: Her fighting style makes use of both weather and terrain to overwhelm her opponents in stall-tactics with residual damage effects.
ja: 彼女の戦法は、天候と地形の両方を駆使して、継続ダメージによる持久戦で相手を圧倒するものだ。

key: Not only that, but her signature move, Nature Power, takes a brain to use.
en: Not only that, but her signature move, Nature Power, takes a brain to use.
ja: それだけじゃない、彼女の代名詞技「しぜんのちから」を使いこなすには頭も使わなきゃならない。

key: Most Trainers know that the attack changes based on the environment, but can you match your moves to the field you're on?
en: Most Trainers know that the attack changes based on the environment, but can you match your moves to the field you're on?
ja: この技が環境によって効果を変えることは多くのトレーナーが知っているが、その場に応じて自分の技を合わせられるか?

key: You'll certainly need a tactical advantage to take on her star Pokémon, Cradily!
en: You'll certainly need a tactical advantage to take on her star Pokémon, Cradily!
ja: 彼女のエースポケモン、ユレイドルを相手にするには戦術的な工夫が必須だぜ!

key: Taking center stage in her 'desert rose' fighting style, a Mono-Grass Sandstorm hybrid, Cradily requires either pure strength or pure cunning to take out.
en: Taking center stage in her 'desert rose' fighting style, a Mono-Grass Sandstorm hybrid, Cradily requires either pure strength or pure cunning to take out.
ja: 「砂漠のバラ」と呼ばれる草・すなあらしのハイブリッド戦法の主役、ユレイドルを倒すには純粋な力か、あるいは知恵が必要になる。

key: Today, we're going to be taking a break from our usual programming to dive into some history!
en: Today, we're going to be taking a break from our usual programming to dive into some history!
ja: 今日はいつもの構成を離れて、ちょっと歴史を掘り下げてみようと思う!

key: Specifically, we'll be looking at the now-retired Poison Gym Leader of an era past, Corey Molinar!
en: Specifically, we'll be looking at the now-retired Poison Gym Leader of an era past, Corey Molinar!
ja: 具体的には、今は引退したどくタイプの元ジムリーダー、コーリー・モリナーについてだ!

key: An older man with more derision than a grandma at a metal show, this former star pours it on thick with the pessimism.
en: An older man with more derision than a grandma at a metal show, this former star pours it on thick with the pessimism.
ja: メタルショーに来てるおばあちゃんよりも辛辣な、その元スターは、悲観論をたっぷり振りまいてくれる。

key: Not a whole lot is known about the man except that he appears to have some training as a pharmacist, and works in cooperation with Reborn City police supplying valuable forensic chemicals and advice.
en: Not a whole lot is known about the man except that he appears to have some training as a pharmacist, and works in cooperation with Reborn City police supplying valuable forensic chemicals and advice.
ja: この男についてはあまり知られていないが、薬剤師としての訓練を受けたことがあるらしく、リボーンシティ警察に協力して、貴重な鑑識用の薬品や助言を提供しているようだ。

key: Here's a scoop though-- some residents of the Beryl Ward, where he's known to live, report him frequently visiting and spending hours at the nearby cemetery!
en: Here's a scoop though-- some residents of the Beryl Ward, where he's known to live, report him frequently visiting and spending hours at the nearby cemetery!
ja: ここでスクープだ――彼が住んでいるとされるベリルワードの住民の何人かは、彼が近くの墓地に頻繁に足を運んで、何時間も過ごしているのを見たと証言している!

key: But who could that be for?
en: But who could that be for?
ja: でも、それは一体誰のためなんだろうな?

key: Even I'm not sure.
en: Even I'm not sure.
ja: 俺にもさっぱり分からない。

key: If you ask me, someone oughta go smack a smile into him.
en: If you ask me, someone oughta go smack a smile into him.
ja: 俺に言わせりゃ、誰かあの男に笑顔をたたき込んでやるべきだと思うぜ。

key: Life's too short to be moping around all the time, yanno?
en: Life's too short to be moping around all the time, yanno?
ja: 人生ってのは、ずっと暗い顔してるには短すぎるだろ?

key: Trainers, should you find yourself in a chance battle against the old Leader, be careful!
en: Trainers, should you find yourself in a chance battle against the old Leader, be careful!
ja: トレーナーの諸君、もし偶然この元リーダーとの戦いになったら気をつけろよ!

key: His Crobat is a speed demon, and its attacks are no laughing matter.
en: His Crobat is a speed demon, and its attacks are no laughing matter.
ja: 彼のクロバットはスピードの権化で、その攻撃は笑い事じゃ済まされない。

key: Take special care not to let it set up by keeping pressure on it with status moves or hard-hits.
en: Take special care not to let it set up by keeping pressure on it with status moves or hard-hits.
ja: 状態異常技や強力な一撃で圧力をかけ続けて、積み技を使わせないようにするんだ。

key: Perseverance will always win the day in the face of pessimism!
en: Perseverance will always win the day in the face of pessimism!
ja: 悲観論を前にしても、粘り強さは必ず報われる!

key: Let's talk about Shelly, Leader of the Lapis Ward!
en: Let's talk about Shelly, Leader of the Lapis Ward!
ja: 続いては、ラピスワードのリーダー、シェリーについて話そう!

key: She's a timid soul with a passion for reading and knowledge.
en: She's a timid soul with a passion for reading and knowledge.
ja: 読書と知識に情熱を注ぐ、内気な女の子だ。

key: In fact, it's rare to see the girl without her nose in a book, but it's paid off in spades.
en: In fact, it's rare to see the girl without her nose in a book, but it's paid off in spades.
ja: 実際、本から顔を上げているところを見るのは珍しいくらいだが、それがしっかり実を結んでいる。

key: All that studying means that she knows just what kind of tune to have her Bug-types play in any battle!
en: All that studying means that she knows just what kind of tune to have her Bug-types play in any battle!
ja: たくさんの勉強のおかげで、彼女はどんな戦いでもむしタイプにどんな旋律を奏でさせればいいか、ちゃんと分かっているのさ!

key: Shelly herself prefers Double Battles, using rain to cover her weaknesses and overwhelm the opponent.
en: Shelly herself prefers Double Battles, using rain to cover her weaknesses and overwhelm the opponent.
ja: シェリー自身はダブルバトルを好んで、雨を使って弱点をカバーしつつ相手を圧倒する。

key: Her signature Pokémon, Illumise and Volbeat, are the prelude and finale each to her tactical advantages,
en: Her signature Pokémon, Illumise and Volbeat, are the prelude and finale each to her tactical advantages,
ja: 代名詞のポケモン、イルミーゼとバルビートは、それぞれ彼女の戦術的優位性の前奏と大詰めを担う役割。

key: So if you find yourself facing the bookworm, focus down her supports right away!
en: So if you find yourself facing the bookworm, focus down her supports right away!
ja: だから、この読書家との対戦になったら、まずはそのサポート役を集中して狙うことだ!

key: We've got some sort of mystery for you today, viewers.
en: We've got some sort of mystery for you today, viewers.
ja: 今日は、視聴者の皆さんにちょっとした謎をお届けしよう。

key: Let's talk about Shade, the Ghost Gym Leader.
en: Let's talk about Shade, the Ghost Gym Leader.
ja: ゴーストジムリーダー、シェイドについて話そうと思う。

key: Most people aren't all that sure if Shade is human, a ghost himself, or maybe something else entirely!
en: Most people aren't all that sure if Shade is human, a ghost himself, or maybe something else entirely!
ja: シェイドが人間なのか、幽霊そのものなのか、それとも何か全く別のものなのか、はっきり分かっている人はほとんどいない!

key: Given that he rarely speaks, and that when he does, he seldom makes common sense, there's not a whole lot we can tell you about this entity.
en: Given that he rarely speaks, and that when he does, he seldom makes common sense, there's not a whole lot we can tell you about this entity.
ja: めったに話さないし、話したとしても常識が通じることは滅多にないから、この存在について語れることはあまり多くない。

key: In battle, look out for his ace Pokémon, Mimikyu!
en: In battle, look out for his ace Pokémon, Mimikyu!
ja: 戦いでは、エースポケモンのミミッキュに要注意だ!

key: That Pokémon hides nearly as much as the Leader himself does, but rather than a sinister smile to top it all off, Mimikyu's Disguise makes it hard to hit.
en: That Pokémon hides nearly as much as the Leader himself does, but rather than a sinister smile to top it all off, Mimikyu's Disguise makes it hard to hit.
ja: あのポケモンは、リーダー本人と同じくらい正体を隠しているが、不気味な笑みで飾る代わりに、「ばけのかわ」で攻撃を受けにくくしているぜ。

key: Do your best not to let it get the jump on you... or else!
en: Do your best not to let it get the jump on you... or else!
ja: 先手を取られないよう、全力を尽くせよ……さもないと痛い目に遭うぞ!

key: Today, we're taking a hiatus from your regularly scheduled roster to visit another relic of Reborn's League History, Kiki Argall!
en: Today, we're taking a hiatus from your regularly scheduled roster to visit another relic of Reborn's League History, Kiki Argall!
ja: 今日は普段のラインナップを一旦離れて、リボーンリーグ史のもう一人の生き証人、キキ・アーガルを訪ねてみよう!

key: Now the modest Sensei of Apophyll Academy, Kiki was once a Fighting Gym Leader of some renown!
en: Now the modest Sensei of Apophyll Academy, Kiki was once a Fighting Gym Leader of some renown!
ja: 今ではアポフィルアカデミーの謙虚なセンセイだが、キキはかつて、それなりに名の知れたかくとうジムリーダーだった!

key: A devout teacher of zen philosophy, Kiki sings the melody that eases the mind and plays the beat to soothe the body.
en: A devout teacher of zen philosophy, Kiki sings the melody that eases the mind and plays the beat to soothe the body.
ja: 禅の哲学に深く帰依する教師であるキキは、心を静める旋律を奏で、体をいたわるリズムを刻む。

key: Her special technique, honed even after her retirement, revolves around honing her Pokémon's power with mental focus,
en: Her special technique, honed even after her retirement, revolves around honing her Pokémon's power with mental focus,
ja: 引退後もなお磨き続けている彼女の必殺技は、精神集中でポケモンの力を高めることに重きを置いている。

key: And believe me, a Pokémon's power-packed pure Focus Punch isn't something any brawler can just shrug off.
en: And believe me, a Pokémon's power-packed pure Focus Punch isn't something any brawler can just shrug off.
ja: そして忘れちゃいけない、ありったけの一撃、純粋な「きあいパンチ」の威力は、どんな格闘家でも簡単には受け流せないものだぜ。

key: Take special care with her Medicham!
en: Take special care with her Medicham!
ja: 彼女のチャーレムには特に気をつけろ!

key: Its Meditate attack will skyrocket its offensive capabilities, so make sure to take it down before it can set up!
en: Its Meditate attack will skyrocket its offensive capabilities, so make sure to take it down before it can set up!
ja: 「ヨガのポーズ」で攻撃力が急上昇するから、積まれる前に倒しておくことだ!

key: Today, we're looking at Reborn's newest Leader, the poison-packing Aya!
en: Today, we're looking at Reborn's newest Leader, the poison-packing Aya!
ja: 今日は、リボーンの新人リーダー、どく使いのアヤについて見ていこう!

key: A new star on the scene, Aya has recently replaced her own brother, Cain LaRue, who himself was a relatively recent arrival!
en: A new star on the scene, Aya has recently replaced her own brother, Cain LaRue, who himself was a relatively recent arrival!
ja: 新たに現れたスターであるアヤは、最近まで自身の兄、比較的最近この地に来たばかりのカイン・ラルーに代わってリーダーの座についたばかりだ!

key: It seems between the two of them, they decided she's the better fit for the role of Gym Leader!
en: It seems between the two of them, they decided she's the better fit for the role of Gym Leader!
ja: どうやら二人の間で、ジムリーダーにはアヤの方がふさわしいという結論に至ったらしい!

key: My sources tell me that Aya, who lives in the Byxbysion Wasteland, favors Double Battles,
en: My sources tell me that Aya, who lives in the Byxbysion Wasteland, favors Double Battles,
ja: 俺のネタ元によれば、ビクスビジョン荒野に住むアヤは、ダブルバトルを好み、

key: And uses her signature move to throw all the putrid power of poison across the field at once.
en: And uses her signature move to throw all the putrid power of poison across the field at once.
ja: 代名詞の技を使って、毒のどぎつい力を一気に戦場全体へばらまくそうだ。

key: Take care, or you really will be wasted!
en: Take care, or you really will be wasted!
ja: 気をつけろよ、本当に「毒され」ちまうぞ!

key: Of course, none carries this task out better than her Dragalge.
en: Of course, none carries this task out better than her Dragalge.
ja: もちろん、この役目を彼女以上にこなせるのが、ドラミドロだ。

key: Its Adaptability skill makes any hit sting, so KO that 'Mon ASAP.
en: Its Adaptability skill makes any hit sting, so KO that 'Mon ASAP.
ja: その特性「てきおうりょく」で、どんな一撃も強烈に痛くなる。だからさっさとKOしちまうことだな。

key: Today we're looking at the Ice Gym Leader, Serra!
en: Today we're looking at the Ice Gym Leader, Serra!
ja: 今日は、こおりタイプのジムリーダー、セラについて見ていこう!

key: A former model, Miss Serra Voclain has made a career change and is now breaking up the battle scene.
en: A former model, Miss Serra Voclain has made a career change and is now breaking up the battle scene.
ja: 元モデルのセラ・ヴォクランさんは、キャリアチェンジを果たして、今はバトルシーンを騒がせている。

key: For Trainers daring to bear Serra's feral onslaught, beware and take care to prepare for this icy hell of a fight!
en: For Trainers daring to bear Serra's feral onslaught, beware and take care to prepare for this icy hell of a fight!
ja: セラの容赦ない猛攻に挑もうというトレーナーは、この氷地獄の戦いに備えて、心して臨んだ方がいいぜ!

key: Always one for keeping appearances, Serra's arena is covered top to bottom in mirrors.
en: Always one for keeping appearances, Serra's arena is covered top to bottom in mirrors.
ja: 常に見た目にこだわるセラらしく、彼女のアリーナは上から下まで鏡だらけだ。

key: Her stealthy Pokémon, notably Froslass, enjoy dancing in and out of the frames, both silver and glass, with a tinge of aurora for shine!
en: Her stealthy Pokémon, notably Froslass, enjoy dancing in and out of the frames, both silver and glass, with a tinge of aurora for shine!
ja: 彼女のこっそりしたポケモン、特にユキメノコは、銀とガラス、それぞれの額縁の間をオーロラのきらめきを添えて舞い踊る。

key: Defensive and sneaky plays are the name of her Pokémon's game, so reliable attacks or those that can shatter her screens can be your go-to!
en: Defensive and sneaky plays are the name of her Pokémon's game, so reliable attacks or those that can shatter her screens can be your go-to!
ja: 守りと駆け引きが彼女のポケモンの得意技だから、確実に当てられる攻撃や、鏡を割れる技が頼りになるはずだ!

key: Before going in, reflect on how you can see past her tactics and pin the pin-up model down!
en: Before going in, reflect on how you can see past her tactics and pin the pin-up model down!
ja: 挑む前に、どうすればその戦術を見抜けるか、じっくり考えて、このピンナップモデルを打ち負かしてやれ!

key: Let's talk about Noel!
en: Let's talk about Noel!
ja: 続いてはノエルについて話そう!

key: One of Reborn's youngest Leaders, this prodigy boy has an arena set up right below the Lapis Ward's Orphanage.
en: One of Reborn's youngest Leaders, this prodigy boy has an arena set up right below the Lapis Ward's Orphanage.
ja: リボーン最年少リーダーの一人であるこの神童は、ラピスワードの孤児院のすぐ下にアリーナを構えている。

key: Noel's got a penchant for frustrating his unsuspecting challengers,
en: Noel's got a penchant for frustrating his unsuspecting challengers,
ja: ノエルは、油断した挑戦者を翻弄するのが得意でな、

key: Who suppose either his youth or his Normal-type Pokémon will make for an easy match.
en: Who suppose either his youth or his Normal-type Pokémon will make for an easy match.
ja: 彼の若さやノーマルタイプのポケモンを見て、簡単な相手だろうと高をくくる者も多い。

key: Not to be outdone so easily, Noel packs a medley of Pokémon that cover his weaknesses.
en: Not to be outdone so easily, Noel packs a medley of Pokémon that cover his weaknesses.
ja: だが、そう簡単にはやられない。ノエルは弱点を補うポケモンの布陣を組んでいる。

key: Including, to the surprise of many, his Clefable!
en: Including, to the surprise of many, his Clefable!
ja: 中でも意外なのが、彼のピクシーだ!

key: Though Clefable is no longer a Normal-type Pokémon, Noel is one of the few Leaders to use a wildcard in his battles.
en: Though Clefable is no longer a Normal-type Pokémon, Noel is one of the few Leaders to use a wildcard in his battles.
ja: ピクシーはもうノーマルタイプではないが、ノエルは戦いに切り札を持ち込む数少ないリーダーの一人だ。

key: Don't let yourself get stuck on this brick wall of a Pokémon, and do whatever it takes to take it out before it gets cozy in its defensive capability!
en: Don't let yourself get stuck on this brick wall of a Pokémon, and do whatever it takes to take it out before it gets cozy in its defensive capability!
ja: この壁のように硬いポケモンに足止めされないよう、守りを固められる前に何としても倒しきれ!

key: By the way, a few of our listeners have asked in the past about just how someone of Noel's age earned a position in the Reborn League.
en: By the way, a few of our listeners have asked in the past about just how someone of Noel's age earned a position in the Reborn League.
ja: ところで、リスナーの何人かから、ノエルほどの若さでどうやってリボーンリーグの地位を手にしたのか、これまで質問をもらっている。

key: Like any Leader, he was referred to the position and passed his qualifying tests-- with flying colors, no less!
en: Like any Leader, he was referred to the position and passed his qualifying tests-- with flying colors, no less!
ja: 他のリーダーと同じく、彼も推薦を受けて資格試験に合格した――それも、優秀な成績でな!

key: But just who would refer him to such a position?
en: But just who would refer him to such a position?
ja: では、一体誰が彼をその座に推薦したのか?

key: We'll give you just a small hint! All right, listen closely:
en: We'll give you just a small hint! All right, listen closely:
ja: ちょっとしたヒントをやろう! よく聞いておけよ:

key: We've got a report on Grandmaster Radomus, Reborn's Psychic Leader!
en: We've got a report on Grandmaster Radomus, Reborn's Psychic Leader!
ja: リボーンのエスパータイプリーダー、ラドマス大師について報告が入っている!

key: Radomus is a cheery man with a fascination for assorted hats!
en: Radomus is a cheery man with a fascination for assorted hats!
ja: ラドマスは、さまざまな帽子に目がない陽気な男だ!

key: Ranging from fashionable to outright bizarre, his wardrobe and mannerisms toe the line between defying and defining logic!
en: Ranging from fashionable to outright bizarre, his wardrobe and mannerisms toe the line between defying and defining logic!
ja: おしゃれなものから突拍子もないものまで、その服装と立ち居振る舞いは、理屈が通っているようで通っていないような、絶妙な境界線を行く!

key: Of course, as a Grandmaster of chess, his logic must be solid.
en: Of course, as a Grandmaster of chess, his logic must be solid.
ja: もちろん、チェスの大師である以上、その理屈はしっかりしているはずだ。

key: Having amassed a fortune from tournaments, he lives in his very own personal Castle, complete with a Chessboard Arena!
en: Having amassed a fortune from tournaments, he lives in his very own personal Castle, complete with a Chessboard Arena!
ja: トーナメントで築いた財産を元に、自分だけの城に住んでいて、そこにはチェス盤を模したアリーナまで完備されている!

key: In battle, his Psychic abilities can shift the pieces around, including making them attack your own Pokémon.
en: In battle, his Psychic abilities can shift the pieces around, including making them attack your own Pokémon.
ja: 戦いでは、彼のエスパー能力が駒を自在に動かし、こちらのポケモンを攻撃させることさえある。

key: Fight back by beating him at his own game!
en: Fight back by beating him at his own game!
ja: 彼のやり方で、彼自身を打ち負かせ!

key: His ace Pokémon is already well known herself, the one and only Gossip Gardevoir, who runs other segments on the network.
en: His ace Pokémon is already well known herself, the one and only Gossip Gardevoir, who runs other segments on the network.
ja: エースポケモンはもう有名だろう、他でもないゴシップサーナイト、当局でも他のコーナーを担当している。

key: Her strength is matched only by her pep, so make sure you're ready when going into battle, otherwise you'll find yourself right in check by the two of them!
en: Her strength is matched only by her pep, so make sure you're ready when going into battle, otherwise you'll find yourself right in check by the two of them!
ja: 元気いっぱいなのと同じくらい強さも折り紙つきだから、戦いに臨む際はしっかり準備しておけよ、さもないと二人がかりでチェックメイトされちまうぞ!

key: Let's talk about the Gym Leader, Luna!
en: Let's talk about the Gym Leader, Luna!
ja: 続いてはジムリーダー、ルナについて話そう!

key: Luna's a lovely lady with more than one way to make a man tremble.
en: Luna's a lovely lady with more than one way to make a man tremble.
ja: ルナは、男をとろけさせる方法をいくつも知っている、魅力的な女性だ。

key: If her beauty wasn't spell-binding alone, her Dark-type attacks will lock down and take out any opposition if unchecked.
en: If her beauty wasn't spell-binding alone, her Dark-type attacks will lock down and take out any opposition if unchecked.
ja: その美しさだけでも十分に魅了されるが、それに加えて、あくタイプの攻撃で、油断した相手を封じ込め、確実に仕留める。

key: And from being the Champion of Wonderland, to a regal lord's maid, Luna enjoys bringing infinity to reality by living out storybook tales.
en: And from being the Champion of Wonderland, to a regal lord's maid, Luna enjoys bringing infinity to reality by living out storybook tales.
ja: 「ワンダーランドのチャンピオン」から「貴族の従者」まで、ルナは物語の世界を現実に持ち込んで生きるのを楽しんでいる。

key: Even her Pokémon are all named after characters from old fantasy!
en: Even her Pokémon are all named after characters from old fantasy!
ja: 彼女のポケモンたちには、みんな古い物語のキャラクターの名前がついている!

key: As for what they are, we'll let you figure out the hard way.
en: As for what they are, we'll let you figure out the hard way.
ja: それが何なのかは、自分で苦労して見つけてもらうとしよう。

key: After all, the Cheshire Cat himself was never too clear.
en: After all, the Cheshire Cat himself was never too clear.
ja: 何せ、あのチェシャ猫でさえ、はっきりしたことは一度も言わなかったんだからな。

key: One-and-two, that's a knockout!
en: One-and-two, that's a knockout!
ja: ワン・ツー、それでノックアウトだ!

key: You'll hear this often when facing the Agate Circus Strongman, Samson!
en: You'll hear this often when facing the Agate Circus Strongman, Samson!
ja: アゲート・サーカスの力自慢、サムソンとの戦いでは、これをよく耳にすることになるだろう。

key: Reborn's current Fighting Gym Leader, compared to the long past previous one, is all about matter over mind!
en: Reborn's current Fighting Gym Leader, compared to the long past previous one, is all about matter over mind!
ja: 過去の歴代リーダーと比べて、リボーン現かくとうジムリーダーは、精神論より力がものを言うタイプだ!

key: His Pokémon's power is augmented by the Big Top's High Striker effect, an infamously rigged carnival game that triggers based on certain attacks!
en: His Pokémon's power is augmented by the Big Top's High Striker effect, an infamously rigged carnival game that triggers based on certain attacks!
ja: 彼のポケモンの力は、ビッグトップの「ハイストライカー」効果によって底上げされる。特定の技で発動する、悪名高きインチキ祭り屋台のゲームだ!

key: Here's a hook: It turns out, Samson may not have joined the League of his own accord.
en: Here's a hook: It turns out, Samson may not have joined the League of his own accord.
ja: ここでひとネタ――実は、サムソンは自分の意思でリーグに入ったわけじゃないらしい。

key: It seems he was strong-armed into it by another party.
en: It seems he was strong-armed into it by another party.
ja: どうやら、別の人物に無理やり引き込まれたようだ。

key: And who's that?
en: And who's that?
ja: それは、一体誰なんだ?

key: None other than the Agate Circus' Ground Leader, Terra!
en: None other than the Agate Circus' Ground Leader, Terra!
ja: 他でもない、アゲート・サーカスのじめんリーダー、テラだ!

key: What could have gone down?
en: What could have gone down?
ja: 一体何があったんだろうな?

key: The world may never know.
en: The world may never know.
ja: 真相は誰にも分からないかもしれない。

key: But in order to take him out, beat him at his own game!
en: But in order to take him out, beat him at his own game!
ja: だが、彼を倒すには、彼のやり方で打ち負かせばいい!

key: Cripple his Pokémon to reduce their power-- even that from the High Striker-- or use the Big Top's Flying-type advantages for the super-effective kill!
en: Cripple his Pokémon to reduce their power-- even that from the High Striker-- or use the Big Top's Flying-type advantages for the super-effective kill!
ja: ポケモンを弱体化させて力を削ぐんだ――ハイストライカーの効果も含めてな――それか、ビッグトップのひこうタイプ有利を活かして、効果ばつぐんで仕留めろ!

key: Either way, Pokémon like his ace, Conkeldurr, are sure not to go down easy as they tank hits and strike back double every time!
en: Either way, Pokémon like his ace, Conkeldurr, are sure not to go down easy as they tank hits and strike back double every time!
ja: どちらにしても、エースのローブシンのようなポケモンは、一撃食らってもしっかり耐えて、倍にして殴り返してくるから、そう簡単には倒れないぜ!

key: Today, we're going over Charlotte, a young beauty as cool as she is hot!
en: Today, we're going over Charlotte, a young beauty as cool as she is hot!
ja: 今日はシャルロットについて見ていこう、クールでありながら情熱的な若き美女だ!

key: Taking over her mother's Gym after years of absence, Charlotte's Super-heated Field offers little advantage itself to her Fire-types.
en: Taking over her mother's Gym after years of absence, Charlotte's Super-heated Field offers little advantage itself to her Fire-types.
ja: 何年もの不在の後、母親のジムを引き継いだシャルロットだが、彼女自身の「超高温フィールド」は、ほのおタイプにさほど有利には働かない。

key: However, when ignited by her wide-ranged Fire attacks, the inferno takes a new life, and often a few other lives with it!
en: However, when ignited by her wide-ranged Fire attacks, the inferno takes a new life, and often a few other lives with it!
ja: しかし、彼女の広範囲に及ぶほのお技によって火がつけば、その業火は新たな命を宿し、他の命まで巻き添えにすることもしばしばだ!

key: Trainers will need to keep the flames under wraps one way or another, or pack a team that can stand them!
en: Trainers will need to keep the flames under wraps one way or another, or pack a team that can stand them!
ja: トレーナーは何らかの方法で炎を封じ込めるか、それに耐えられるチームを用意する必要があるぜ!

key: The situation gets no more mild when her Ninetales enters the fray!
en: The situation gets no more mild when her Ninetales enters the fray!
ja: キュウコンが戦場に加わると、状況はさらに厳しくなる!

key: Its Drought Ability amplifies her strength even further, but keep in mind, every strategy has its exploits!
en: Its Drought Ability amplifies her strength even further, but keep in mind, every strategy has its exploits!
ja: その特性「ひでり」が彼女の力をさらに引き上げるが、忘れるな、どんな戦法にも弱点はあるってことをな!

key: She's hearty, she's hyper, and she's abso-freaking- lutely insane--
en: She's hearty, she's hyper, and she's abso-freaking- lutely insane--
ja: 彼女は元気いっぱい、ハイテンションで、そしてぶっちぎりにイカれてる――

key: Terra, the Ground Gym Leader, is up to play!
en: Terra, the Ground Gym Leader, is up to play!
ja: じめんジムリーダー、テラの登場だ!

key: With a personality like an earthquake and a type to match, anyone who's met her-- is probably traumatized.
en: With a personality like an earthquake and a type to match, anyone who's met her-- is probably traumatized.
ja: 地震のような性格に、それにぴったりのタイプ。彼女に会った者は、きっと誰もがトラウマを抱えているだろう。

key: However, I wanted to find out what's really behind that energetic persona, so I did some digging to find out.
en: However, I wanted to find out what's really behind that energetic persona, so I did some digging to find out.
ja: だが、あの元気いっぱいの人柄の裏に本当は何があるのか知りたくて、少し調べてみたんだ。

key: From the records I found, it looks like Terra was a fairly average girl at one point, having been raised in the Beryl Ward.
en: From the records I found, it looks like Terra was a fairly average girl at one point, having been raised in the Beryl Ward.
ja: 見つけた記録によると、テラはかつてベリルワードで育った、ごく平凡な女の子だったらしい。

key: School reports say she was very shy, and seldom socialized, and took a natural interest in computer science.
en: School reports say she was very shy, and seldom socialized, and took a natural interest in computer science.
ja: 学校の記録では、とても内気で、あまり社交的でもなく、コンピューターサイエンスに自然と興味を持っていたそうだ。

key: One day, however, she ran away from home for a reason perhaps she only knows...
en: One day, however, she ran away from home for a reason perhaps she only knows...
ja: しかしある日、彼女は本人にしか分からない理由で家出をして……

key: ...and was next known applying for a job at the Agate Circus with her zany energetic persona!
en: ...and was next known applying for a job at the Agate Circus with her zany energetic persona!
ja: ……次に確認されたのは、あの奇抜で元気いっぱいのキャラクターのまま、アゲート・サーカスに就職を申し込んでいたところだった!

key: Just what happened to her between the time she left home and the time she joined the Circus?
en: Just what happened to her between the time she left home and the time she joined the Circus?
ja: 家を出てからサーカスに入るまでの間、彼女に一体何があったんだろうな?

key: Call me crazy-- Actually, call her crazy,
en: Call me crazy-- Actually, call her crazy,
ja: 俺をおかしいと言ってくれ――いや、テラをおかしいと言うべきか、

key: But I'm not sure I want to find out.
en: But I'm not sure I want to find out.
ja: でも、正直、あまり知りたいとは思わないな。

key: Let's talk about the aerial Agate Ace, Ciel!
en: Let's talk about the aerial Agate Ace, Ciel!
ja: 続いては、空のアゲートのエース、シエルについて話そう!

key: If you haven't seen her in action, then imagine this:
en: If you haven't seen her in action, then imagine this:
ja: まだ彼女の演技を見たことがないなら、こんな光景を想像してみてくれ:

key: Two ribbons hang from the ceiling.
en: Two ribbons hang from the ceiling.
ja: 天井から二本のリボンが垂れ下がっている。

key: A dancer on the floor twirls herself betwixt them, over, under, and back again, spinning this way and that, pulling the ribbons ever tighter to her.
en: A dancer on the floor twirls herself betwixt them, over, under, and back again, spinning this way and that, pulling the ribbons ever tighter to her.
ja: 床の上で踊る一人の少女が、その間をくぐり抜けるように身をひねり、上へ下へ、行きつ戻りつしながら、リボンを少しずつ自分の方へたぐり寄せていく。

key: Then--
en: Then--
ja: そして――

key: She jumps.
en: She jumps.
ja: 彼女は跳ぶ。

key: The ribbons unfurl around her body, lifting her up with their tension.
en: The ribbons unfurl around her body, lifting her up with their tension.
ja: リボンが体の周りでほどけて、その張力で彼女を宙へと持ち上げる。

key: She grabs onto them, subtly climbing higher as she flips over, her legs dancing towards the sky.
en: She grabs onto them, subtly climbing higher as she flips over, her legs dancing towards the sky.
ja: リボンをつかんだまま、彼女はくるりと回転しながらさらに高く登っていき、脚が空へ向かって舞う。

key: She can walk, swing, float in mid air, all between these ribbons, moving like water through the atmosphere.
en: She can walk, swing, float in mid air, all between these ribbons, moving like water through the atmosphere.
ja: 歩き、揺れ、宙に浮かぶ――そのすべてをリボンの間でこなし、まるで水が空気の中を漂うように動く。

key: The crowd gazes in silent awe as she moves against gravity and with the melody,
en: The crowd gazes in silent awe as she moves against gravity and with the melody,
ja: 観客は言葉もなく見とれる。重力に逆らい、旋律と一体になって舞う彼女の姿に。

key: Gracefully rolling herself into an angel's sleeve, and descending to the Earth again.
en: Gracefully rolling herself into an angel's sleeve, and descending to the Earth again.
ja: そして優雅に体を丸め、天使の袖のようにたたみながら、再び地上へと降りていく。

key: It's undeniable-- nothing can match Ciel's grace and beauty!
en: It's undeniable-- nothing can match Ciel's grace and beauty!
ja: 疑いようがない――シエルの優雅さと美しさに敵うものはない!

key: In fact, some day, I'd like to get her in for an interview.
en: In fact, some day, I'd like to get her in for an interview.
ja: 実を言うと、いつか彼女にインタビューを受けてもらいたいと思っているんだ。

key: "Ciel, tell us-- What's your number?"
en: "Ciel, tell us-- What's your number?"
ja: 「シエル、教えてくれ――スリーサイズは?」

key: Sorry, listeners, but I'm not broadcasting the answer to that question.
en: Sorry, listeners, but I'm not broadcasting the answer to that question.
ja: リスナーの皆さん、すまないが、その答えは放送できない。

key: Today I'd like to talk about Reborn's Fairy-type Gym Leader, Adrienn Flores.
en: Today I'd like to talk about Reborn's Fairy-type Gym Leader, Adrienn Flores.
ja: 今日は、リボーンのフェアリータイプジムリーダー、アドリエンヌ・フローレスについて話したい。

key: Personally speaking, I've only gotten to know Adrienn very recently,
en: Personally speaking, I've only gotten to know Adrienn very recently,
ja: 個人的な話をすると、アドリエンヌと知り合ったのはつい最近のことなんだが、

key: But I'd like to think that in our time working together around Reborn City, we've become pretty good friends.
en: But I'd like to think that in our time working together around Reborn City, we've become pretty good friends.
ja: リボーンシティで一緒に活動する中で、かなりいい友達になれたと思っている。

key: Adrienn's that sort of person who knows how to sing xyr spirit into every syllable, and believe me, it shows.
en: Adrienn's that sort of person who knows how to sing xyr spirit into every syllable, and believe me, it shows.
ja: アドリエンヌは、どんな言葉にも心を込めて歌うように話す人で、それは本当に伝わってくる。

key: In just the small amount of time xe's been around, xe's been able to attract more people to xyr life and xyr cause than anyone else I've ever met.
en: In just the small amount of time xe's been around, xe's been able to attract more people to xyr life and xyr cause than anyone else I've ever met.
ja: 出会ってからまだそう時間は経っていないのに、誰よりも多くの人を自分の生き方と信念に引き寄せてきた。

key: Hold up, that gives me an idea.
en: Hold up, that gives me an idea.
ja: おっと、それでひとつ思いついたことがある。

key: I've got a feeling that Adrienn would give some out-of-this-world dating advice.
en: I've got a feeling that Adrienn would give some out-of-this-world dating advice.
ja: アドリエンヌなら、とんでもなく突き抜けた恋愛アドバイスをしてくれそうな気がするんだ。

key: Listeners, if you'd be interested in having Adrienn on the show for a segment, why don't you hit us up on Chatter and let us know what questions you'd have.
en: Listeners, if you'd be interested in having Adrienn on the show for a segment, why don't you hit us up on Chatter and let us know what questions you'd have.
ja: リスナーの皆さん、アドリエンヌを番組に呼んでコーナーをやってほしいなら、チャッターで質問を送ってくれ。

key: But back to the silver-haired silvertongue's day-to- day dealings, don't mistake xyr softness of heart for softness in battle.
en: But back to the silver-haired silvertongue's day-to- day dealings, don't mistake xyr softness of heart for softness in battle.
ja: 話を戻そう。この銀髪の弁が立つ人物の日々の仕事ぶりについてだが、その心の柔らかさを、戦いの弱さと勘違いしないように。

key: Adrienn's battle style numbers in Doubles, and a Fairy pairing makes a very scary and fairly harrying team tearing into challengers left and right!
en: Adrienn's battle style numbers in Doubles, and a Fairy pairing makes a very scary and fairly harrying team tearing into challengers left and right!
ja: アドリエンヌの戦法はダブルバトル、フェアリータイプのコンビは挑戦者を左右から切り裂く、かなり恐ろしいチームだ!

key: In particular, watch out for xyr Florges, Rhyannon-- a Pokémon that might as well run in xyr family.
en: In particular, watch out for xyr Florges, Rhyannon-- a Pokémon that might as well run in xyr family.
ja: 特に注意したいのが、彼のフラージェス、リアノン――もはや一族の代名詞と言ってもいいポケモンだ。

key: With mixed moves to pack a pixie punch and more bulk than a beefed-up Blissey, it's gonna take a team effort to uproot this flower power.
en: With mixed moves to pack a pixie punch and more bulk than a beefed-up Blissey, it's gonna take a team effort to uproot this flower power.
ja: 変幻自在の技で妖精のパンチを繰り出し、鍛え上げたハピナスよりもタフ。この花の力を根こそぎ倒すには、チーム全員の力が必要になるだろう。

key: But I gotta be honest with you guys-- I haven't had the best time lately.
en: But I gotta be honest with you guys-- I haven't had the best time lately.
ja: でも正直に言うと、俺自身、最近はあまり調子がよくないんだ。

key: Had a little accident--
en: Had a little accident--
ja: ちょっとした事故があってな――

key: And let's just say it's a miracle I'm fit to go on TV right now.
en: And let's just say it's a miracle I'm fit to go on TV right now.
ja: 今こうしてテレビに出られているのが奇跡ってくらいだ、とだけ言っておこう。

key: Eye patches are stylish, right?
en: Eye patches are stylish, right?
ja: 眼帯ってスタイリッシュだろ?

key: I'll spare you all the details-- some of them are unclear to me anyway.
en: I'll spare you all the details-- some of them are unclear to me anyway.
ja: 詳しいことは省くよ――そもそも俺自身、よく分かってない部分もあるし。

key: But for those who might be concerned-- no need.
en: But for those who might be concerned-- no need.
ja: でも心配してくれてる人がいたら――大丈夫だから安心してくれ。

key: What doesn't kill us makes us stronger, but probably needs to be pummeled into the ground anyway.
en: What doesn't kill us makes us stronger, but probably needs to be pummeled into the ground anyway.
ja: 死なない程度の苦難は人を強くする、って言うけど、まあそれでも、地面にたたきつけられるくらいはされるもんだ。

key: Enough about me-- we've got a Gym Leader profile to steal the show.
en: Enough about me-- we've got a Gym Leader profile to steal the show.
ja: 俺の話はこれくらいにして――今日は番組を丸ごとかっさらうジムリーダー特集だ。

key: And who better to steal it than the Steel Leader herself, Titania Andersen.
en: And who better to steal it than the Steel Leader herself, Titania Andersen.
ja: それをかっさらうのにふさわしいのは、はがねリーダー、ティタニア・アンダーセンをおいて他にいない。

key: Now Tania, as her friends call her, ain' the most friendly Leader on the chopping block.
en: Now Tania, as her friends call her, ain' the most friendly Leader on the chopping block.
ja: 友達からは「ターニャ」と呼ばれてるらしいが、リーダーの中でも一番愛想がいいってわけじゃない。

key: She's got a personality harder than her element and a temper on the cutting edge.
en: She's got a personality harder than her element and a temper on the cutting edge.
ja: 自分の属性より硬い性格に、切れ味抜群の短気っぷりまで持ち合わせている。

key: But this smoldering beauty is forged of more than just a metal mettle and flare.
en: But this smoldering beauty is forged of more than just a metal mettle and flare.
ja: でもこのくすぶる美女は、鋼の意志と気迫だけでできているわけじゃない。

key: You'd never know from looking, but this lass has a literary lineage and the interest to match.
en: You'd never know from looking, but this lass has a literary lineage and the interest to match.
ja: 見た目からは想像もつかないだろうが、この娘には文学の血筋と、それにふさわしい教養がある。

key: I'm told that above all other subjects in her education at the Onyx Trainers' School-- even battling-- Miss Titania chose to prioritize classic literature.
en: I'm told that above all other subjects in her education at the Onyx Trainers' School-- even battling-- Miss Titania chose to prioritize classic literature.
ja: 聞くところによると、オニキストレーナー学校での授業では、他のどの科目よりも――戦闘術さえ差し置いて――ティタニア嬢は古典文学を優先していたそうだ。

key: Who knows what about turning pages turns her head, but maybe it's this archaic aesthetic that draws her to older arts like drawing blades.
en: Who knows what about turning pages turns her head, but maybe it's this archaic aesthetic that draws her to older arts like drawing blades.
ja: ページをめくることの何がそんなに彼女をひきつけるのかは分からないが、剣を振るうような古風な技芸にひかれるのも、この古典趣味のせいなのかもしれない。

key: For a girl known to swing around her Aegislash as easily as if it were an épée,
en: For a girl known to swing around her Aegislash as easily as if it were an épée,
ja: エペのようにエスパトラを振り回すことで知られる彼女らしく、

key: It should be no surprise that the blade and buckle Pokémon also acts as her ace!
en: It should be no surprise that the blade and buckle Pokémon also acts as her ace!
ja: その剣と盾のポケモンがエースを務めているのも、何ら驚くことじゃない!

key: Those who intend to take arms against her should take care not to lose their own during the battle!
en: Those who intend to take arms against her should take care not to lose their own during the battle!
ja: 彼女に挑もうという者は、戦いの最中に自分の腕まで失わないよう気をつけることだ!

key: Today we'll be talking about an admirable allure in the astounding alacrity of the aqua artist, Amaria Fiore!
en: Today we'll be talking about an admirable allure in the astounding alacrity of the aqua artist, Amaria Fiore!
ja: 今日は、水の芸術家、驚くべき機敏さを誇る称賛すべき魅力の持ち主、アマリア・フィオーレについて話そう!

key: Amaria is Reborn's most senior Leader-- not in age, mind you, as this maritime maiden is as fair on the eyes as she is on the heart--
en: Amaria is Reborn's most senior Leader-- not in age, mind you, as this maritime maiden is as fair on the eyes as she is on the heart--
ja: アマリアはリボーンで最も古株のリーダーだ――年齢の話じゃないぞ、この海の乙女は見た目も心も若々しいままだからな――

key: But despite her youth, she was the first Leader chosen by former Champion and Reborn League Manager Ame to take up a Gym Leader title.
en: But despite her youth, she was the first Leader chosen by former Champion and Reborn League Manager Ame to take up a Gym Leader title.
ja: とはいえ、その若さにもかかわらず、彼女は元チャンピオンでリボーンリーグ運営者のアメが最初にジムリーダーの座を任せた人物だった。

key: Apparently, the two of them were somehow close friends and inspired each other to take steps to reopen the old League!
en: Apparently, the two of them were somehow close friends and inspired each other to take steps to reopen the old League!
ja: 二人はどういうわけか親友同士で、互いに刺激し合って古いリーグを再興させる一歩を踏み出したらしい!

key: So for all those Trainers out there enjoying Reborn and its challenges, remember-- you've got Amaria Fiore to thank for it!
en: So for all those Trainers out there enjoying Reborn and its challenges, remember-- you've got Amaria Fiore to thank for it!
ja: だから、リボーンとその挑戦を楽しんでいるトレーナーの皆は覚えておいてくれ――それもこれも、アマリア・フィオーレのおかげなんだ!

key: The lass has also made quite a splash in Reborn City's development in the past even aside from that,
en: The lass has also made quite a splash in Reborn City's development in the past even aside from that,
ja: この娘はそれ以外にも、リボーンシティの発展に大きく貢献してきた。

key: Having been responsible for tracking down and shutting up some of Reborn City's most environmentally-damaging facilities.
en: Having been responsible for tracking down and shutting up some of Reborn City's most environmentally-damaging facilities.
ja: リボーンシティで最も環境を汚していた施設のいくつかを突き止め、閉鎖に追い込んだ張本人でもある。

key: Those who've seen her in action know that her star player, a Lapras named Deliverance,
en: Those who've seen her in action know that her star player, a Lapras named Deliverance,
ja: 彼女の戦いを見たことがある者なら知っているだろう、彼女のエース、デリバランスという名のラプラスは、

key: Should only be underestimated by those who want to themselves be dragged under.
en: Should only be underestimated by those who want to themselves be dragged under.
ja: 甘く見ていいのは、自分も一緒に引きずり込まれたい者だけだ。

key: And how does a Pokémon get a name like that, you may wonder.
en: And how does a Pokémon get a name like that, you may wonder.
ja: そもそも、なんでポケモンにそんな名前がついたのか、気になる人もいるだろう。

key: From what Miss Amaria has said in the past, it seems like it earned its name firsthand.
en: From what Miss Amaria has said in the past, it seems like it earned its name firsthand.
ja: アマリア嬢がかつて語ったところによると、その名は身をもって手に入れたものらしい。

key: She tells a story about a time when she was swimming far out from the coast, only to be caught in the middle of a storm!
en: She tells a story about a time when she was swimming far out from the coast, only to be caught in the middle of a storm!
ja: ある日、彼女は海岸から遠く離れた沖で泳いでいて、嵐のただ中に巻き込まれてしまったという話だ!

key: Make no mistake-- Amy is a stunning swimmer, but stormy seas can sink even the most stout ships.
en: Make no mistake-- Amy is a stunning swimmer, but stormy seas can sink even the most stout ships.
ja: 誤解しないでほしいが、エイミーは泳ぎの達人だ。でも荒れた海は、どんなに頑丈な船だって沈めてしまう。

key: So it was when Amaria thought she'd drawn her last breath that she found herself pulled first to the surface and second to safety by a Pokémon!
en: So it was when Amaria thought she'd drawn her last breath that she found herself pulled first to the surface and second to safety by a Pokémon!
ja: それで、もう最後の息だと思ったそのとき、あるポケモンに助けられ、まず水面へ、そして安全な場所へと引き上げられたそうだ!

key: That Pokémon would be her lifelong companion, who she named Deliverance in thanks for it saving her life.
en: That Pokémon would be her lifelong companion, who she named Deliverance in thanks for it saving her life.
ja: そのポケモンこそ、彼女の生涯の相棒となり、命を救ってくれた感謝を込めて「デリバランス」と名づけられた。

key: Turns out, Deliverance saves more than just lives though, with many of Amaria's past challengers having been staring it down as the face of defeat,
en: Turns out, Deliverance saves more than just lives though, with many of Amaria's past challengers having been staring it down as the face of defeat,
ja: 実はデリバランスが救うのは命だけじゃない。アマリアの過去の挑戦者の多くが、勝ったと思っていた試合の最後にこのポケモンと対決し、敗北を突きつけられている、

key: In what otherwise seemed like a won match for them.
en: In what otherwise seemed like a won match for them.
ja: それも、勝利を確信していたはずの試合でだ。

key: As Amaria announces-- Deliverance always pulls through for her!
en: As Amaria announces-- Deliverance always pulls through for her!
ja: アマリアいわく――デリバランスはいつだって、彼女のために踏ん張ってくれるらしい!

key: We've got a special program rolling out for you today on the Rock-type and rockin' roller renegade, Hardy Andersen!
en: We've got a special program rolling out for you today on the Rock-type and rockin' roller renegade, Hardy Andersen!
ja: 今日は特別企画をお届けする、いわタイプのロックなはみ出し者、ハーディ・アンダーセンについてだ!

key: If that last name sounds familiar to you, it should-- He's the younger brother of Steel Leader Titania Andersen...
en: If that last name sounds familiar to you, it should-- He's the younger brother of Steel Leader Titania Andersen...
ja: その苗字、聞き覚えがあるって? そのとおり――彼は、はがねリーダー、ティタニア・アンダーセンの弟だ……

key: And in a sense, he's got her to thank for his stairway to heaven!
en: And in a sense, he's got her to thank for his stairway to heaven!
ja: そしてある意味、彼が今のステータスを手にできたのも、彼女のおかげとも言える!

key: You see, nowadays there isn't a whole lotta love between them, but they weren't always in such bad company.
en: You see, nowadays there isn't a whole lotta love between them, but they weren't always in such bad company.
ja: 今でこそ二人の間に愛情はあまり感じられないが、昔からずっとこんな間柄だったわけじゃない。

key: Back in the glory days, the two of them were thick as thieves, united in their interest for Rock-type Pokémon!
en: Back in the glory days, the two of them were thick as thieves, united in their interest for Rock-type Pokémon!
ja: 華やかだったころは、二人はいわタイプのポケモンへの興味で結ばれた大の仲良しだった!

key: But when Steel-types were discovered and were all the latest pride and joy of the Pokémon world, Titania jumped ship and went her own way!
en: But when Steel-types were discovered and were all the latest pride and joy of the Pokémon world, Titania jumped ship and went her own way!
ja: でも、はがねタイプが発見されてポケモン界の新たな人気者になると、ティタニアはあっさり乗り換えて自分の道を進んだ!

key: She never looked back, but Hardy was determined to dream on with his classic type!
en: She never looked back, but Hardy was determined to dream on with his classic type!
ja: 彼女は一度も振り返らなかったが、ハーディは自分の信じる古典タイプを貫くと心に決めていた!

key: And thus started an enduring rivalry between the siblings-- one that don't stop even today!
en: And thus started an enduring rivalry between the siblings-- one that don't stop even today!
ja: そうして始まった兄妹の因縁は――今日この日まで続いている!

key: Hardy's held that determination fast to take care of business and rise up in the ranks, raring to prove once and for all just which is the better type!
en: Hardy's held that determination fast to take care of business and rise up in the ranks, raring to prove once and for all just which is the better type!
ja: ハーディはその決意を固く胸に抱き、実力をつけて順位を駆け上がってきた。ついにどちらが優れたタイプなのか、白黒つけてやろうと意気込んでいる!

key: And indeed, Hardy isn't just another brick in the cabal of Rock Leaders at the bottom of their totems.
en: And indeed, Hardy isn't just another brick in the cabal of Rock Leaders at the bottom of their totems.
ja: そして実際、ハーディはいわタイプリーダーの底辺に転がるただの石ころなんかじゃない。

key: As the second highest-ranked Leader in Reborn, that boy promises to rock all his challengers like a hurricane!
en: As the second highest-ranked Leader in Reborn, that boy promises to rock all his challengers like a hurricane!
ja: リボーン第2位のリーダーとして、あの少年はどんな挑戦者もハリケーンのように吹き飛ばすと約束するぜ!

key: Challengers looking to face down Hardy should take extra care for his Dusk Form Lycanroc!
en: Challengers looking to face down Hardy should take extra care for his Dusk Form Lycanroc!
ja: ハーディに挑もうというトレーナーは、彼のたそがれのすがたのルガルガンに特に気をつけろ!

key: This beast of burden promises to send any challenger free-fallin' unless they escape just by the hair of the dog!
en: This beast of burden promises to send any challenger free-fallin' unless they escape just by the hair of the dog!
ja: この重荷を背負った獣は、間一髪で逃げ切らない限り、どんな挑戦者もまっさかさまに突き落とす!

key: And that's more than just a feeling.
en: And that's more than just a feeling.
ja: それは単なる気のせいなんかじゃない。

key: On the chopping block today is the top-brass battler, gold medalist among the masters, Saphira Belrose!
en: On the chopping block today is the top-brass battler, gold medalist among the masters, Saphira Belrose!
ja: 今日番組で取り上げるのは、一流のバトラー、達人たちの中の金メダリスト、サファイラ・ベルローズだ!

key: This Dragon Type dame is a destructive force not to be fought lightly, as she vouchsafes her type's reputation as the kings of old!
en: This Dragon Type dame is a destructive force not to be fought lightly, as she vouchsafes her type's reputation as the kings of old!
ja: このドラゴンタイプの女傑は、軽々しく戦っていい相手じゃない。古の王者たるドラゴンタイプの誇りを、その身で証明している!

key: And speaking of reputations, it'd seem that one runs in the family.
en: And speaking of reputations, it'd seem that one runs in the family.
ja: 誇りといえば、それも一族の血筋らしい。

key: Saphira inherits her gym and power in two-step from her father, Montague Belrose, of the previous generation of Leaders.
en: Saphira inherits her gym and power in two-step from her father, Montague Belrose, of the previous generation of Leaders.
ja: サファイラは、先代リーダーの一人だった父、モンタギュー・ベルローズから、ジムと力を二段構えで受け継いだ。

key: Those who've remained in or returned to the region since old days might remember the fiery competition between he and Caroline Flambairn.
en: Those who've remained in or returned to the region since old days might remember the fiery competition between he and Caroline Flambairn.
ja: 昔からこの地方にいる、あるいは久々に戻ってきたトレーナーなら、彼とキャロライン・フランベアンの間の、あの熱い競い合いを覚えているかもしれない。

key: For those a little fresher to scene, so the story goes...
en: For those a little fresher to scene, so the story goes...
ja: もう少し新しいトレーナーのために、話はこうだ……

key: The two Leaders met after being stationed adjacent to each other between their cities.
en: The two Leaders met after being stationed adjacent to each other between their cities.
ja: 二人のリーダーは、それぞれの街の間に隣接して配属されたことで出会った。

key: True to her type, little Caroline was as hot-headed as they come, and from the outset she resented any competition from her neighbor!
en: True to her type, little Caroline was as hot-headed as they come, and from the outset she resented any competition from her neighbor!
ja: そのタイプに違わず、幼いキャロラインは誰よりも血の気が多く、最初から隣人の存在にライバル心をむき出しにしていた!

key: After a spell of trying to outdo Monty in performance alone, she tried to prove herself by challenging him directly!
en: After a spell of trying to outdo Monty in performance alone, she tried to prove herself by challenging him directly!
ja: しばらくは成績だけでモンティを上回ろうとしていたが、やがて直接勝負を挑んで自分を証明しようとした!

key: But chalk it up to a difference in rank, the type chart, or whatever you like...
en: But chalk it up to a difference in rank, the type chart, or whatever you like...
ja: でも、順位の差なのか、タイプ相性の差なのか、あるいは何であれ……

key: No dice!
en: No dice!
ja: 結果は出なかった!

key: In a total sweep, Caroline hit the floor.
en: In a total sweep, Caroline hit the floor.
ja: 完全な敗北で、キャロラインは地に伏した。

key: But the blazing broad up and tried again,
en: But the blazing broad up and tried again,
ja: それでも、この燃え盛る女傑はもう一度挑んだ、

key: And again,
en: And again,
ja: そしてまた、

key: And again...
en: And again...
ja: またしても……

key: Months went by, and the sight of little Caroline fuming away from Monty's Gym was practically a daily ritual.
en: Months went by, and the sight of little Caroline fuming away from Monty's Gym was practically a daily ritual.
ja: 何か月も過ぎて、モンティのジムから怒り心頭で立ち去る幼いキャロラインの姿は、もはや日課のようになっていた。

key: As all good stories must, though, this came to an end when she finally scored a win, proving her hard- earned strength once and for all!
en: As all good stories must, though, this came to an end when she finally scored a win, proving her hard- earned strength once and for all!
ja: だが良い物語がそうであるように、ついに彼女が勝利を収め、苦労して積み上げた実力をようやく証明したことで、この物語には決着がついた!

key: The victory was a blessing to the regulars, tired of hearing howls of anger and annoyance each day when the Fire Type femme flew off the scene.
en: The victory was a blessing to the regulars, tired of hearing howls of anger and annoyance each day when the Fire Type femme flew off the scene.
ja: その勝利は常連客にとっても救いだった。毎日のように、ほのおタイプの姫が悔しさと苛立ちの雄たけびをあげながら去っていくのを聞かされてきたのだから。

key: ...So, you can imagine their shock and disappointment when, the next day after winning, Caroline once again showed up on Monty's doorstep anyway!
en: ...So, you can imagine their shock and disappointment when, the next day after winning, Caroline once again showed up on Monty's doorstep anyway!
ja: ……だから、勝利の翌日、キャロラインが再びモンティの家の玄関に現れたときの、彼らの驚きと落胆は想像に難くない!

key: Find us on 9th Street by Castelia. Come on in, and Spyce up your life.
en: Find us on 9th Street by Castelia. Come on in, and Spyce up your life.
ja: カステリア近くの9番街でお待ちしています。ぜひお越しいただいて、人生にスパイスを。

key: Need to spice up your roster?
en: Need to spice up your roster?
ja: 手持ちのラインナップに刺激が欲しいですか?

key: Looking for new Pokémon?
en: Looking for new Pokémon?
ja: 新しいポケモンをお探しですか?

key: Welcome to Reborn's Pokémon Watch!
en: Welcome to Reborn's Pokémon Watch!
ja: ようこそ、リボーン・ポケモンウォッチへ!

key: Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the Peridot and Opal Wards! What is there to find?
en: Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the Peridot and Opal Wards! What is there to find?
ja: 今日は、ペリドットワードとオパールワードでポケモンを探します! 何が見つかるでしょうか?

key: Well, rumour has it that sometimes a cheery blue Pokémon can be seen dancing around the fountain in North Peridot when it rains.
en: Well, rumour has it that sometimes a cheery blue Pokémon can be seen dancing around the fountain in North Peridot when it rains.
ja: そういえば、雨の日には北ペリドットの噴水のまわりで、陽気な青いポケモンが踊っているのを見かけることがあるそうです。

key: Today, we're looking at the small reserve of wildlife around the Grand Hall.
en: Today, we're looking at the small reserve of wildlife around the Grand Hall.
ja: 今日は、大ホール周辺のわずかな野生生物保護区を見ていきます。

key: Only a few species can be found here, however.
en: Only a few species can be found here, however.
ja: ただし、ここで見つかる種類はほんの数種類だけです。

key: Oh, my, is that a Combee?
en: Oh, my, is that a Combee?
ja: あら、あれはミツハニーでしょうか?

key: Where could it have come from?
en: Where could it have come from?
ja: 一体どこから来たのでしょう?

key: There certainly aren't any in the grass around here.
en: There certainly aren't any in the grass around here.
ja: この辺りの草むらには、まったく見かけないはずなのに。

key: How curious!
en: How curious!
ja: 不思議ですね!

key: This morning, we visited a secret garden.
en: This morning, we visited a secret garden.
ja: 今朝、私たちはある秘密の庭園を訪れました。

key: The owner of the garden wishes to keep himself and its location anonymous, but there were some neat Pokémon!
en: The owner of the garden wishes to keep himself and its location anonymous, but there were some neat Pokémon!
ja: 庭の持ち主は、自分自身とその場所を秘密にしておきたいそうですが、そこには素敵なポケモンたちがいました!

key: In fact, we even saw a group of Cherubi! Fascinating how such things live right under our noses..
en: In fact, we even saw a group of Cherubi! Fascinating how such things live right under our noses..
ja: 実は、チェリンボの群れまで見つけたんです! こんなものがすぐ近くで暮らしているなんて、驚きですね……

key: Unfortunately, the Cherubi had made themselves scarce by afternoon.
en: Unfortunately, the Cherubi had made themselves scarce by afternoon.
ja: 残念ながら、午後にはチェリンボの姿は見えなくなっていました。

key: Perhaps they like the morning cool?
en: Perhaps they like the morning cool?
ja: 涼しい朝の時間が好きなのかもしれませんね?

key: Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the South Obsidia, Coral and Onyx Wards!
en: Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the South Obsidia, Coral and Onyx Wards!
ja: 今日は、南オブシディア、コーラル、オニキスの各ワードでポケモンを探します!

key: Rumour has it that deep in the Obsidia Slums, there's a secret room where a certain species of beefy Pokémon hang out!
en: Rumour has it that deep in the Obsidia Slums, there's a secret room where a certain species of beefy Pokémon hang out!
ja: うわさによると、オブシディアスラムの奥深くに、たくましいポケモンの一種がたむろする秘密の部屋があるそうです!

key: Normally on this show, we only talk about wild Pokémon, but I just saw this energetic Lillipup, and can't help but talk about it!
en: Normally on this show, we only talk about wild Pokémon, but I just saw this energetic Lillipup, and can't help but talk about it!
ja: 普段このコーナーでは野生のポケモンだけを扱っていますが、この元気いっぱいのヨーテリーを見てしまったら、話さずにはいられません!

key: The feisty thing was dragging its poor Trainer all over the city!
en: The feisty thing was dragging its poor Trainer all over the city!
ja: この威勢のいい子は、かわいそうなトレーナーを街中引きずり回していました!

key: By the West Peridot Factory...
en: By the West Peridot Factory...
ja: 西ペリドット工場のそばから……

key: ...to under Opal Bridge...
en: ...to under Opal Bridge...
ja: ……オパール橋の下へ……

key: ...back up to North Peridot...
en: ...back up to North Peridot...
ja: ……そしてまた北ペリドットへ……

key: ...or in the back of the Obsidia Ward...
en: ...or in the back of the Obsidia Ward...
ja: ……オブシディアワードの裏手へ……

key: ...even down to the Coral Ward!
en: ...even down to the Coral Ward!
ja: ……ついにはコーラルワードまで!

key: Finally, they ended up in the Onyx Ward!
en: Finally, they ended up in the Onyx Ward!
ja: そして最後は、オニキスワードにたどり着きました!

key: There's no telling where that pup will go!
en: There's no telling where that pup will go!
ja: あの子犬がどこまで行くのか、誰にも分かりません!

key: Today, we were passing through the Coral Ward, down around the warehouses, and there was this awful banging.
en: Today, we were passing through the Coral Ward, down around the warehouses, and there was this awful banging.
ja: 今日、私たちはコーラルワードの倉庫街を通りかかったのですが、そこでものすごい物音がしました。

key: It almost sounded like a Pokémon was trapped inside.
en: It almost sounded like a Pokémon was trapped inside.
ja: まるでポケモンが中に閉じ込められているような音でした。

key: But I wonder what it could be?
en: But I wonder what it could be?
ja: 一体何だったのでしょう?

key: Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the Jasper and Beryl Wards!
en: Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the Jasper and Beryl Wards!
ja: 今日は、ジャスパーワードとベリルワードでポケモンを探します!

key: Actually, earlier today we came across a police officer who was looking for a certain Pokémon and had a rare Egg to offer in return!
en: Actually, earlier today we came across a police officer who was looking for a certain Pokémon and had a rare Egg to offer in return!
ja: 実は今日の早く、ある警察官が特定のポケモンを探していて、お礼に珍しいタマゴを提供すると言っていました!

key: I smell an opportunity for one generous and lucky Trainer!
en: I smell an opportunity for one generous and lucky Trainer!
ja: これは、太っ腹で運のいいトレーナーにとってのチャンスの匂いがしますね!

key: In fact, just last night we passed through the Beryl Cemetery.
en: In fact, just last night we passed through the Beryl Cemetery.
ja: 実は、昨夜私たちはベリル墓地を通り抜けました。

key: It was a terrifying experience!
en: It was a terrifying experience!
ja: 恐ろしい体験でした!

key: I was afraid that a zombie would rise up and attack me!
en: I was afraid that a zombie would rise up and attack me!
ja: ゾンビが起き上がって襲ってくるんじゃないかと怖かったです!

key: And to my fright, something did!
en: And to my fright, something did!
ja: そして恐ろしいことに、本当に何かが現れました!

key: Well, our cameraman turned tail and fled before we could catch the culprit on film, so as of yet, it is unidentified.
en: Well, our cameraman turned tail and fled before we could catch the culprit on film, so as of yet, it is unidentified.
ja: ただ、カメラマンが撮影する前に逃げ出してしまったので、その正体はまだ分かっていません。

key: But for all you brave Trainers out there, be warned that there could be something lurking...
en: But for all you brave Trainers out there, be warned that there could be something lurking...
ja: でも勇敢なトレーナーの皆さんは、何かが潜んでいるかもしれないことを覚えておいてください……

key: Ah, wait, what's this over here?!
en: Ah, wait, what's this over here?!
ja: あ、待って、こっちに何かいます?!

key: It's an Aipom! What a cutie!
en: It's an Aipom! What a cutie!
ja: エイパムです! なんてかわいいんでしょう!

key: Oh, hey, no, don't run away! Come back!
en: Oh, hey, no, don't run away! Come back!
ja: あ、ちょっと、逃げないで! 戻ってきて!

key: Ah, it scampered back up into that tree.
en: Ah, it scampered back up into that tree.
ja: あ、木の上に走って戻ってしまいました。

key: No matter, we still know that there are Aipom in this area now! What a rare find!
en: No matter, we still know that there are Aipom in this area now! What a rare find!
ja: まあいいでしょう、この辺りにエイパムがいることは分かりましたから! 貴重な発見です!

key: Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the North Obsidia and Lapis Wards!
en: Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the North Obsidia and Lapis Wards!
ja: 今日は、北オブシディアとラピスの各ワードでポケモンを探します!

key: We're chasing rumors of a rare Pokémon digging around behind the streets of Obsidia!
en: We're chasing rumors of a rare Pokémon digging around behind the streets of Obsidia!
ja: オブシディアの裏通りで穴を掘っている珍しいポケモンのうわさを追っています!

key: This howling black beast is said to be extremely elusive, but!
en: This howling black beast is said to be extremely elusive, but!
ja: この遠ぼえする黒い獣は、極めて見つけにくいと言われていますが!

key: We've been tracking it, and we think we've found--
en: We've been tracking it, and we think we've found--
ja: 私たちは追跡を続けていて、ついに見つけたと思います――

key: ???: 'Ey, you trespassin' on our territory?
en: ???: 'Ey, you trespassin' on our territory?
ja: ???: おい、うちの縄張りに勝手に入ってるのか?

key: HOST: Oh, um, hi, what? No, sir! We're just innocent news--
en: HOST: Oh, um, hi, what? No, sir! We're just innocent news--
ja: ホスト: あ、えっと、こんにちは、何でしょう? 違います、私たちはただの罪のない取材班で――

key: ???: Get outta here! Or I'll make you get out!
en: ???: Get outta here! Or I'll make you get out!
ja: ???: とっとと出てけ! さもないと、出て行かせてやるぞ!

key: HOST: Okay!
en: HOST: Okay!
ja: ホスト: 分かりました!

key: Following rumors of a rare Pokémon having been seen in the area, we've tracked it down to this location: A lavish house in the Lapis Ward.
en: Following rumors of a rare Pokémon having been seen in the area, we've tracked it down to this location: A lavish house in the Lapis Ward.
ja: この辺りで珍しいポケモンが目撃されたといううわさを追い、ある場所にたどり着きました。ラピスワードにある豪華な邸宅です。

key: Let's find out if we can meet the owner of this rare Po--
en: Let's find out if we can meet the owner of this rare Po--
ja: この珍しいポケ――の飼い主に会えるか、確かめてみましょう――

key: CRAUDBURRY: What's all that racket out there?!
en: CRAUDBURRY: What's all that racket out there?!
ja: クラウドバリー: 外で何の騒ぎですか?!

key: HOST: Ah, hello! Are you the owner of--
en: HOST: Ah, hello! Are you the owner of--
ja: ホスト: ああ、こんにちは! こちらは――

key: CRAUDBURRY: I don't need your scandalous press loitering around my house!
en: CRAUDBURRY: I don't need your scandalous press loitering around my house!
ja: クラウドバリー: あなたたちみたいなゴシップ記者に、うちの周りをうろつかれたくないんです!

key: This is MY property, and I can have you arrested for filming without consent!
en: This is MY property, and I can have you arrested for filming without consent!
ja: ここは私の私有地です、無断で撮影したら訴えることだってできますよ!

key: HOST: Miss, please calm down--
en: HOST: Miss, please calm down--
ja: ホスト: 落ち着いてください、奥様――

key: CRAUDBURRY: What's your network? I'll sue!
en: CRAUDBURRY: What's your network? I'll sue!
ja: クラウドバリー: どこの局? 訴えますからね!

key: Stand right there, I'm getting my lawyer!
en: Stand right there, I'm getting my lawyer!
ja: そこを動かないで、今すぐ弁護士を呼びますから!

key: HOST: Yikes, and after everything we couldn't find any Pokémon. Bye!
en: HOST: Yikes, and after everything we couldn't find any Pokémon. Bye!
ja: ホスト: うわ、結局ポケモンも見つからずじまいでした。それでは!

key: You will not BELIEVE what we've just seen!
en: You will not BELIEVE what we've just seen!
ja: 今見たものが、きっと信じられないと思います!

key: A legendary Pokémon, right here in Reborn!
en: A legendary Pokémon, right here in Reborn!
ja: 伝説のポケモンが、このリボーンに!

key: Before our eyes, a beautiful Mew jumped right by and vanished!
en: Before our eyes, a beautiful Mew jumped right by and vanished!
ja: 私たちの目の前を、美しいミュウが飛び跳ねて消えていきました!

key: We're on the hunt now! We know it ran this way, and-- Oh my word!
en: We're on the hunt now! We know it ran this way, and-- Oh my word!
ja: 今、追いかけています! こっちに走っていったのは分かっていて、それに――なんと!

key: That's a Victini! Two legends in one day?!
en: That's a Victini! Two legends in one day?!
ja: あれはビクティニです! 一日に伝説が二体も?!

key: What is this?!
en: What is this?!
ja: 一体どうなっているんでしょう?!

key: Quick, follow it!
en: Quick, follow it!
ja: 急いで、追ってください!

key: Aw, where did it go?
en: Aw, where did it go?
ja: あら、どこに行ったのでしょう?

key: Wait, back there! It's a--
en: Wait, back there! It's a--
ja: 待って、あっちに! あれは――

key: Darkrai?!
en: Darkrai?!
ja: ダークライ?!

key: Wait, it just transformed into... Oh!
en: Wait, it just transformed into... Oh!
ja: 待って、今何かに変身しました……あ!

key: It's a Zorua!
en: It's a Zorua!
ja: ゾロアです!

key: But it ran off...
en: But it ran off...
ja: でも逃げてしまいました……

key: Trainers, keep an eye out for this illusive catch!
en: Trainers, keep an eye out for this illusive catch!
ja: トレーナーの皆さん、この幻影のような獲物にご注目ください!

key: It could take the shape of anything!
en: It could take the shape of anything!
ja: どんな姿にも化けられるかもしれません!

key: Today, we're looking for Pokémon all over Reborn City!
en: Today, we're looking for Pokémon all over Reborn City!
ja: 今日は、リボーンシティ全域でポケモンを探します!

key: Following a beaten path off from the Beryl Cemetery, we come through a dark cave to a place somewhere deep in the Rhodochrine Jungle...
en: Following a beaten path off from the Beryl Cemetery, we come through a dark cave to a place somewhere deep in the Rhodochrine Jungle...
ja: ベリル墓地から続く人けのない小道を進むと、暗い洞窟を抜けて、ロドクラインジャングルの奥深くにたどり着きました……

key: What kind of mysterious Pokémon will we-- Aah!!!
en: What kind of mysterious Pokémon will we-- Aah!!!
ja: どんな不思議なポケモンが――きゃあ!!!

key: What? We seem to have been trapped in some sort of cage!
en: What? We seem to have been trapped in some sort of cage!
ja: え? 何かのおりに閉じ込められてしまったようです!

key: What Pokémon could have done this?!
en: What Pokémon could have done this?!
ja: 一体どんなポケモンがこんなことを?!

key: We've got a special report coming in!
en: We've got a special report coming in!
ja: 特別リポートが入りました!

key: Sean Slagle from the Peridot Ward writes to us about a strange Pokémon that appears only when it rains!
en: Sean Slagle from the Peridot Ward writes to us about a strange Pokémon that appears only when it rains!
ja: ペリドットワードのショーン・スラグルさんから、雨の日にしか現れない不思議なポケモンについて投稿がありました!

key: You might expect that this would be a Water-type!
en: You might expect that this would be a Water-type!
ja: きっとみずタイプだろうと思いますよね!

key: But no! It's actually, of all things, a Numel!
en: But no! It's actually, of all things, a Numel!
ja: ところが違います! なんと、ドンメルなんです!

key: Sean tells us that the poor Pokémon wanders out in every storm looking lost and confused.
en: Sean tells us that the poor Pokémon wanders out in every storm looking lost and confused.
ja: ショーンさんいわく、そのかわいそうなポケモンは、嵐のたびに道に迷ったような、困惑した様子でさまよっているそうです。

key: It’s obviously suffering from the rain, but the strange thing can't figure out what to do with itself!
en: It’s obviously suffering from the rain, but the strange thing can't figure out what to do with itself!
ja: どう見ても雨に苦しんでいるようですが、この不思議な子は、自分でもどうしたらいいか分からないみたいです!

key: Today we were checking out the alleys of the city when we found a certain pool.
en: Today we were checking out the alleys of the city when we found a certain pool.
ja: 今日は街の路地を調べていたところ、とある水たまりを見つけました。

key: Two surprises awaited us-- the first being that the water in this place was miraculously not contaminated.
en: Two surprises awaited us-- the first being that the water in this place was miraculously not contaminated.
ja: そこには二つの驚きが待っていました――まず、この場所の水は奇跡的に汚染されていませんでした。

key: The second being that it was teeming with dangerous Pokémon?
en: The second being that it was teeming with dangerous Pokémon?
ja: そして二つ目、そこには危険なポケモンがうようよいたんです?

key: Which?
en: Which?
ja: それはどんなポケモンかって?

key: We'll let our viewers find out themselves!
en: We'll let our viewers find out themselves!
ja: それは視聴者の皆さん自身で確かめてもらいましょう!

key: Today, we're looking for Pokémon around Apophyll Beach and Pyrous Mountain!
en: Today, we're looking for Pokémon around Apophyll Beach and Pyrous Mountain!
ja: 今日は、アポフィルビーチとパイロス山周辺でポケモンを探します!

key: We're exploring a cave far out across the beach.
en: We're exploring a cave far out across the beach.
ja: 浜辺の向こうに広がる、遠く離れた洞窟を探検しています。

key: There's no telling what could be inside!
en: There's no telling what could be inside!
ja: 中に何があるかは、誰にも分かりません!

key: Hey, what's that!
en: Hey, what's that!
ja: おっと、あれは何でしょう!

key: Moving there in the shadows!
en: Moving there in the shadows!
ja: 影の中で何かが動いています!

key: What kind of Pokémon could it be!?
en: What kind of Pokémon could it be!?
ja: 一体どんなポケモンなんでしょう!?

key: It's a--
en: It's a--
ja: それは――

key: Oh, it's just a Stunfisk.
en: Oh, it's just a Stunfisk.
ja: あ、ただのマッギョでした。

key: That's not exciting.
en: That's not exciting.
ja: それほど盛り上がる話じゃないですね。

key: Cut, cut. We'll have to look somewhere else...
en: Cut, cut. We'll have to look somewhere else...
ja: カット、カット。他の場所を探しましょう……

key: Just today we were walking down the beach, when suddenly one of the volcanic stones started shaking!
en: Just today we were walking down the beach, when suddenly one of the volcanic stones started shaking!
ja: つい今日、浜辺を歩いていたら、突然火山岩のひとつが揺れ始めました!

key: Anxious to uncover the source of this tremor, we smashed open the rock in a hurry.
en: Anxious to uncover the source of this tremor, we smashed open the rock in a hurry.
ja: この震動の正体を突き止めたくて、急いで岩を割ってみました。

key: Inside was a unique Pokémon!
en: Inside was a unique Pokémon!
ja: 中には、ユニークなポケモンが!

key: It's Shuckle!
en: It's Shuckle!
ja: ツボツボです!

key: How strange!
en: How strange!
ja: 変わってますね!

key: But it didn't seem like there would be very many. Could this be a rare find?!
en: But it didn't seem like there would be very many.  Could this be a rare find?!
ja: でも、あまりたくさんはいなさそうです。これは貴重な発見でしょうか?!

key: We've been tracking a mysterious Pokémon in the depths of Pyrous Mountain!
en: We've been tracking a mysterious Pokémon in the depths of Pyrous Mountain!
ja: パイロス山の奥深くで、謎のポケモンを追跡しています!

key: This lava-loving creature is elusive and lonesome, but after dedicated research, I think we've finally found its habits.
en: This lava-loving creature is elusive and lonesome, but after dedicated research, I think we've finally found its habits.
ja: この溶岩好きの生き物は見つけにくく、孤独を好むようですが、地道な調査の末、ついにその習性が分かってきたと思います!

key: And they're quite silly!
en: And they're quite silly!
ja: それが、かなりおかしなものでして!

key: It seems this Pokémon loves to eat molten stone and other minerals... but with the volatile lava flow in Pyrous Mountain, sometimes falls right into it!
en: It seems this Pokémon loves to eat molten stone and other minerals... but with the volatile lava flow in Pyrous Mountain, sometimes falls right into it!
ja: このポケモンは溶けた岩石やその他の鉱物を食べるのが大好きなようです……でもパイロス山の不安定な溶岩の流れのせいで、時々その中に落ちてしまうこともあるとか!

key: Thus, we wound up finding this Pokémon stuck in some other cooling magma!
en: Thus, we wound up finding this Pokémon stuck in some other cooling magma!
ja: そんなわけで、私たちはこのポケモンが、冷えかけた別の溶岩に埋まっているところを見つけました!

key: It seems this Pokémon crawls off to brood on its own in a far off, but very heated place!
en: It seems this Pokémon crawls off to brood on its own in a far off, but very heated place!
ja: どうやらこのポケモンは、はるか遠くの、それでいてとても熱い場所へはっていって、一人でふさぎ込む習性があるようです!

key: We weren't able to get our attention ourselves...
en: We weren't able to get our attention ourselves...
ja: 私たちでは近づいてもらえませんでしたが……

key: But a clever Trainer could perhaps lure it to a catch!
en: But a clever Trainer could perhaps lure it to a catch!
ja: 賢いトレーナーなら、うまくおびき寄せて捕まえられるかもしれません!

key: Today, we're looking for Pokémon around Azurine Island and the Byxbysion Wasteland!
en: Today, we're looking for Pokémon around Azurine Island and the Byxbysion Wasteland!
ja: 今日は、アズリン島とビクスビジョン荒地周辺でポケモンを探します!

key: However, horror has struck us in the Wasteland!
en: However, horror has struck us in the Wasteland!
ja: しかし、荒地で恐ろしいことが起きました!

key: After being bafflingly lost inside the hallowed halls and walls of the mountainous tundra...
en: After being bafflingly lost inside the hallowed halls and walls of the mountainous tundra...
ja: 山岳ツンドラの神聖な広間と壁の中で、わけも分からず迷ってしまい……

key: An apparition has revealed itself to us!
en: An apparition has revealed itself to us!
ja: 幽霊が私たちの前に姿を現しました!

key: Needless to say, we high-tailed it out of there, but a braver Trainer may find a prize for themselves if they dare face it!
en: Needless to say, we high-tailed it out of there, but a braver Trainer may find a prize for themselves if they dare face it!
ja: 言うまでもなく、私たちは一目散に逃げ出しましたが、勇敢なトレーナーなら、あえて立ち向かえば何かご褒美を見つけられるかもしれません!

key: This morning, we were traveling through Azurine Island, and one of our cameramen leaned on a nearby tree.
en: This morning, we were traveling through Azurine Island, and one of our cameramen leaned on a nearby tree.
ja: 今朝、私たちはアズリン島を移動中、カメラマンの一人が近くの木にもたれかかりました。

key: Imagine his surprise when a spirited Psychic-type fell out of it, right on top of his head!
en: Imagine his surprise when a spirited Psychic-type fell out of it, right on top of his head!
ja: すると驚いたことに、元気いっぱいのエスパータイプが木から落ちてきて、まさに頭の上に直撃したんです!

key: They were NOT happy!
en: They were NOT happy!
ja: 全然喜んでいませんでした!

key: Today, we were relaxing in the Wasteland-- if one can 'relax' in such a chaotic place-- when we chanced upon an adorable duo.
en: Today, we were relaxing in the Wasteland-- if one can 'relax' in such a chaotic place-- when we chanced upon an adorable duo.
ja: 今日は、荒地で――こんなこんとんとした場所で「くつろぐ」なんて言葉が使えるならですが――くつろいでいたところ、愛らしい二匹組に出くわしました。

key: Two young Nidoran were playing in the Wasteland's tunnels!
en: Two young Nidoran were playing in the Wasteland's tunnels!
ja: 荒地のトンネルで、二匹の幼いニドランが遊んでいました!

key: Not ideal scenery, but the young Pokémon were a picture-perfect pair.
en: Not ideal scenery, but the young Pokémon were a picture-perfect pair.
ja: 理想的な景色とは言えませんが、幼いポケモンたちは絵になるほどぴったりの組み合わせでした。

key: Too bad they scampered off, but there seem to be Nidoran out there waiting for a Trainer to find!
en: Too bad they scampered off, but there seem to be Nidoran out there waiting for a Trainer to find!
ja: 残念ながら逃げられてしまいましたが、この辺りにはトレーナーに見つけられるのを待っているニドランがいるようです!

key: Today, we're searching the Chrysolia Region for new Pokémon!
en: Today, we're searching the Chrysolia Region for new Pokémon!
ja: 今日は、クリソリア地方で新しいポケモンを探します!

key: This morning, we found a hidden clearing in the middle of the Chrysolia Forest!
en: This morning, we found a hidden clearing in the middle of the Chrysolia Forest!
ja: 今朝、クリソリアの森の中に隠れた空き地を見つけました!

key: Although we didn't find any Pokémon, we did find another little gem that could be useful to Trainers: A rock positively glowing with moss!
en: Although we didn't find any Pokémon, we did find another little gem that could be useful to Trainers: A rock positively glowing with moss!
ja: ポケモンは見つかりませんでしたが、トレーナーに役立ちそうな別の宝物を見つけました。こけでぼんやり光る岩です!

key: Who might find this useful, hm?
en: Who might find this useful, hm?
ja: これが役立ちそうな人、いますか?

key: Could such a Pokémon be nearby?
en: Could such a Pokémon be nearby?
ja: こんなポケモンが近くにいるのでしょうか?

key: We've unveiled quite the mystery!
en: We've unveiled quite the mystery!
ja: とんでもない謎を解き明かしました!

key: Late last night, our group stumbled upon a cave.
en: Late last night, our group stumbled upon a cave.
ja: 昨夜遅く、私たちのグループはある洞窟を見つけました。

key: The inside of the cave was very confusing, winding in circles, almost like a riddle-- but never mind that!
en: The inside of the cave was very confusing, winding in circles, almost like a riddle-- but never mind that!
ja: 洞窟の中はとても入り組んでいて、まるで謎かけのようにぐるぐる巻いていました――でも、それは置いといて!

key: Let's talk about the rare Pokémon inside!
en: Let's talk about the rare Pokémon inside!
ja: 中にいた珍しいポケモンについて話しましょう!

key: By some luck, we encountered a Smeargle!
en: By some luck, we encountered a Smeargle!
ja: 幸運にも、ドーブルに遭遇しました!

key: With its Sketch attack, it could be an invaluable tool for any breeder that can get their hands on it.
en: With its Sketch attack, it could be an invaluable tool for any breeder that can get their hands on it.
ja: その「スケッチ」という技があれば、手に入れられたブリーダーにとって、これ以上ない貴重な道具になるでしょう。

key: This evening, we're searching the shore of a surprisingly pure lake in the Chrysolia Region!
en: This evening, we're searching the shore of a surprisingly pure lake in the Chrysolia Region!
ja: 今日の夕方は、クリソリア地方にある、驚くほど澄んだ湖の岸辺を探索しています!

key: With all the pollution around the city, it's a marvel that a place like this could exist!
en: With all the pollution around the city, it's a marvel that a place like this could exist!
ja: 街のあちこちが汚染されている中で、こんな場所が存在するなんて驚きです!

key: Even more marvelous, tons of Pokémon flock to its shore, and many cute ones!
en: Even more marvelous, tons of Pokémon flock to its shore, and many cute ones!
ja: さらに驚くべきことに、たくさんのポケモンがその岸辺に集まっていて、かわいい子もたくさんいます!

key: But one cutie especially caught our eye: A little Poliwag wagging its way along the lake!
en: But one cutie especially caught our eye: A little Poliwag wagging its way along the lake!
ja: でも特に目を引いたのは、湖に沿って尻尾を振りながら歩く小さなニョロモでした!

key: Maybe some Trainer might like to add this doll to their collection!
en: Maybe some Trainer might like to add this doll to their collection!
ja: このお人形みたいな子を、コレクションに加えたいトレーナーもいるかもしれませんね!

key: Today, we're looking in the vast Aventurine Region of Reborn!
en: Today, we're looking in the vast Aventurine Region of Reborn!
ja: 今日は、リボーンの広大なアベンチュリン地方を探索します!

key: Oh! Look at that! It's a Heracross!
en: Oh! Look at that! It's a Heracross!
ja: おっと! あれを見てください! ヘラクロスです!

key: And not only that, but a Pinsir!
en: And not only that, but a Pinsir!
ja: それだけじゃありません、なんとカイロスまで!

key: The two are fighting each other!
en: The two are fighting each other!
ja: 二匹は激しく戦っています!

key: Perhaps they're after the honey on that tree!
en: Perhaps they're after the honey on that tree!
ja: きっとあの木になっているミツの取り合いですね!

key: Yet, they're locked in a fierce combat. These two Pokémon are ignoring us completely!
en: Yet, they're locked in a fierce combat. These two Pokémon are ignoring us completely!
ja: それにしても、猛烈な戦いです。二匹とも私たちのことなんて完全に無視しています!

key: I would be surprised if there were any way a Trainer could get their attention long enough to even smack them with a Poké Ball!
en: I would be surprised if there were any way a Trainer could get their attention long enough to even smack them with a Poké Ball!
ja: これでは、トレーナーがモンスターボールを投げつける隙すら見つけられないのでは、と心配になるほどです!

key: But maybe there's some way to get them alone to capture them?
en: But maybe there's some way to get them alone to capture them?
ja: でも、どうにか二匹を引き離して捕まえる方法があるかもしれません。

key: We've traveled deep into the woods and we've found a hidden cave.
en: We've traveled deep into the woods and we've found a hidden cave.
ja: 森の奥深くまで進んできたところ、隠れた洞窟を見つけました。

key: What wonders might this cave hold for us!?
en: What wonders might this cave hold for us!?
ja: この洞窟には、一体どんな驚きが待っているのでしょう!?

key: Oh, my! Ice crystals jut up from the floor to-and-fro, and in the middle-- look!
en: Oh, my! Ice crystals jut up from the floor to-and-fro, and in the middle-- look!
ja: あら、まあ! 床のあちこちから氷の結晶が突き出ています。そして真ん中を見てください――!

key: Icy mist rolls off that stone!
en: Icy mist rolls off that stone!
ja: あの石から、冷たい霧が立ちのぼっています!

key: Could it be emitting some special power?
en: Could it be emitting some special power?
ja: 何か特別な力を放っているのでしょうか?

key: I can think of at least one species who would enjoy that!
en: I can think of at least one species who would enjoy that!
ja: これを喜びそうな種族が、少なくとも一種類は思い浮かびますね!

key: We've been taking a peaceful stroll through the woods, following a lovely tune performed for us this evening.
en: We've been taking a peaceful stroll through the woods, following a lovely tune performed for us this evening.
ja: 森を平和にそぞろ歩いていたところ、今夜私たちのために奏でられたような、美しい調べが聞こえてきました。
