key: What sort of Pokémon could be such a divine singer? It must be so cute, and innocent!
en: What sort of Pokémon could be such a divine singer?  It must be so cute, and innocent!
ja: こんなに神々しい歌声のポケモンって、一体何でしょう? きっとかわいくて、むくな子に違いありません!

key: We'll leave that question for you to answer, Trainers, because this is a Pokémon that doesn't appear to us walking around on the ground!
en: We'll leave that question for you to answer, Trainers, because this is a Pokémon that doesn't appear to us walking around on the ground!
ja: この答えは、トレーナーの皆さんにお任せしましょう。だって、これは地上を歩いている姿では私たちの前に現れないポケモンなんですから!

key: Perhaps the answer is in the trees, or the sky!
en: Perhaps the answer is in the trees, or the sky!
ja: 答えは木の上か、それとも空にあるのかもしれません!

key: Today, we're searching for Pokémon around the Agate Circus and Route 2!
en: Today, we're searching for Pokémon around the Agate Circus and Route 2!
ja: 今日は、アゲートサーカスと2番道路周辺でポケモンを探します!

key: We're out on an early morning adventure to see what we can see on the peaks outside of Agate.
en: We're out on an early morning adventure to see what we can see on the peaks outside of Agate.
ja: アゲート郊外の山頂で何が見られるか、早朝から冒険に出ています。

key: Oh! Look at that! It's a whole flock of Hawlucha!
en: Oh! Look at that! It's a whole flock of Hawlucha!
ja: おっと! あれを見てください! ルチャブルの群れです!

key: These bizarre Pokémon seem to gravitate to this area in the mornings for their workout habits. Now we know!
en: These bizarre Pokémon seem to gravitate to this area in the mornings for their workout habits. Now we know!
ja: この奇妙なポケモンたちは、朝のトレーニング習慣でこの辺りに集まってくるようです。これで謎が解けましたね!

key: We're here at the Agate Circus and we were VERY surprised.
en: We're here at the Agate Circus and we were VERY surprised.
ja: 私たちは今アゲートサーカスにいるのですが、とても驚かされました。

key: We weren't promised a Pokémon as a prize, but it seems one snuck into the booth!
en: We weren't promised a Pokémon as a prize, but it seems one snuck into the booth!
ja: 景品としてポケモンがもらえるとは聞いていなかったのに、どうやら屋台にこっそり紛れ込んでいたようです!

key: Much to the game operator's surprise!
en: Much to the game operator's surprise!
ja: ゲームの担当者もすっかり驚いていました!

key: Well, he wanted to get rid of it, so we're now the proud new owners.
en: Well, he wanted to get rid of it, so we're now the proud new owners.
ja: 彼はそのポケモンを手放したかったそうで、おかげで私たちが新しい誇らしい飼い主になりました。

key: Maybe you can luck out too!
en: Maybe you can luck out too!
ja: 皆さんにも、そんな幸運が訪れるかもしれませんよ!

key: So, here's a shout-out to and signal boost for a rather enigmatic man whom we just met.
en: So, here's a shout-out to and signal boost for a rather enigmatic man whom we just met.
ja: というわけで、先ほど出会った、なんとも謎めいた男性についてお知らせします。

key: Somewhere near the Circus, this man offers a deal-- find which Pokémon to trade him in return for his rather rare Vulpix!
en: Somewhere near the Circus, this man offers a deal-- find which Pokémon to trade him in return for his rather rare Vulpix!
ja: サーカスの近くのどこかで、この男性はこんな取引を持ちかけているそうです――彼が持つ珍しいロコンと交換できるポケモンを見つけてこい、と。

key: Any interested Trainers should seek him out at once!
en: Any interested Trainers should seek him out at once!
ja: 興味のあるトレーナーは、すぐにでも彼を探してみてください!

key: Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the greater Ametrine Mountain area!
en: Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the greater Ametrine Mountain area!
ja: 今日は、アメトリン山周辺の広いエリアでポケモンを探します!

key: We're traveling through Celestinine Mountain right now, and we've got a rare Pokémon in our sights!
en: We're traveling through Celestinine Mountain right now, and we've got a rare Pokémon in our sights!
ja: 現在セレスティナイン山を移動中で、珍しいポケモンを視界にとらえました!

key: It appears to be training its strength using some of the boulders as punching bags! Impressive!
en: It appears to be training its strength using some of the boulders as punching bags! Impressive!
ja: どうやら、岩を殴って鍛錬しているようです! 見事なものですね!

key: Perhaps it might come to respect one who can prove its better?
en: Perhaps it might come to respect one who can prove its better?
ja: もしかすると、自分より強い相手には敬意を払ってくれるかもしれません?

key: We've been diving deep beneath Ametrine Mountain in search of rare Water Pokémon, and boy have we found one...
en: We've been diving deep beneath Ametrine Mountain in search of rare Water Pokémon, and boy have we found one...
ja: アメトリン山の地下深くに潜って、珍しいみずポケモンを探していたのですが、なんと見つけてしまいました……

key: Splashing about in crested pools deep below Ametrine Mountain-- would you believe it?
en: Splashing about in crested pools deep below Ametrine Mountain-- would you believe it?
ja: アメトリン山の地下深くにある、波立つ水たまりの中ではしゃいでいる――信じられますか?

key: It's a Totodile!
en: It's a Totodile!
ja: ワニノコです!

key: Good luck catching the spirited little thing though, it weaves in and out of the water as easily as Ciel Featherstone swings in the skies!
en: Good luck catching the spirited little thing though, it weaves in and out of the water as easily as Ciel Featherstone swings in the skies!
ja: とはいえ、この元気な子を捕まえるのは大変かもしれません。まるでシエル・フェザーストーンが空を舞うように、水の中を軽々とすり抜けていきますから!

key: Today we're taking an underwater exploration, where we received an anonymous tip that a certain Pokémon appears only on a certain day of the week!
en: Today we're taking an underwater exploration, where we received an anonymous tip that a certain Pokémon appears only on a certain day of the week!
ja: 今日は水中探索です。特定の曜日にしか現れないというポケモンについて、匿名のタレコミがありました!

key: ...Unfortunately, we've had no luck finding the rare Lapras yet...
en: ...Unfortunately, we've had no luck finding the rare Lapras yet...
ja: ……残念ながら、まだ珍しいラプラスを見つけられていません……

key: Is it because this hollow underground area is so big and vast?
en: Is it because this hollow underground area is so big and vast?
ja: この地下の空洞があまりに広くて大きいせいでしょうか?

key: Or did we just get the day wrong...?
en: Or did we just get the day wrong...?
ja: それとも、そもそも曜日を間違えていたのでしょうか……?

key: I could've sworn there was some historical precedent for it...
en: I could've sworn there was some historical precedent for it...
ja: たしか、何か歴史的な裏づけがあったはずなんですが……

key: Well, we can't keep the equipment submerged for too long, so it looks like we'll be signing out of this one!
en: Well, we can't keep the equipment submerged for too long, so it looks like we'll be signing out of this one!
ja: とはいえ、機材をいつまでも水中に沈めておくわけにはいきませんので、今回はここで撤収します!

key: Today, we're looking for Pokémon around the Ametrine Mountain peak area!
en: Today, we're looking for Pokémon around the Ametrine Mountain peak area!
ja: 今日は、アメトリン山の山頂周辺でポケモンを探します!

key: Instead, we've heard a very concerning story!
en: Instead, we've heard a very concerning story!
ja: 代わりに、とても気になる話を聞いてしまいました!

key: Ametrine is famous for its snow-capped peaks and frigid temperatures, and few Pokémon are able to withstand it...
en: Ametrine is famous for its snow-capped peaks and frigid temperatures, and few Pokémon are able to withstand it...
ja: アメトリンは雪をかぶった山頂と厳しい寒さで有名で、それに耐えられるポケモンはほとんどいません……

key: But according to one report, a foreign Pokémon has been abandoned among the icy peaks!
en: But according to one report, a foreign Pokémon has been abandoned among the icy peaks!
ja: でも、ある報告によると、この氷の山頂に見慣れないポケモンが置き去りにされているそうです!

key: Will this Pokémon be okay?
en: Will this Pokémon be okay?
ja: このポケモンは無事なのでしょうか?

key: Trainers in the area, keep a lookout for any defenseless Pokémon that may have been abandoned, and make sure to keep them safe!
en: Trainers in the area, keep a lookout for any defenseless Pokémon that may have been abandoned, and make sure to keep them safe!
ja: この辺りのトレーナーの皆さん、無防備なまま置き去りにされたポケモンがいないか気をつけて、見つけたら安全を確保してあげてください!

key: We were passing by a large building in Ametrine City this evening and were surprised to discover something rare!
en: We were passing by a large building in Ametrine City this evening and were surprised to discover something rare!
ja: 今夜、アメトリンシティの大きな建物のそばを通りかかったとき、珍しいものを見つけて驚きました!

key: An Old Amber was just laying half-buried in the snow in front of us!
en: An Old Amber was just laying half-buried in the snow in front of us!
ja: 目の前の雪の中に、ひみつのコハクが半分埋まっていたんです!

key: Unfortunately, a child came and claimed the item as 'his treasure' that he had dropped.
en: Unfortunately, a child came and claimed the item as 'his treasure' that he had dropped.
ja: 残念ながら、そこへ子どもがやってきて、自分が落とした「宝物」だと言って持ち去ってしまいました。

key: But could there be more Old Amber somewhere here?
en: But could there be more Old Amber somewhere here?
ja: でも、この辺りにはまだ他にもひみつのコハクが埋まっているかもしれません。

key: As you might know, Ametrine City is somewhat renowned for its technological prowess.
en: As you might know, Ametrine City is somewhat renowned for its technological prowess.
ja: ご存じの方もいるかもしれませんが、アメトリンシティはその技術力の高さで、ちょっとした有名どころです。

key: One of the few industries that can be maintained in such climate.
en: One of the few industries that can be maintained in such climate.
ja: この気候の中でも成り立つ数少ない産業のひとつなんです。

key: Occasionally, in sorting through the computers, you find some strange things!
en: Occasionally, in sorting through the computers, you find some strange things!
ja: コンピューターを整理していると、時々奇妙なものが見つかります!

key: Today we've found a machine that can actually alter the form of a specific Pokémon!
en: Today we've found a machine that can actually alter the form of a specific Pokémon!
ja: 今日は、特定のポケモンの姿を実際に変えられる機械を見つけました!

key: It requires a Data Chip to work, but if you have one, you can freely use it at any time!
en: It requires a Data Chip to work, but if you have one, you can freely use it at any time!
ja: 動かすにはデータチップが必要ですが、持っていればいつでも自由に使えます!

key: Today, we're back in Reborn City, peeping the Pokémon that are once again popping up all around the region!
en: Today, we're back in Reborn City, peeping the Pokémon that are once again popping up all around the region!
ja: 今日はリボーンシティに戻ってきて、この地方に再び姿を見せるようになったポケモンたちを見て回っています!

key: And let me tell you, Trainers, I've already had my Sawks Knocked Off by the sheer volume and strength that resurfacing wildlife has been showing.
en: And let me tell you, Trainers, I've already had my Sawks Knocked Off by the sheer volume and strength that resurfacing wildlife has been showing.
ja: 言っておきますが、トレーナーの皆さん、戻ってきた野生生物の量と強さには、私もすっかり度肝を抜かれました。

key: Just the other night, we were traveling in the Jasper Ward and we came across-- you won't believe it--
en: Just the other night, we were traveling in the Jasper Ward and we came across-- you won't believe it--
ja: つい先日の夜、ジャスパーワードを移動していたときのことです。信じられないかもしれませんが――

key: A huge, fully evolved Ampharos, nightlight tail-wagging like a pendulum as it lumbered around the quiet city streets.
en: A huge, fully evolved Ampharos, nightlight tail-wagging like a pendulum as it lumbered around the quiet city streets.
ja: 完全に進化しきった巨大なデンリュウが、静かな街並みをのっしのっしと歩き回りながら、光る尻尾を振り子のように揺らしていたんです。

key: Seeing something so peaceful return to this city after so long was a truly sublime experience.
en: Seeing something so peaceful return to this city after so long was a truly sublime experience.
ja: こんなに穏やかな光景が、長い時を経てこの街に戻ってきたのを見るのは、本当に胸を打つ体験でした。

key: Not only that, but reports of such powerful Pokémon peacefully returning to the area have been pouring in recently.
en: Not only that, but reports of such powerful Pokémon peacefully returning to the area have been pouring in recently.
ja: それだけではなく、こうした力強いポケモンたちが穏やかに戻ってきているという報告が、最近続々と届いています。

key: Once upon a time, it was thought that the wildlife had fled the tainted Reborn City.
en: Once upon a time, it was thought that the wildlife had fled the tainted Reborn City.
ja: かつては、野生生物は汚染されたリボーンシティから逃げ出してしまったと考えられていました。

key: It turns out, it was just waiting until the day it could return.
en: It turns out, it was just waiting until the day it could return.
ja: でも実際は、ただ戻ってこられる日を待っていただけだったのです。

key: Here on Reborn's Pokémon Watch, we've been dipping our toes and our lures into a newly purified Azurine Lake.
en: Here on Reborn's Pokémon Watch, we've been dipping our toes and our lures into a newly purified Azurine Lake.
ja: リボーン・ポケモンウォッチでは、新しく浄化されたアズリン湖に、足先と釣り糸を浸してきました。

key: Reborn's Water Treatment Center seems to have bounced back with an unexpected vigor,
en: Reborn's Water Treatment Center seems to have bounced back with an unexpected vigor,
ja: リボーンの水質浄化センターは、予想外の勢いで復活を遂げたようです。

key: Working overtime to clear out every bit of muck from the once-sullied waterland.
en: Working overtime to clear out every bit of muck from the once-sullied waterland.
ja: かつて汚れきっていた水域から、あらゆる汚れを取り除くために、休みなく作業を続けています。

key: Meanwhile, the Pokémon have responded in kind.
en: Meanwhile, the Pokémon have responded in kind.
ja: そしてそれに応えるように、ポケモンたちも戻ってきています。

key: How they survived the toxic onslaught of pollution past may remain a mystery to us humans for all time,
en: How they survived the toxic onslaught of pollution past may remain a mystery to us humans for all time,
ja: かつての有毒な汚染の猛威をどうやって生き延びたのか、それは私たち人間にとって永遠の謎のままかもしれません。

key: But there's no denying the numerous species fishers are rejoicing to see in their lake once again.
en: But there's no denying the numerous species fishers are rejoicing to see in their lake once again.
ja: でも、釣り人たちが再びこの湖でたくさんの種を見られるようになって喜んでいるのは、紛れもない事実です。

key: Just this morning, one of our crewmen fished up a whole Eelektrik!
en: Just this morning, one of our crewmen fished up a whole Eelektrik!
ja: 今朝、私たちのクルーの一人が、なんとシビビールを丸ごと釣り上げました!

key: We would've loved to show you the footage, but unfortunately the Pokémon's Electric attack fried our video feed.
en: We would've loved to show you the footage, but unfortunately the Pokémon's Electric attack fried our video feed.
ja: 映像をお見せしたかったのですが、残念ながらそのポケモンのでんき技のせいで、カメラの映像が焼き切れてしまいました。

key: Still, there's definitely more out there in the depths than we could have possibly expected.
en: Still, there's definitely more out there in the depths than we could have possibly expected.
ja: それでも、この湖の底には、私たちの想像をはるかに超えるものが、まだまだ潜んでいるようです。

key: We've been chasing a rare specimen through the sewers under the city!
en: We've been chasing a rare specimen through the sewers under the city!
ja: 街の地下にある下水道で、珍しい個体を追いかけてきました!

key: When exploring the recently reactivated Water Treatment Center for any signs of life, we came across none other than the ultra-rare Goomy!
en: When exploring the recently reactivated Water Treatment Center for any signs of life, we came across none other than the ultra-rare Goomy!
ja: 最近再稼働した水質浄化センターを探索して生き物の気配を探していたところ、なんと超レアなヌメラに出くわしました!

key: Of course, when pursuing it, the Pokémon hopped into one of the pipes and slid its way out of grasp into a back room.
en: Of course, when pursuing it, the Pokémon hopped into one of the pipes and slid its way out of grasp into a back room.
ja: もちろん、追いかけようとしたところ、そのポケモンはパイプのひとつに飛び込み、するりと奥の部屋へ逃げていってしまいました。

key: Perhaps some other Trainer will be able to plunge this purple Pokémon from the pipeline,
en: Perhaps some other Trainer will be able to plunge this purple Pokémon from the pipeline,
ja: この紫色のポケモンを配管から引きずり出せる、他のトレーナーがいるかもしれません。

key: But we here are hunters, not plumbers.
en: But we here are hunters, not plumbers.
ja: でも、私たちはハンターであって、配管工ではないので。

key: And it still smells down there.
en: And it still smells down there.
ja: それに、あそこは今もまだ臭います。

key: Bad.
en: Bad.
ja: ひどく。

key: We're out in full force in the Tourmaline Desert and its surrounding areas today!
en: We're out in full force in the Tourmaline Desert and its surrounding areas today!
ja: 今日は、トルマリン砂漠とその周辺を全力で探索しています!

key: The desert itself is, as many would expect, considerably empty--
en: The desert itself is, as many would expect, considerably empty--
ja: 砂漠そのものは、皆さんの予想どおり、かなり閑散としています――

key: But for Trainers willing to venture off the beaten path, who knows what may be in store for them?
en: But for Trainers willing to venture off the beaten path, who knows what may be in store for them?
ja: でも、あえて人の通らない道に踏み込む覚悟のあるトレーナーには、何が待っているか分かりません。

key: We've been searching for a while now and have come to a very strange place indeed where the sky is--
en: We've been searching for a while now and have come to a very strange place indeed where the sky is--
ja: しばらく探し続けて、とても奇妙な場所にたどり着きました。空が――

key: What?!
en: What?!

key: Are you okay!?
en: Are you okay!?
ja: 大丈夫ですか?!

key: Hey! Hey, answer me!
en: Hey! Hey, answer me!
ja: ちょっと! ねえ、返事をして!

key: One second--
en: One second--
ja: ちょっと待って――

key: Sorry, viewers, for the distorted footage!
en: Sorry, viewers, for the distorted footage!
ja: 視聴者の皆さん、映像が乱れてしまってすみません!

key: As our cameraman was filming, something just fell out of the tree above him and knocked him clean out!
en: As our cameraman was filming, something just fell out of the tree above him and knocked him clean out!
ja: カメラマンが撮影していたところ、上の木から何かが落ちてきて、彼に直撃してしまったんです!

key: Hold on, let me--
en: Hold on, let me--
ja: 待ってください、ちょっと――

key: Gosh, how does he carry this thing everywhere--
en: Gosh, how does he carry this thing everywhere--
ja: まったく、こんなものをどうやって持ち運んでいたんでしょうね――

key: There! You can see it!
en: There! You can see it!
ja: ほら! 見てください!

key: It's a Ferroseed!
en: It's a Ferroseed!
ja: テッシードです!

key: Who knew that a Pokémon like that would be hiding in a tree here of all places!
en: Who knew that a Pokémon like that would be hiding in a tree here of all places!
ja: まさか、こんな場所の木の中にこんなポケモンが隠れていたなんて!

key: Okay, anyway, our crewman needs medical attention, so we'll be going now!
en: Okay, anyway, our crewman needs medical attention, so we'll be going now!
ja: とにかく、クルーの一人が手当てを受けないといけないので、今日はここで失礼します!

key: For instance, we may have just made the discovery of our careers!
en: For instance, we may have just made the discovery of our careers!
ja: たとえば、私たちのキャリアの中でも最大の発見をしたかもしれません。

key: We're here among the sands right now, and we've discovered, in our very own Reborn Region--
en: We're here among the sands right now, and we've discovered, in our very own Reborn Region--
ja: 今、私たちは砂の中にいるのですが、なんと、このリボーン地方の中で発見してしまいました――

key: Real--
en: Real--
ja: 本物の――

key: Live!
en: Live!
ja: 生きた――

key: Legendary Pokémon!
en: Legendary Pokémon!
ja: 伝説のポケモンを!

key: In fact, this place is teeming with them!
en: In fact, this place is teeming with them!
ja: それどころか、この場所はそんなポケモンでいっぱいなんです!

key: Yet, say, how did we get here anyway...
en: Yet, say, how did we get here anyway...
ja: それにしても、私たちはどうやってここに来たんでしょう……

key: We passed this very spot several times before and there was nothing here before--
en: We passed this very spot several times before and there was nothing here before--
ja: 以前も何度かこの場所を通ったはずなのに、そのときは何もなかったのに――

key: But now the water is clear and this little thing is just adorable--
en: But now the water is clear and this little thing is just adorable--
ja: でも今は水が澄んでいて、この小さな子はとにかくかわいくて――

key: Say, if we couldn't see it before, maybe it chose us?
en: Say, if we couldn't see it before, maybe it chose us?
ja: そういえば、以前は見えなかったのなら、もしかしてこの子の方から私たちを選んでくれたのでしょうか?

key: In that case, perhaps it's disrespectful to broadcast it...
en: In that case, perhaps it's disrespectful to broadcast it...
ja: だとしたら、これを放送するのは失礼にあたるかもしれません……

key: Mmm... Sorry, Trainers, it seems this isn't a place you'll be able to get to normally!
en: Mmm... Sorry, Trainers, it seems this isn't a place you'll be able to get to normally!
ja: うーん……すみません、トレーナーの皆さん、どうやらここは普通の方法ではたどり着けない場所のようです!

key: Even so--
en: Even so--
ja: それでも――

key: In fact, just last night we were camping up on Teknite Ridge, a span of mountains that towers over Tourmaline!
en: In fact, just last night we were camping up on Teknite Ridge, a span of mountains that towers over Tourmaline!
ja: 実は昨夜、トルマリンの上にそびえるテクナイト尾根でキャンプをしていました!

key: What we saw was beyond stunning!
en: What we saw was beyond stunning!
ja: そこで見たものは、驚き以上のものでした!

key: I was woken up by my partner as he was filming the most marvelous meteor shower I'd ever seen!
en: I was woken up by my partner as he was filming the most marvelous meteor shower I'd ever seen!
ja: 相棒に起こされて目を覚ますと、彼が今まで見た中で一番見事な流星群を撮影していたんです!

key: We watched from the safety of a cave as sparkling stars dotting the skies fell and crashed into the peaks around us--
en: We watched from the safety of a cave as sparkling stars dotting the skies fell and crashed into the peaks around us--
ja: 私たちは洞窟の中から安全に見守っていました。きらめく星々が空を彩りながら降り注ぎ、周りの山々に落ちていく様子を――

key: But imagine our surprise when we found that those lights weren't meteors at all-- but Pokémon!
en: But imagine our surprise when we found that those lights weren't meteors at all-- but Pokémon!
ja: でも驚いたことに、その光は流れ星なんかじゃなくて――ポケモンだったんです!

key: That's right, it's Minior, come down from the heavens to say hello!
en: That's right, it's Minior, come down from the heavens to say hello!
ja: そうです、メテノです。天から降りてきて、私たちに挨拶してくれました!

key: Judging by the craters all over the ground, this may be a common location for them anyway!
en: Judging by the craters all over the ground, this may be a common location for them anyway!
ja: 地面のあちこちにクレーターがあるところを見ると、この場所はもともとよく落ちてくる場所なのかもしれません!

key: And yet, by morning they had all gone already.
en: And yet, by morning they had all gone already.
ja: それなのに、朝になるころには、もう全員いなくなっていました。

key: Still, now you know-- Teknite Ridge is a place worth visiting at night if you want a Pokémon like this!
en: Still, now you know-- Teknite Ridge is a place worth visiting at night if you want a Pokémon like this!
ja: それでも、これで分かりましたね――こういうポケモンが欲しいなら、テクナイト尾根は夜に訪れる価値がある場所です!

key: Today we're exploring the northeast area of the Carnelia Region around Route 4 and Agate City!
en: Today we're exploring the northeast area of the Carnelia Region around Route 4 and Agate City!
ja: 今日は、カルネリア地方北東部、4番道路とアゲートシティ周辺を探索します!

key: What kind of Pokémon might live up here? Let's see what we can see!
en: What kind of Pokémon might live up here? Let's see what we can see!
ja: この辺りにはどんなポケモンが住んでいるのでしょう? 見てみましょう!

key: And sure enough, there's certainly something worth seeing up here already...
en: And sure enough, there's certainly something worth seeing up here already...
ja: そして案の定、ここにはすでに見る価値のあるものがありました……

key: It's a Scyther!
en: It's a Scyther!
ja: ストライクです!

key: This much sought-after Pokémon appears to appear only rarely up here, but rest assured, the beauty is alive and well!
en: This much sought-after Pokémon appears to appear only rarely up here, but rest assured, the beauty is alive and well!
ja: この人気の高いポケモンは、ここではめったに姿を現さないようですが、ご安心を、その美しさは健在です!

key: That Scyther in particular has flown the coop, but it appears to be taking off for greener pastures...
en: That Scyther in particular has flown the coop, but it appears to be taking off for greener pastures...
ja: 特にあのストライクは飛び去ってしまいましたが、どうやらもっと過ごしやすい場所を求めているようですね……

key: Perhaps they prefer a warmer environment after all?
en: Perhaps they prefer a warmer environment after all?
ja: 結局のところ、暖かい環境の方が好みなのかもしれません?

key: We were traversing down the route here... And don't you know, all of these cliffs and waterfalls make for a bumpy adventure!
en: We were traversing down the route here... And don't you know, all of these cliffs and waterfalls make for a bumpy adventure!
ja: この道を進んでいたのですが……ご存じのとおり、この崖と滝続きのせいで、なかなか波乱含みの冒険になっています!

key: Unfortunately we had a little accident, and half of our equipment ended up washing downstream!
en: Unfortunately we had a little accident, and half of our equipment ended up washing downstream!
ja: 残念ながらちょっとした事故があり、機材の半分が川に流されてしまいました!

key: But we are well and safe and the other half has gotten some better work for it-- look there!
en: But we are well and safe and the other half has gotten some better work for it-- look there!
ja: でも私たちは無事ですし、残りの半分にはむしろ良い仕事をしてもらいました――見てください、あそこ!

key: Our little detour has led us straight into the heart of a nest of Snivy!
en: Our little detour has led us straight into the heart of a nest of Snivy!
ja: この寄り道のおかげで、まさにツタージャの巣のど真ん中にたどり着きました!

key: Oh, and there's a Serperior too!
en: Oh, and there's a Serperior too!
ja: それに、ジャローダまでいます!

key: Who knew what going off the beaten path could find!
en: Who knew what going off the beaten path could find!
ja: 人の通らない道に外れると、何が見つかるか分かりませんね!

key: Sometimes all you need is a little spill!
en: Sometimes all you need is a little spill!
ja: 時には、ちょっとした失敗こそが必要なんです!

key: I gotta tell you guys, we just had the fright of our lives!
en: I gotta tell you guys, we just had the fright of our lives!
ja: 皆さん、聞いてください、たった今、人生で一番の恐怖を味わいました!

key: We came upon an abandoned building out here in the frosted hills, and so we thought we'd have a look inside to see if there were any Pokémon...
en: We came upon an abandoned building out here in the frosted hills, and so we thought we'd have a look inside to see if there were any Pokémon...
ja: この霜に覆われた丘で、廃虚になった建物を見つけたので、中にポケモンがいないか見てみようと思ったのですが……

key: That's not a question we can answer because we ended up turning tail and running for our hides after being accosted by a machine!
en: That's not a question we can answer because we ended up turning tail and running for our hides after being accosted by a machine!
ja: それには答えられません。だって、機械に襲われて、命からがら逃げ出すことになったんですから!

key: This red-eyed machine seemed determined to put down anyone for just a little provocation, but could there be something behind it?
en: This red-eyed machine seemed determined to put down anyone for just a little provocation, but could there be something behind it?
ja: この赤い目の機械は、ちょっとした挑発だけで誰でもたたきのめそうとしているようでしたが、その裏に何かあるのでしょうか?

key: We tripped the power cable and shut it in as we left, so maybe there's no telling--
en: We tripped the power cable and shut it in as we left, so maybe there's no telling--
ja: 逃げる際に電源ケーブルを引っかけて閉じ込めてしまったので、真相は分からずじまいかもしれません――

key: But for the brave, who knows what might be in store?!
en: But for the brave, who knows what might be in store?!
ja: でも、勇気あるトレーナーになら、何が待っているか分かりませんよ?!

key: Happy hunting, Trainers! And may the RNG be ever in your favor!
en: Happy hunting, Trainers! And may the RNG be ever in your favor!
ja: 狩りを楽しんでください、トレーナーの皆さん! そして、乱数があなたに味方しますように!

key: And now our local forecast for Reborn City!
en: And now our local forecast for Reborn City!
ja: では、リボーンシティの現地天気予報です!

key: Coming out of the dry spell we've just had, we can expect these high temperatures to finish out in the next day or two.
en: Coming out of the dry spell we've just had, we can expect these high temperatures to finish out in the next day or two.
ja: 続いていた乾燥した日々を抜けて、この高い気温はこれから1、2日で落ち着く見込みです。

key: The scattered showers we've been seeing recently will be fading out over the next day or so.
en: The scattered showers we've been seeing recently will be fading out over the next day or so.
ja: 最近見られていたにわか雨は、今後1日ほどで収まっていくでしょう。

key: The high winds and showers we've had over the last few days will be winding down soon.
en: The high winds and showers we've had over the last few days will be winding down soon.
ja: ここ数日続いていた強風とにわか雨は、まもなく弱まっていく見込みです。

key: Expect this rainstorm to fall off shortly, as easterly winds carry new horizons to us.
en: Expect this rainstorm to fall off shortly, as easterly winds carry new horizons to us.
ja: この雨はまもなくやみ、東寄りの風が新しい空模様を運んでくるでしょう。

key: We've finally got some weather coming in for us over the next few days!
en: We've finally got some weather coming in for us over the next few days!
ja: ここ数日、ようやく天候の変化が見られそうです!

key: This blizzard may finally be letting up over the next few days!
en: This blizzard may finally be letting up over the next few days!
ja: このふぶきも、ここ数日でようやく落ち着いてくるかもしれません!

key: This sun has provided a respite from the rocky weather lately, but that may not continue to be the case.
en: This sun has provided a respite from the rocky weather lately, but that may not continue to be the case.
ja: この晴天が荒れ模様の天気からの一息をくれていますが、この先も続くとは限りません。

key: Hot weather is following, with high winds and temperatures alike.
en: Hot weather is following, with high winds and temperatures alike.
ja: このあとは暑い日が続き、強風と高い気温を伴うでしょう。

key: Scattered showers should be rolling in over the next few days.
en: Scattered showers should be rolling in over the next few days.
ja: 今後数日はにわか雨が続く見込みです。

key: However, count on high winds and mild rain storms filling in in the next few days.
en: However, count on high winds and mild rain storms filling in in the next few days.
ja: ただし、今後数日は強風と弱い雨が入り込んでくるでしょう。

key: But, cold weather is rolling in for us, with temperatures staying low for the next few days.
en: But, cold weather is rolling in for us, with temperatures staying low for the next few days.
ja: 一方、寒気が入り込んできており、今後数日は低い気温が続きます。

key: But, cold weather is rolling in for us, with light snowstorms and rain over the next few days.
en: But, cold weather is rolling in for us, with light snowstorms and rain over the next few days.
ja: 一方、寒気が入り込んできており、今後数日は小雪や雨が続くでしょう。

key: Nonetheless, clear weather is predicted to follow this bout, so look forward to the next few days!
en: Nonetheless, clear weather is predicted to follow this bout, so look forward to the next few days!
ja: とはいえ、この後は晴天が続く見込みです。この先数日、楽しみにしていてください!

key: Not all will stay well though, as a blizzard seems to be headed straight for Reborn City!
en: Not all will stay well though, as a blizzard seems to be headed straight for Reborn City!
ja: ただし、すべてが順調というわけではなく、ふぶきがリボーンシティに向かってまっすぐ進んでいるようです!

key: We will be seeing some varied weather therefollowing though, so stay tuned!
en: We will be seeing some varied weather therefollowing though, so stay tuned!
ja: この後、変わりやすい天気が続く見込みです。続報にご期待ください!

key: We will be leading in with some light snow and erratic weather therefollowing, so stay tuned!
en: We will be leading in with some light snow and erratic weather therefollowing, so stay tuned!
ja: 弱い雪から始まり、その後は不安定な天気が続く見込みです。続報にご期待ください!

key: We'll have updates for you over the next few days.
en: We'll have updates for you over the next few days.
ja: 今後数日の情報は随時お伝えします。

key: We'll be seeing a spike in temperature over the next few days with clear skies, high winds, and more sun than you can shake a Solar Beam at.
en: We'll be seeing a spike in temperature over the next few days with clear skies, high winds, and more sun than you can shake a Solar Beam at.
ja: 今後数日は気温が急上昇し、晴天、強風、そしてソーラービームもかすむほどの日差しが続くでしょう。

key: We'll be kicking off with light rainstorms all across the city.
en: We'll be kicking off with light rainstorms all across the city.
ja: 街全体で弱い雨から始まる見込みです。

key: Don't fret though, because those storms will soon give way to clear skies and sunny days!
en: Don't fret though, because those storms will soon give way to clear skies and sunny days!
ja: でも心配はいりません、その雨もまもなく晴れ間と晴天の日々に取って代わられるでしょう!

key: Temperatures are dropping over the next few days as we come to the intersection between rainy and gusty.
en: Temperatures are dropping over the next few days as we come to the intersection between rainy and gusty.
ja: 今後数日は気温が下がり、雨模様と強風の境目に差しかかります。

key: Expect scattered showers on and off throughout the next few days!
en: Expect scattered showers on and off throughout the next few days!
ja: 今後数日は、にわか雨が降ったりやんだりを繰り返す見込みです!

key: Over the next few days, we could be seeing an entourage of rain!
en: Over the next few days, we could be seeing an entourage of rain!
ja: 今後数日は、雨続きになるかもしれません!

key: The incoming storm is expected to last just a few days, so grab those umbrellas and buckle in!
en: The incoming storm is expected to last just a few days, so grab those umbrellas and buckle in!
ja: 近づいている嵐は数日ほどで収まる見込みです。傘を用意して、しっかり備えてください!

key: Reborn is seeing some snowfall right now, but this dusting is not going to last through the week.
en: Reborn is seeing some snowfall right now, but this dusting is not going to last through the week.
ja: リボーンでは現在降雪が見られますが、この程度の積雪は今週いっぱいは続かないでしょう。

key: Temperatures will begin to rise over the next few days, with snow turning into rain. Nonetheless, this downpour shows no signs of stopping!
en: Temperatures will begin to rise over the next few days, with snow turning into rain. Nonetheless, this downpour shows no signs of stopping!
ja: 今後数日で気温が上昇し始め、雪は雨に変わっていくでしょう。とはいえ、この大雨がやむ気配はまだありません!

key: Temperatures are at a record low right now, but the skies are clear, so if you plan on heading out, make sure to bundle up!
en: Temperatures are at a record low right now, but the skies are clear, so if you plan on heading out, make sure to bundle up!
ja: 現在、気温は記録的な低さですが、空は晴れています。お出かけの予定がある方は、しっかり防寒してください!

key: There's no time like snow time in Reborn City! With how much it's coming down, you'd think we were in Ametrine!
en: There's no time like snow time in Reborn City! With how much it's coming down, you'd think we were in Ametrine!
ja: リボーンシティに、まさに雪の季節がやってきました! この降り方だと、まるでアメトリンにいるみたいですね!

key: Though accumulation is negligible, this blizzard is expected to last consistently throughout the next few days.
en: Though accumulation is negligible, this blizzard is expected to last consistently throughout the next few days.
ja: 積雪量はわずかですが、このふぶきは今後数日、一定して続く見込みです。

key: Easterly winds will be coming in over the next few days, bringing rain with them!
en: Easterly winds will be coming in over the next few days, bringing rain with them!
ja: 今後数日は東寄りの風が入り込み、雨をもたらすでしょう!

key: The storm is not expected to last, however, and we should be back to sunny days in no time at all.
en: The storm is not expected to last, however, and we should be back to sunny days in no time at all.
ja: ただし、この嵐は長続きしないと見られ、まもなく晴天が戻ってくるでしょう。

key: Light snowstorms start us off this week, with high winds coming in, followed by scattered showers.
en: Light snowstorms start us off this week, with high winds coming in, followed by scattered showers.
ja: 今週は弱い雪から始まり、その後強風が入り込み、にわか雨が続く見込みです。

key: There is a silver lining after this tumultuous weather though: expect sunny days coming up just around the corner.
en: There is a silver lining after this tumultuous weather though: expect sunny days coming up just around the corner.
ja: この荒れた天気の後には、希望の光もあります。もうすぐそこまで晴天が近づいています。

key: Stay warm and keep on, Reborn City!
en: Stay warm and keep on, Reborn City!
ja: 暖かくして、頑張ってください、リボーンシティ!

key: Keep cool and carry on, Reborn City!
en: Keep cool and carry on, Reborn City!
ja: 涼しくして、頑張ってください、リボーンシティ!

key: The Powder spoiled from being shaken on the unstable rock!
en: The Powder spoiled from being shaken on the unstable rock!
ja: 不安定な岩を揺らしたことで、粉薬がだめになってしまった!

key: AYA: I know I'm not good for very much, but I'd appreciate if you didn't use me as a meat-shield.
en: AYA: I know I'm not good for very much, but I'd appreciate if you didn't use me as a meat-shield.
ja: アヤ: あたし、あんまり役に立たないのは分かってるけど、盾代わりに使うのはやめてほしいな。

key: AYA: The others will be okay, right?
en: AYA: The others will be okay, right?
ja: アヤ: みんな、大丈夫だよね?

key: Uh, don't tell them that I asked.
en: Uh, don't tell them that I asked.
ja: あ、あたしが聞いてたって言わないで。

key: AYA: It'll be a straight shot, they said.
en: AYA: It'll be a straight shot, they said.
ja: アヤ: 一直線だって、そう言ってたよね。

key: It's right around the corner, they said.
en: It's right around the corner, they said.
ja: すぐそこの角だって、そう言ってたし。

key: AYA: Hey.
en: AYA: Hey.
ja: アヤ: ねえ。

key: Uh, thanks for putting up with me.
en: Uh, thanks for putting up with me.
ja: あの、我慢してくれてありがと。

key: Don't get the wrong idea! I just felt like it was the thing to say.
en: Don't get the wrong idea! I just felt like it was the thing to say.
ja: 別に変な意味じゃないから! ただ、言うべきかなって思っただけ。

key: And now for this week's forecast for Reborn City!
en: And now for this week's forecast for Reborn City!
ja: そして、今週のリボーンシティの天気予報です!

key: We've got clear skies over the weekend, but we're looking at high temperatures on Tuesday.
en: We've got clear skies over the weekend, but we're looking at high temperatures on Tuesday.
ja: 週末は晴天が続きますが、火曜日は気温が上昇する見込みです。

key: Fortunately, this won't last long as strong winds on Wednesday are going to blow in a storm system which will take hold for a couple days.
en: Fortunately, this won't last long as strong winds on Wednesday are going to blow in a storm system which will take hold for a couple days.
ja: とはいえ、水曜日の強風が嵐を運んでくるため、これは長くは続きません。この嵐は数日ほど居座るでしょう。

key: We've got a storm system hitting us mid-week. Clearing up a couple days later, we risk intense sun mid-day Saturday, but that'll clear out from Sunday's high winds!
en: We've got a storm system hitting us mid-week. Clearing up a couple days later, we risk intense sun mid-day Saturday, but that'll clear out from Sunday's high winds!
ja: 週の半ばに嵐が上陸します。数日後には晴れますが、土曜日の昼ごろには強い日差しの危険があります。ただ、日曜日の強風でそれも吹き払われるでしょう!

key: We're in for a rainy week! Starting Wednesday, we're looking at a huge storm system coming in. Thunderstorms Thursday and lingering showers until strong winds clear it out for us on Saturday.
en: We're in for a rainy week! Starting Wednesday, we're looking at a huge storm system coming in. Thunderstorms Thursday and lingering showers until strong winds clear it out for us on Saturday.
ja: 雨がちな一週間になりそうです! 水曜日から大きな嵐がやってきます。木曜日は雷雨、その後もにわか雨が続き、土曜日の強風でようやく吹き払われるでしょう。

key: This week is gonna be hot, hot, hot! We've got clearskies all week, but that stagnant air in the city is likely to weaken the local atmosphere resulting in spiking temperatures in the city over the weekend! Fortunately we expect some high winds on Sunday to come in and clean out the air, so we should be back to normal afterwards.
en: This week is gonna be hot, hot, hot! We've got clearskies all week, but that stagnant air in the city is likely to weaken the local atmosphere resulting in spiking temperatures in the city over the weekend! Fortunately we expect some high winds on Sunday to come in and clean out the air, so we should be back to normal afterwards.
ja: 今週は暑い、暑い、暑い一週間になります! 一週間ずっと晴天が続きますが、街に停滞するその空気のせいで、週末にかけて気温が急上昇する見込みです。幸い、日曜日には強風が入り込んで空気を入れ替えてくれるので、その後は平常に戻るでしょう。

key: Scattered showers this week! Look out for slight rainstorms on Monday and Friday, as well as high winds on Tuesday!
en: Scattered showers this week! Look out for slight rainstorms on Monday and Friday, as well as high winds on Tuesday!
ja: 今週はにわか雨に注意です! 月曜日と金曜日には軽い嵐、火曜日には強風が予想されます!

key: We're looking at a pretty clear week here in Reborn! We've got high winds on Monday and Thursday, but otherwise this is an ideally calm week!
en: We're looking at a pretty clear week here in Reborn! We've got high winds on Monday and Thursday, but otherwise this is an ideally calm week!
ja: リボーンは今週、かなり晴れ間の多い一週間になりそうです! 月曜日と木曜日は強風が吹きますが、それ以外はとても穏やかな一週間です!

key: We've got quite the system coming our way! Clear skies Friday and Saturday, but some pretty intense heat coming in Sunday, followed by high winds on Monday and then from there out it is rain, rain, rain! The intense thunderstorm is expected to last two days, tailing off on Thursday.
en: We've got quite the system coming our way! Clear skies Friday and Saturday, but some pretty intense heat coming in Sunday, followed by high winds on Monday and then from there out it is rain, rain, rain! The intense thunderstorm is expected to last two days, tailing off on Thursday.
ja: なかなかの天気の変化が訪れます! 金曜日と土曜日は晴天、日曜日にはかなりの猛暑が入り込み、月曜日には強風、そしてそこから先はもう雨、雨、雨です! この激しい雷雨は2日ほど続き、木曜日にはおさまる見込みです。

key: Take care, Reborn City!
en: Take care, Reborn City!
ja: 気をつけて、リボーンシティ!

key: Can't use that here.
en: Can't use that here.
ja: ここでは使えない。

key: \PN showed the Application to Mannie.
en: \PN showed the Application to Mannie.
ja: \PNはマニーに申込書を見せた。

key: MANNIE: Whatcha got there, pal?
en: MANNIE: Whatcha got there, pal?
ja: マニー: 何それ、それ何?

key: A construction job?
en: A construction job?
ja: 建設の仕事?

key: It's just like when we were helping out with the city on our own,
en: It's just like when we were helping out with the city on our own,
ja: これって、俺たちが自分たちで街の復興を手伝ってたときと同じじゃないか、

key: But it pays?!
en: But it pays?!
ja: でも、お金がもらえるのか?!

key: Man, I can do that!
en: Man, I can do that!
ja: すごいな、俺にもできるぞ!

key: That sounds dope! It'll be like that time, right?
en: That sounds dope! It'll be like that time, right?
ja: それ、最高じゃん! あの時と同じって感じだよな?

key: I'll fill this out right away. Thanks!
en: I'll fill this out right away. Thanks!
ja: すぐに書き込むよ。ありがとな!

key: This is way too complicated for me, buddy!
en: This is way too complicated for me, buddy!
ja: これは俺には難しすぎるよ、相棒!

key: There's no way I could do a job like this.
en: There's no way I could do a job like this.
ja: こんな仕事、俺にはとても無理だ。

key: I always gotta be told what has to be done next, like it was when we were rebuilding the city.
en: I always gotta be told what has to be done next, like it was when we were rebuilding the city.
ja: 俺はいつも、次に何をすればいいか教えてもらわなきゃダメなんだ。街を立て直してたときもそうだったろ。

key: Isn't there anything like that?
en: Isn't there anything like that?
ja: 何かそういう感じの仕事、ないのか?

key: \PN showed the Application to Kriz.
en: \PN showed the Application to Kriz.
ja: \PNはクリズに申込書を見せた。

key: KRIZ: Huh? That's...
en: KRIZ: Huh? That's...
ja: クリズ: え? それって……

key: An application for The Spyce...
en: An application for The Spyce...
ja: ザ・スパイスの求人票……

key: A line cook position?
en: A line cook position?
ja: ラインコックの仕事?

key: That's-- no good. I don't know how to cook lines.
en: That's-- no good. I don't know how to cook lines.
ja: それは……無理。ラインの料理の仕方なんて知らないし。

key: Then again, I can cook other stuff. I cook every day!
en: Then again, I can cook other stuff. I cook every day!
ja: でも待てよ、他の料理ならできるぞ。毎日料理してるし!

key: So maybe, just maybe, there's a chance I can learn to cook up some tasty lines too!
en: So maybe, just maybe, there's a chance I can learn to cook up some tasty lines too!
ja: だから、もしかしたら、もしかしたらだけど、美味しいラインの料理だって作れるようになるかもしれない!

key: Okay! I'll give it a go!
en: Okay! I'll give it a go!
ja: よし! やってみる!

key: Don't wait for me!
en: Don't wait for me!
ja: 先に行っててくれ!

key: Just a job application, right?
en: Just a job application, right?
ja: ただの求人票だろ?

key: I already told you, I don't have any skills employers would want.
en: I already told you, I don't have any skills employers would want.
ja: 前にも言ったけど、雇い主が欲しがるようなスキル、俺には何もないよ。

key: All I do is make food and sleep. And roll with the Magma Gang.
en: All I do is make food and sleep. And roll with the Magma Gang.
ja: 俺にできるのは料理と寝ることだけ。あとはマグマ団とつるむことくらい。

key: Don't worry about someone useless like me.
en: Don't worry about someone useless like me.
ja: 俺みたいな役立たずのことは気にしなくていいから。

key: \PN showed the Application to DeFacto.
en: \PN showed the Application to DeFacto.
ja: \PNはデファクトに申込書を見せた。

key: DEFACTO: And what have you procured now?
en: DEFACTO: And what have you procured now?
ja: デファクト: それで、今度は何を調達してきたんだ?

key: An application for the Beryl Library...
en: An application for the Beryl Library...
ja: ベリル図書館の求人票……

key: Since when was there a library there?
en: Since when was there a library there?
ja: いつからあそこに図書館なんてあったんだ?

key: I suppose I've already learned one good thing now, haven't I?
en: I suppose I've already learned one good thing now, haven't I?
ja: これで、また一つ有益なことを学んだわけだな。

key: All right, I acquiesce. This sounds intriguing.
en: All right, I acquiesce. This sounds intriguing.
ja: よかろう、承服しよう。なかなか興味をそそられる話だ。

key: I'll pay them a visit. See ya.
en: I'll pay them a visit. See ya.
ja: 訪ねてみるとしよう。またな。

key: Some other kind of meaningless recruitment paper?
en: Some other kind of meaningless recruitment paper?
ja: 何か別の、取るに足らない求人票か?

key: How blase.
en: How blase.
ja: 何とも陳腐なことだ。

key: There's nothing to be learned from something like that.
en: There's nothing to be learned from something like that.
ja: そんなものから学べることなど、何もない。

key: I'd much rather be somewhere I could engorge myself with knowledge.
en: I'd much rather be somewhere I could engorge myself with knowledge.
ja: 私はむしろ、知識を貪り尽くせるような場所にいたいものだ。

key: \PN showed the Application to Break.
en: \PN showed the Application to Break.
ja: \PNはブレークに申込書を見せた。

key: BREAK: Oh?
en: BREAK: Oh?
ja: ブレーク: おや?

key: You want me to work at a medicine market?
en: You want me to work at a medicine market?
ja: 薬売りの仕事をしてほしいって?

key: For a Meganium?
en: For a Meganium?
ja: メガニウムのために?

key: Dealing substances of questionable validity to perfectly unsuspecting consumers who are more likely to believe in sigils than science?
en: Dealing substances of questionable validity to perfectly unsuspecting consumers who are more likely to believe in sigils than science?
ja: 科学よりまじないを信じるような、何も知らない消費者たちに、効能の怪しい薬品を売りつけろと?

key: Well.
en: Well.
ja: なるほど。

key: Then you found the right person for the job.
en: Then you found the right person for the job.
ja: それなら、うってつけの人材を見つけたな。

key: I won't waste a minute. Ta-ta!
en: I won't waste a minute. Ta-ta!
ja: 一分だって無駄にしないよ。それじゃあね!

key: How fascinating!
en: How fascinating!
ja: なんて興味深い!

key: It's scrap paper!
en: It's scrap paper!
ja: ただの反故紙じゃないか!

key: Laced with ink!
en: Laced with ink!
ja: インクがしみ込んでる!

key: I do love the smell of freshly laden ink.
en: I do love the smell of freshly laden ink.
ja: 私は、刷りたてのインクの匂いが大好きでね。

key: Especially after you smell too much of it and start getting loopy. It'll knock you right out!
en: Especially after you smell too much of it and start getting loopy. It'll knock you right out!
ja: 特に、嗅ぎすぎてふらふらしてくる感じがたまらない。あっという間に意識が飛ぶんだ!

key: That's the best! Maybe not healthy!
en: That's the best! Maybe not healthy!
ja: 最高だよ! 健康にはよくないかもしれないけどね!

key: If you want health, try valerian root. Guaranteed to KO-- plus some health benefits!
en: If you want health, try valerian root. Guaranteed to KO-- plus some health benefits!
ja: 健康が欲しいなら、カノコソウの根を試すといい。確実に意識を飛ばしてくれるし――おまけに体にもいいんだ!

key: Only problem with that one is, it smells like the south end of a north-facing Skuntank!
en: Only problem with that one is, it smells like the south end of a north-facing Skuntank!
ja: 唯一の難点は、北向きのスカタンクの南側みたいな匂いがすることだけどね!

key: \PN showed the Application to Pierce.
en: \PN showed the Application to Pierce.
ja: \PNはピアースに申込書を見せた。

key: PIERCE: ...
en: PIERCE: ...
ja: ピアース: ……

key: Apophyll Beach, huh?
en: Apophyll Beach, huh?
ja: アポフィルビーチ、か。

key: Beats the city.
en: Beats the city.
ja: 街よりはましだな。

key: I'll go.
en: I'll go.
ja: 行くよ。

key: A library, huh?
en: A library, huh?
ja: 図書館、か。

key: It's quiet, I'll give you that.
en: It's quiet, I'll give you that.
ja: 静かなのは認めるよ。

key: But people need help all the time.
en: But people need help all the time.
ja: でも、人はいつだって助けを求めてくる。

key: Asking where books are, or for recommendations...
en: Asking where books are, or for recommendations...
ja: 本の場所を聞いたり、おすすめを聞いたり……

key: I don't want to deal with that.
en: I don't want to deal with that.
ja: そういうの、関わりたくない。

key: So forget it.
en: So forget it.
ja: だから、やめとく。

key: Too loud.
en: Too loud.
ja: うるさすぎる。

key: Too many people.
en: Too many people.
ja: 人が多すぎる。

key: Forget it.
en: Forget it.
ja: やめとく。

key: \PN showed the Application to Darm.
en: \PN showed the Application to Darm.
ja: \PNはダームに申込書を見せた。

key: DARM: Hmph!
en: DARM: Hmph!
ja: ダーム: フン!

key: A circus job!?
en: A circus job!?
ja: サーカスの仕事だと!?

key: No way that's for me.
en: No way that's for me.
ja: 俺には無縁だな。

key: Then again, it could be fun to be show off in front of so many people...
en: Then again, it could be fun to be show off in front of so many people...
ja: とはいえ、大勢の前で見せつけるのは楽しいかもしれない……

key: Lemme see that.
en: Lemme see that.
ja: ちょっと見せてみろ。

key: "Requirements: Arm-wrestle"?!
en: "Requirements: Arm-wrestle"?!
ja: 「応募条件: 腕相撲」だと?!

key: You can get a job for arm-wrestling some shmuck?!
en: You can get a job for arm-wrestling some shmuck?!
ja: 誰かとちょっと腕相撲するだけで仕事にありつけるのか?!

key: Who cares about the job? This a personal CHALLENGE now!
en: Who cares about the job? This a personal CHALLENGE now!
ja: 仕事なんかどうでもいい! これは俺個人へのチャレンジだ!

key: I'm off!
en: I'm off!
ja: 行ってくる!

key: A job like this is way below my strength!
en: A job like this is way below my strength!
ja: こんな仕事、俺の力には見合わなすぎる!

key: I should be dazzling people with muscles, not taking orders or selling things!
en: I should be dazzling people with muscles, not taking orders or selling things!
ja: 俺は筋肉で人々を魅了するべきなんだ、注文を取ったり物を売ったりじゃなくてな!

key: That's what POWER is all about!
en: That's what POWER is all about!
ja: それこそが力ってものだ!

key: Wonder and excitement! A true show!
en: Wonder and excitement! A true show!
ja: 驚きと興奮! 本物のショーだ!

key: Find something like that, and then we can talk!
en: Find something like that, and then we can talk!
ja: そういうのを見つけてきたら、また話そう!

key: \PN showed the Application to Razzy.
en: \PN showed the Application to Razzy.
ja: \PNはラジーに申込書を見せた。

key: RAZZY: What'd you find? Anything interesting?!
en: RAZZY: What'd you find? Anything interesting?!
ja: ラジー: 何見つけたの? 何か面白いもの?!

key: What? A company job? That's totally boring...
en: What? A company job? That's totally boring...
ja: え? 会社勤め? それ超つまんない……

key: Connected to the Sweet Kiss Candy Shop?!
en: Connected to the Sweet Kiss Candy Shop?!
ja: あまいキッス菓子店の関連?!

key: You think they sell rock candy? I haven't had that since I was a kid!
en: You think they sell rock candy? I haven't had that since I was a kid!
ja: ロックキャンディーとか売ってる? 子どものころ以来食べてないんだよね!

key: Oh! What about Red-Hots?!
en: Oh! What about Red-Hots?!
ja: あ! レッドホッツはどう?!

key: My grandma used to make a killer applesauce that she'd flavor using blended Red-Hots!
en: My grandma used to make a killer applesauce that she'd flavor using blended Red-Hots!
ja: おばあちゃんが、レッドホッツを砕いて混ぜたリンゴソースを作ってくれてね、あれ絶品だったんだ!

key: This sounds awesome! Count me in!
en: This sounds awesome! Count me in!
ja: これ、めっちゃ楽しそう! あたし、やる!

key: Woah, a circus?!
en: Woah, a circus?!
ja: うわ、サーカス?!

key: That sounds radical!
en: That sounds radical!
ja: それ最高じゃん!

key: But it's out of Reborn City...
en: But it's out of Reborn City...
ja: でもリボーンシティの外だし……

key: There's no way I could work at a place like that.
en: There's no way I could work at a place like that.
ja: そんなところで働くなんて無理だよ。

key: Is there anything else?
en: Is there anything else?
ja: 他に何かない?

key: Huh? This doesn't sound interesting at all!
en: Huh? This doesn't sound interesting at all!
ja: え? これ、全然面白くなさそう!

key: Isn't there something close by that's upbeat and exciting?
en: Isn't there something close by that's upbeat and exciting?
ja: 近くて、明るくて楽しいところ、何かないの?

key: Good food would be a plus too!
en: Good food would be a plus too!
ja: 美味しいご飯があったらなおいいな!

key: Wait, can you eat on the job?
en: Wait, can you eat on the job?
ja: てか、仕事中に食べていいの?

key: \PN showed the Application to Nihil.
en: \PN showed the Application to Nihil.
ja: \PNはニヒルに申込書を見せた。

key: NIHIL: Don't bother.
en: NIHIL: Don't bother.
ja: ニヒル: どうでもいい。

key: The Nightclub's hiring.
en: The Nightclub's hiring.
ja: ナイトクラブが求人出してる。

key: All right, fuck you. You win.
en: All right, fuck you. You win.
ja: はいはい、分かったよ。お前の勝ちだ。

key: I'll go and check it out.
en: I'll go and check it out.
ja: 見に行ってやるよ。

key: And uh,
en: And uh,
ja: それと、あー、

key: Thanks, I guess.
en: Thanks, I guess.
ja: ……ありがとな、たぶん。

key: Weren't you listening? I said don't bother.
en: Weren't you listening? I said don't bother.
ja: 聞いてなかったのか? どうでもいいって言っただろ。

key: There's not a job in this whole city cool enough for me.
en: There's not a job in this whole city cool enough for me.
ja: この街には、俺に釣り合うほどイケてる仕事なんてない。

key: Isn't that obvious?
en: Isn't that obvious?
ja: 分かりきったことだろ?

key: There's not many places you'd expect to see someone as exclusive as me working.
en: There's not many places you'd expect to see someone as exclusive as me working.
ja: 俺くらい特別な人間が働くような場所は、そう多くない。

key: So just drop it already. You heard it?
en: So just drop it already. You heard it?
ja: だからもう放っておいてくれ。聞いたか?

key: \PN showed the Application to Archer.
en: \PN showed the Application to Archer.
ja: \PNはアーチャーに申込書を見せた。

key: ARCHER: Hmm...
en: ARCHER: Hmm...
ja: アーチャー: ふむ……

key: Silph Co. requires at least two years of business management experience...
en: Silph Co. requires at least two years of business management experience...
ja: シルフカンパニーは、経営管理の実務経験を最低2年求めている、か……

key: Well, seems like the Aqua Gang's been quite the profitable business, hasn't it?
en: Well, seems like the Aqua Gang's been quite the profitable business, hasn't it?
ja: なるほど、アクア団もなかなかもうかる商売だったようだな。

key: Ahh, that title won't do. I'll just quickly rebrand the now-empty group to Aqua Incorporated.
en: Ahh, that title won't do. I'll just quickly rebrand the now-empty group to Aqua Incorporated.
ja: ああ、その肩書きでは通らないか。では手早く、今は空になったこの組織をアクア・インコーポレイテッドと改名するとしよう。

key: It should make a fine qualification, and I'm more than capable of brushing aside the details.
en: It should make a fine qualification, and I'm more than capable of brushing aside the details.
ja: それなら十分な資格になるだろうし、細かい部分は私が難なく取り繕える。

key: This job will suit me perfectly, thank you.
en: This job will suit me perfectly, thank you.
ja: この仕事は私にぴったりだ、感謝する。

key: You've been a true friend to us all.
en: You've been a true friend to us all.
ja: 君は私たち全員にとって、真の友人だった。

key: Please take this as a final parting gift.
en: Please take this as a final parting gift.
ja: これを最後の贈り物として受け取ってくれ。

key: It was one of the Pokémon we liberated from the Magma Gang.
en: It was one of the Pokémon we liberated from the Magma Gang.
ja: マグマ団から解放したポケモンの一匹だ。

key: The item it's holding is just a personal selection from me.
en: The item it's holding is just a personal selection from me.
ja: 持たせている道具は、私からの個人的な選りすぐりだ。

key: ARCHER: Farewell, \PN.
en: ARCHER: Farewell, \PN.
ja: アーチャー: さらばだ、\PN。

key: Oh, and don't mind if I list you as a professional reference.
en: Oh, and don't mind if I list you as a professional reference.
ja: ああ、それと、君を職務経歴の照会先として記載しても構わないかな。

key: Is this really the best out there?
en: Is this really the best out there?
ja: これが本当に最善なのか?

key: Compared to many of the other guys, I would hope I'd be able to get something a little more significant.
en: Compared to many of the other guys, I would hope I'd be able to get something a little more significant.
ja: 他の連中と比べれば、もう少しましなものが得られてもいいはずだが。

key: I've also managed to keep my record fairly clean, so that shouldn't be a problem.
en: I've also managed to keep my record fairly clean, so that shouldn't be a problem.
ja: 経歴もかなりきれいに保ってきたつもりだ、問題にはならないだろう。

key: Was there, by chance, anything more profitable?
en: Was there, by chance, anything more profitable?
ja: もっと実入りのいいものは、なかったのか?

key: ARCHER: Mm? Have you finished with the others already?
en: ARCHER: Mm? Have you finished with the others already?
ja: アーチャー: ん? もう他の者たちの分は片づけたのか?

key: They should be the top priority right now.
en: They should be the top priority right now.
ja: 今は彼らを最優先にすべきだ。

key: While it's true that I will be looking for employment myself shortly, I would rather ensure they all have positions first than risk taking one from them.
en: While it's true that I will be looking for employment myself shortly, I would rather ensure they all have positions first than risk taking one from them.
ja: 私自身もじきに職を探すことになるだろうが、彼ら全員の職が決まる前に、私が横取りするような真似はしたくない。

key: \PN showed the Application to Maxwell.
en: \PN showed the Application to Maxwell.
ja: \PNはマクスウェルに申込書を見せた。

key: MAXWELL: Let's take a look!
en: MAXWELL: Let's take a look!
ja: マクスウェル: よし、見てみよう!

key: SOLICE? Never heard of this place before.
en: SOLICE? Never heard of this place before.
ja: ソリス? 聞いたことないな。

key: But the work they do seems to be exactly the sort of thing I'm looking for.
en: But the work they do seems to be exactly the sort of thing I'm looking for.
ja: だが、あそこの仕事内容は、まさに俺が探してたようなやつだ。

key: Nice catch, \PN!
en: Nice catch, \PN!
ja: いい仕事を見つけてきたな、\PN!

key: I knew I could count on you!
en: I knew I could count on you!
ja: お前になら任せられると思ってたぜ!

key: Let's see... They require 2 years of social work experience?
en: Let's see... They require 2 years of social work experience?
ja: ええと……社会福祉の実務経験2年、か?

key: I'd say the Magma Gang's work has been pretty social. That should be no problem!
en: I'd say the Magma Gang's work has been pretty social. That should be no problem!
ja: マグマ団の活動だって、それなりに「社会的」だったと言えるだろ。問題ないな!

key: Anyway, thanks for stickin' it out with us.
en: Anyway, thanks for stickin' it out with us.
ja: とにかく、俺たちにずっと付き合ってくれてありがとな。

key: When you first showed up in our humble ol' alley, I had no idea you'd be the kind of person that you were.
en: When you first showed up in our humble ol' alley, I had no idea you'd be the kind of person that you were.
ja: お前が初めてこのしがない路地に現れたときは、こんな奴だとは思ってもみなかったよ。

key: But by now, I've heard the rumours about you.
en: But by now, I've heard the rumours about you.
ja: でも今じゃ、お前のうわさは俺の耳にも届いてる。

key: It took me too long to even connect them to the person I knew, but you're the one who everyone says has been saving Reborn, right?
en: It took me too long to even connect them to the person I knew, but you're the one who everyone says has been saving Reborn, right?
ja: 知ってる奴と結びつけるのに時間がかかったけどよ、みんなが言う「リボーンを救ってる奴」って、お前のことなんだろ?

key: And you don't care about the glory at all, do you?
en: And you don't care about the glory at all, do you?
ja: しかも、名声なんてこれっぽっちも気にしちゃいないんだろ?

key: Magnificent bastard.
en: Magnificent bastard.
ja: とんでもない奴だぜ。

key: Take this with you.
en: Take this with you.
ja: これを持ってけ。

key: It's a final "Thank you" gift we got from the Aqua Gang.
en: It's a final "Thank you" gift we got from the Aqua Gang.
ja: アクア団からの、最後の「ありがとう」の印だ。

key: Oh, and the item is just a little bonus I threw in.
en: Oh, and the item is just a little bonus I threw in.
ja: あ、それと、そのアイテムはちょっとしたおまけで俺が付け足したやつだ。

key: MAXWELL: See you around!
en: MAXWELL: See you around!
ja: マクスウェル: またな!

key: And don't you dare ever let your glory slip away, baby!
en: And don't you dare ever let your glory slip away, baby!
ja: それと、お前の栄光を絶対に手放すんじゃねえぞ、相棒!

key: Hmm...
en: Hmm...
ja: うーん……

key: I don't want to be rude, since you've gone through all this trouble...
en: I don't want to be rude, since you've gone through all this trouble...
ja: せっかくここまでしてくれたのに、無礼なことは言いたくないんだけど……

key: But where's the glory in this?
en: But where's the glory in this?
ja: でも、これのどこに栄光があるんだ?

key: If it's just another normal job, I don't know whose life I can really make a difference in that way.
en: If it's just another normal job, I don't know whose life I can really make a difference in that way.
ja: ただの普通の仕事だっていうなら、そんなもので一体誰の人生を変えられるっていうんだ。

key: Of course, I'm willing to wait until a position where I can make a direct difference opens up.
en: Of course, I'm willing to wait until a position where I can make a direct difference opens up.
ja: もちろん、直接誰かの力になれるような仕事が空くまで待つのはやぶさかじゃないけどな。

key: Glory doesn't come overnight, baby.
en: Glory doesn't come overnight, baby.
ja: 栄光は一晩じゃ手に入らないもんだぜ、相棒。

key: Heh, though that does sound like a raunchy slogan, doesn't it?
en: Heh, though that does sound like a raunchy slogan, doesn't it?
ja: へっ、それにしても、ずいぶん下品なスローガンに聞こえるよな?

key: MAXWELL: Woah, hey there.
en: MAXWELL: Woah, hey there.
ja: マクスウェル: おっと、よお。

key: You know I was asking you to find applications for the other guys, right?
en: You know I was asking you to find applications for the other guys, right?
ja: 他の連中の求人票を探してきてくれって頼んでたよな?

key: Not me-- Well, maybe I'll think about it later.
en: Not me-- Well, maybe I'll think about it later.
ja: 俺のじゃなくてよ――まあ、それはまた今度考えるとするか。

key: TAKA: This would be a decent place to hide... if it weren't for the ton of Pokémon strolling about.
en: TAKA: This would be a decent place to hide... if it weren't for the ton of Pokémon strolling about.
ja: タカ: 隠れるにはちょうどいい場所かもしれないけど……こんなにポケモンがうろついてるんじゃなあ。

key: I may have many healing items, but I still only have so many healing items.
en: I may have many healing items, but I still only have so many healing items.
ja: 回復アイテムはたくさん持ってるつもりだけど、それでも限りはあるからね。

key: TAKA: Somehow everywhere we go looks amazing to me.
en: TAKA: Somehow everywhere we go looks amazing to me.
ja: タカ: なんでだろう、どこに行っても、僕にはすごい場所に見えるんだ。

key: Maybe living for myself means finally seeing the world.
en: Maybe living for myself means finally seeing the world.
ja: 自分のために生きるっていうのは、ようやく世界を見るってことなのかもしれない。

key: TAKA: Looking at a place like this, I get the feeling anything could be beyond it.
en: TAKA: Looking at a place like this, I get the feeling anything could be beyond it.
ja: タカ: こういう場所を見ていると、この先には何でもありそうな気がしてくる。

key: Maybe this is where I run.
en: Maybe this is where I run.
ja: もしかしたら、僕が逃げ込む先はここなのかもしれない。

key: TAKA: Something is off in the energy of this place...
en: TAKA: Something is off in the energy of this place...
ja: タカ: この場所、何かエネルギーがおかしい気がする……

key: I wonder what it is that makes it so unstable?
en: I wonder what it is that makes it so unstable?
ja: 一体何がこんなに不安定にしてるんだろう?

key: Then again, same.
en: Then again, same.
ja: それを言ったら、僕もおんなじか。

key: TAKA: This place feels like a huge deja vu trip for me somehow...
en: TAKA: This place feels like a huge deja vu trip for me somehow...
ja: タカ: この場所、なんだかすごいデジャヴを感じるよ……

key: TAKA: How does something like this even keep from collapsing in on itself?
en: TAKA: How does something like this even keep from collapsing in on itself?
ja: タカ: こういうのって、どうして自分の重みで崩れ落ちたりしないんだろうね?

key: Sorry, I wasn't talking about the cave--
en: Sorry, I wasn't talking about the cave--
ja: ごめん、洞窟の話じゃなくて――

key: I meant myself.
en: I meant myself.
ja: 僕自身のことを言ったんだ。

key: TAKA: There has to be something more here... Or else why would I be remembering this?
en: TAKA: There has to be something more here... Or else why would I be remembering this?
ja: タカ: この先に、まだ何かあるはずなんだ……じゃなきゃ、どうしてこんなことを覚えてるっていうんだよ?

key: TAKA: I swear, one of these sand pits is gonna have a Trapinch at the bottom, and that's gonna be the end of us.
en: TAKA: I swear, one of these sand pits is gonna have a Trapinch at the bottom, and that's gonna be the end of us.
ja: タカ: 絶対、こういう砂の穴のどれかの底にアリボンがいて、それで僕たちは終わりになるんだ。

key: TAKA: By the way, do you have any idea where you're going?
en: TAKA: By the way, do you have any idea where you're going?
ja: タカ: ところで、自分がどこに向かってるか、分かってるの?

key: I mean, if not, it's cool.
en: I mean, if not, it's cool.
ja: いや、分かってなくても別にいいんだけど。

key: Frankly, I've never once in my life known where I was going.
en: Frankly, I've never once in my life known where I was going.
ja: 正直、僕は人生で一度も、自分がどこに向かってるか分かったためしがないよ。

key: TAKA: This place isn't so bad during the night, huh?
en: TAKA: This place isn't so bad during the night, huh?
ja: タカ: 夜になると、ここも案外悪くないね。

key: If you can get past all the sand.
en: If you can get past all the sand.
ja: 砂さえ我慢できればだけど。

key: And the...
en: And the...
ja: それと……

key: Actually I guess that's about all there is here, huh.
en: Actually I guess that's about all there is here, huh.
ja: いや、実はそれくらいしかここにはないか。

key: TAKA: My heart's racing from escaping like this.
en: TAKA: My heart's racing from escaping like this.
ja: タカ: こんなふうに逃げてると、心臓がバクバクする。

key: Well, either that or a heat stroke.
en: Well, either that or a heat stroke.
ja: まあ、熱中症のせいかもしれないけど。

key: TAKA: Nobody's following us, right?
en: TAKA: Nobody's following us, right?
ja: タカ: 誰にも追われてないよね?

key: TAKA: Listen, if you see anyone suspicious, just bury me in the sand and come back for me later.
en: TAKA: Listen, if you see anyone suspicious, just bury me in the sand and come back for me later.
ja: タカ: あのさ、もし怪しい人を見かけたら、僕を砂の中に埋めて、後で掘り返しに来てよ。

key: TAKA: For somewhere that only half-exists and is tossed out in the middle of who knows how many miles of sand, this place is pretty tidy.
en: TAKA: For somewhere that only half-exists and is tossed out in the middle of who knows how many miles of sand, this place is pretty tidy.
ja: タカ: 半分しか実在しないような場所で、何マイルあるか分からない砂の真ん中に放り出されてる割には、ここ、けっこう小ぎれいだね。

key: TAKA: If you ask me, this place is entirely too clean.
en: TAKA: If you ask me, this place is entirely too clean.
ja: タカ: 個人的には、ここはきれいすぎるくらいだと思うよ。

key: TAKA: I still don't really get that whole sliding block puzzle, but I'm glad you do.
en: TAKA: I still don't really get that whole sliding block puzzle, but I'm glad you do.
ja: タカ: あのスライドパズル、僕はいまだによく分かってないけど、キミが分かってるならよかった。

key: I bet it would be a lot easier if you could see it from above.
en: I bet it would be a lot easier if you could see it from above.
ja: 上から見られたら、きっともっと簡単なんだろうね。

key: ...Is that your secret?
en: ...Is that your secret?
ja: ……それがキミの秘けつ?

key: TAKA: This doesn't seem like it would be a bad place to hide, but...
en: TAKA: This doesn't seem like it would be a bad place to hide, but...
ja: タカ: 隠れるには悪くない場所だと思うけど……

key: Maybe I just don't want to be alone after all.
en: Maybe I just don't want to be alone after all.
ja: 結局、僕はただ一人になりたくないだけなのかもしれない。

key: TAKA: I relate to these trains on a spiritual level.
en: TAKA: I relate to these trains on a spiritual level.
ja: タカ: この電車たち、なんだか魂のレベルで共感しちゃうよ。

key: TAKA: You think there's food in some of these trains?
en: TAKA: You think there's food in some of these trains?
ja: タカ: この電車のどれかに、食べ物とか入ってると思う?

key: TAKA: I always wanted to crash trains into a pile of scrap metal.
en: TAKA: I always wanted to crash trains into a pile of scrap metal.
ja: タカ: 昔から、電車をスクラップの山に突っ込ませてみたかったんだ。

key: Being with you makes dreams come true, or something.
en: Being with you makes dreams come true, or something.
ja: キミと一緒だと、夢がかなうっていうか、そんな感じ。

key: TAKA: Is there really anything out here in this mess?
en: TAKA: Is there really anything out here in this mess?
ja: タカ: こんなガラクタの中に、本当に何かあるのかな?

key: Like, I get there's supposed to be a Gym here, but... why.
en: Like, I get there's supposed to be a Gym here, but...  why.
ja: ジムがここにあるはずってのは分かるけど……なんで。

key: TAKA: It feels wrong, traveling with someone who was supposed to be my enemy...
en: TAKA: It feels wrong, traveling with someone who was supposed to be my enemy...
ja: タカ: 敵になるはずだった相手と一緒に旅をするのって、なんだか間違ってる気がするよ……

key: But then again, my entire life has been wrong.
en: But then again, my entire life has been wrong.
ja: でも、僕の人生自体、ずっと間違ってたし。

key: So this feels right after all.
en: So this feels right after all.
ja: だから、これでやっと正しい気がするんだ。

key: TAKA: I wonder how long it'll take the others to realize I'm not coming back.
en: TAKA: I wonder how long it'll take the others to realize I'm not coming back.
ja: タカ: 僕が戻らないって、みんな気づくのにどれくらいかかるんだろう。

key: If they haven't already, anyway...
en: If they haven't already, anyway...
ja: もうとっくに気づいてなければの話だけど……

key: TAKA: ZEL is gonna get chewed out because of me...
en: TAKA: ZEL is gonna get chewed out because of me...
ja: タカ: 僕のせいで、ゼルがひどくしかられることになりそうだ……

key: Father had asked them to keep tabs on me when they weren't working on the PULSEs.
en: Father had asked them to keep tabs on me when they weren't working on the PULSEs.
ja: 父上は、PULSEの作業をしていないとき、僕の様子を見ておくようゼルに頼んでいたから。

key: Then again, I heard Zero's not doing too well lately.
en: Then again, I heard Zero's not doing too well lately.
ja: それに、最近ゼロの調子があまり良くないって聞いた。

key: TAKA: I know Team Meteor's track record isn't exactly the best,
en: TAKA: I know Team Meteor's track record isn't exactly the best,
ja: タカ: チームメテオの実績が決して立派なものじゃないのは分かってる。

key: But they're still the only family I've ever had.
en: But they're still the only family I've ever had.
ja: でも、それでも僕にとっては、これまで唯一の家族なんだ。

key: TAKA: You know, Meteor wasn't always like this...
en: TAKA: You know, Meteor wasn't always like this...
ja: タカ: あのさ、メテオは最初からこうだったわけじゃないんだ……

key: Originally we just looked after the Citadel.
en: Originally we just looked after the Citadel.
ja: もともとは、ただシタデルを守っているだけだったんだよ。

key: My dad said that his parents were more like shrinekeepers than anything.
en: My dad said that his parents were more like shrinekeepers than anything.
ja: 父上いわく、その先代たちは、何かというより神殿の番人みたいな存在だったらしい。

key: TAKA: \PN, I'm sorry for always being such a burden.
en: TAKA: \PN, I'm sorry for always being such a burden.
ja: タカ: \PN、いつも重荷になってばかりで、ごめんね。

key: TAKA: None of this would have happened if not for that woman...
en: TAKA: None of this would have happened if not for that woman...
ja: タカ: あの女さえいなければ、こんなことにはならなかったはずなんだ……

key: She's corrupted Team Meteor-- both our ends and our means.
en: She's corrupted Team Meteor-- both our ends and our means.
ja: 彼女はチームメテオを――目的も手段も――腐らせてしまった。

key: TAKA: My father says none of this would have happened if not for that woman...
en: TAKA: My father says none of this would have happened if not for that woman...
ja: タカ: 父上は、あの女さえいなければ何も起きなかったはずだと言ってる……

key: The Champion of Reborn, who created the League and advertised it across the world like some kind of fairground.
en: The Champion of Reborn, who created the League and advertised it across the world like some kind of fairground.
ja: リボーンのチャンピオン、リーグを作って、まるでどこかの遊園地みたいに世界中に宣伝した女性だ。

key: She closed up the old city's wounds, hiding the Citadel again.
en: She closed up the old city's wounds, hiding the Citadel again.
ja: 彼女は古い街の傷を塞いで、シタデルを再び覆い隠した。

key: Regardless of anyone's ideals, why bother just building over a ruin instead of preserving it?
en: Regardless of anyone's ideals, why bother just building over a ruin instead of preserving it?
ja: どんな理想があったにせよ、遺跡をそのまま残す代わりに、なぜわざわざ上に街を建てたりするんだろう?

key: That sounds like something I'd pull.
en: That sounds like something I'd pull.
ja: それ、僕がやりそうなことだけどね。

key: TAKA: My father says that whatever happens to Reborn City is its own fault.
en: TAKA: My father says that whatever happens to Reborn City is its own fault.
ja: タカ: 父上は、リボーンシティに何が起ころうと、それは自業自得だと言ってる。

key: After my grandparents' death, the founders built Reborn City on top of the holy Citadel, trying to hide it.
en: After my grandparents' death, the founders built Reborn City on top of the holy Citadel, trying to hide it.
ja: 祖父母が亡くなった後、創始者たちは、聖なるシタデルの上にリボーンシティを建てて、それを覆い隠そうとした。

key: It was the ultimate insult to our forebearers' culture.
en: It was the ultimate insult to our forebearers' culture.
ja: それは、僕たちの祖先の文化に対する、この上ない侮辱だったんだ。

key: Or whatever that's supposed to mean.
en: Or whatever that's supposed to mean.
ja: まあ、そういうことになってるらしい。

key: TAKA: Hey, in your travels, did you ever meet a girl named Luna?
en: TAKA: Hey, in your travels, did you ever meet a girl named Luna?
ja: タカ: ねえ、旅をしてる間に、ルナっていう女の子に会ったことある?

key: She was one of my only friends growing up.
en: She was one of my only friends growing up.
ja: 僕が育つ中で、数少ない友達の一人だったんだ。

key: Then she ran away...
en: Then she ran away...
ja: それから彼女は家出した……

key: Just like me now, I guess.
en: Just like me now, I guess.
ja: 今の僕と、ちょうど同じだね。

key: I think about her a lot.
en: I think about her a lot.
ja: 彼女のこと、よく考えるんだ。

key: TAKA: Hey, this is just a random question, but you know Luna, right?
en: TAKA: Hey, this is just a random question, but you know Luna, right?
ja: タカ: ねえ、これはただの何気ない質問だけど、ルナのこと知ってるよね?

key: If you see her again, tell her--
en: If you see her again, tell her--
ja: もしまた会うことがあったら、伝えてほしいんだ――

key: ...Actually, never mind.
en: ...Actually, never mind.
ja: ……ううん、やっぱりいいや。

key: I kind of think it's my fault that she's become as delusional as she is...
en: I kind of think it's my fault that she's become as delusional as she is...
ja: 彼女があんなふうに思い込みが激しくなったのは、僕のせいな気がするんだ……

key: After all, if I hadn't been born, she wouldn't have had to be in that position.
en: After all, if I hadn't been born, she wouldn't have had to be in that position.
ja: だって、僕が生まれてさえいなければ、彼女があの立場に立たされることもなかったから。

key: TAKA: Hey, \PN, what are your parents like?
en: TAKA: Hey, \PN, what are your parents like?
ja: タカ: ねえ\PN、キミの両親ってどんな人?

key: You've seen how my father is.
en: You've seen how my father is.
ja: 僕の父上がどんな人か、キミも見てきたよね。

key: And my mother-- was just that.
en: And my mother-- was just that.
ja: それで、僕の母上は――それだけの人だったんだ。

key: She was hired to have me, and then she went on her way.
en: She was hired to have me, and then she went on her way.
ja: 僕を産むために雇われて、それで自分の道に去っていった。

key: But that's not normal... right?
en: But that's not normal... right?
ja: でも、それって普通じゃないよね……?

key: TAKA: I know he's done no shortage of destructive things, but my father isn't all bad.
en: TAKA: I know he's done no shortage of destructive things, but my father isn't all bad.
ja: タカ: 父上が数え切れないほど破壊的なことをしてきたのは分かってる。でも、父上がすべて悪いわけじゃないんだ。

key: His dream for Reborn is what his childhood was like-- a small community in reverence to our world's creator.
en: His dream for Reborn is what his childhood was like-- a small community in reverence to our world's creator.
ja: リボーンについての父上の夢は、父上自身の子ども時代そのもの――この世界の創造主を敬う小さな共同体なんだ。

key: The one who's really dangerous is Lin.
en: The one who's really dangerous is Lin.
ja: 本当に危ないのは、リンの方だよ。

key: TAKA: Do you think my father will be okay?
en: TAKA: Do you think my father will be okay?
ja: タカ: 父上、大丈夫だと思う?

key: He's been harsh with me, but only out of concern.
en: He's been harsh with me, but only out of concern.
ja: 僕には厳しかったけど、それはただ心配してくれてたからなんだ。

key: I'm the one that just can't get it together.
en: I'm the one that just can't get it together.
ja: きちんとできないのは、僕の方なんだよ。

key: Not faithfully, anyway...
en: Not faithfully, anyway...
ja: 少なくとも、忠実にはできてない……

key: TAKA: ...
en: TAKA: ...
ja: タカ: ……

key: Oh, sorry \PN, did you say something?
en: Oh, sorry \PN, did you say something?
ja: あ、ごめん\PN、なんか言った?

key: I totally spaced out.
en: I totally spaced out.
ja: 完全にぼーっとしてた。

key: TAKA: I hope my father doesn't take it too hard when he gets the news.
en: TAKA: I hope my father doesn't take it too hard when he gets the news.
ja: タカ: 父上が、あの知らせを聞いて、あまり深く傷つかなければいいんだけど。

key: He never really got over losing his parents like he did.
en: He never really got over losing his parents like he did.
ja: 父上は、自分の両親を亡くしたことを、いまだに乗り越えられていないんだ。

key: He's always in fear of losing things from the past.
en: He's always in fear of losing things from the past.
ja: いつも、過去のものを失うことを恐れてる。

key: That's why he fights so hard for Reborn's history.
en: That's why he fights so hard for Reborn's history.
ja: だからこそ、リボーンの歴史のために、あんなに必死に戦ってるんだ。

key: TAKA: Lin's not following us, right?
en: TAKA: Lin's not following us, right?
ja: タカ: リン、僕たちを追ってきてないよね?

key: That woman never talks except when she's giving orders or spitting on others.
en: That woman never talks except when she's giving orders or spitting on others.
ja: あの女、命令するときと、他人に毒づくとき以外は口を開かないんだ。

key: She's more like a robot than a human, but even less empathetic.
en: She's more like a robot than a human, but even less empathetic.
ja: 人間っていうより、ロボットみたいな感じだけど、共感力はロボット以下だよ。

key: TAKA: Everything is Lin's fault...
en: TAKA: Everything is Lin's fault...
ja: タカ: 何もかも、リンのせいなんだ……

key: That woman is chaos inside and out.
en: That woman is chaos inside and out.
ja: あの女は、内も外も、めちゃくちゃなんだよ。

key: Did you know she's narcoleptic?
en: Did you know she's narcoleptic?
ja: 彼女がナルコレプシーだって知ってた?

key: I can't tell you how many times we've found her collapsed in some random place.
en: I can't tell you how many times we've found her collapsed in some random place.
ja: どこかそこら中で気を失って倒れてる彼女を、何度見つけたか分からないよ。

key: And no matter what we do, she won't wake up except on her own.
en: And no matter what we do, she won't wake up except on her own.
ja: それに、僕らが何をしても、自分から目を覚ます以外に起きてくれないんだ。

key: TAKA: Do you hate my father?
en: TAKA: Do you hate my father?
ja: タカ: キミは、父上のこと嫌い?

key: TAKA: I know he's not exactly a shining beacon of morals...
en: TAKA: I know he's not exactly a shining beacon of morals...
ja: タカ: 父上が、道徳の輝かしい手本ってわけじゃないのは分かってる……

key: But he's always fighting for his own ideals.
en: But he's always fighting for his own ideals.
ja: でも、父上はいつだって、自分の理想のために戦ってきたんだ。

key: That was something I never could do.
en: That was something I never could do.
ja: それは、僕には絶対にできなかったことだよ。

key: Until now, I guess.
en: Until now, I guess.
ja: 今までは、って感じだけどね。

key: TAKA: Even after everything?
en: TAKA: Even after everything?
ja: タカ: こんなことがあった後でも?

key: ...Thank you.
en: ...Thank you.
ja: ……ありがとう。

key: TAKA: He may be subordinate to my father, but you should watch out more for Sirius than for him.
en: TAKA: He may be subordinate to my father, but you should watch out more for Sirius than for him.
ja: タカ: 父上の部下ではあるけど、気をつけるべきなのは父上よりもシリウスの方だよ。

key: He's always had the "history is written by the winners" mindset, but since he's fallen in with Lin, it's gotten much worse.
en: He's always had the "history is written by the winners" mindset, but since he's fallen in with Lin, it's gotten much worse.
ja: 彼は昔から「歴史は勝者が書くもの」って考えの持ち主だったけど、リンと組むようになってから、それがずっとひどくなったんだ。

key: TAKA: Elias will probably be looking for me too...
en: TAKA: Elias will probably be looking for me too...
ja: タカ: イライアスも、たぶん僕を探してるだろうな……

key: I don't want to be found by anyone, but at least Elias is loyal to my father.
en: I don't want to be found by anyone, but at least Elias is loyal to my father.
ja: 誰にも見つかりたくないけど、少なくともイライアスは父上に忠実だから。

key: I can't imagine having someone act towards me the way he does to my father.
en: I can't imagine having someone act towards me the way he does to my father.
ja: 誰かに、彼が父上にするみたいに接してもらうなんて、僕には想像もつかないよ。

key: I deserve that least of all.
en: I deserve that least of all.
ja: そんなの、僕には一番似合わない。

key: TAKA: You had something to do with that doctor guy joining us recently, right?
en: TAKA: You had something to do with that doctor guy joining us recently, right?
ja: タカ: 最近、あの医者みたいな男が仲間に加わったのって、キミが関係してるんだよね?

key: That guy creeps me out so much.
en: That guy creeps me out so much.
ja: あの男、本当に気味が悪いんだ。

key: He's almost stalking Lin, like he's obsessed with her or something.
en: He's almost stalking Lin, like he's obsessed with her or something.
ja: リンにほとんどつきまとってるみたいで、何か執着してるみたいなんだよ。

key: TAKA: Everyone connected to Lin is crazy.
en: TAKA: Everyone connected to Lin is crazy.
ja: タカ: リンに関わる人間は、みんなおかしいんだ。

key: Like that girl, Terra.
en: Like that girl, Terra.
ja: あのテラって女の子もそう。

key: Everyone talks about her like her technical ability is unrivaled,
en: Everyone talks about her like her technical ability is unrivaled,
ja: みんな、彼女の技術力は誰にも負けないって言うけど、

key: But she's almost never around the bases, and then when she is, we end up having to repair a ton of stuff.
en: But she's almost never around the bases, and then when she is, we end up having to repair a ton of stuff.
ja: 拠点にはほとんどいないくせに、たまにいると、結局大量に修理する羽目になるんだ。

key: But Lin always insists she stays anyway.
en: But Lin always insists she stays anyway.
ja: それでも、リンはいつも彼女を残しておけって言い張ってる。

key: TAKA: You remember that guy who was with Ace, ZEL, and I in Rhodochrine?
en: TAKA: You remember that guy who was with Ace, ZEL, and I in Rhodochrine?
ja: タカ: ロドクラインで、エースとゼルと一緒にいた男のこと、覚えてる?

key: Back then, some of the grunts were saying you killed him.
en: Back then, some of the grunts were saying you killed him.
ja: あのとき、何人かの構成員が、キミがあいつを殺したって言ってたんだ。

key: He wasn't the friendliest guy.
en: He wasn't the friendliest guy.
ja: 一番愛想のいい奴ってわけじゃなかったけどね。

key: In fact, he never stayed to talk, or did orders he didn't have to, and he argued with Sirius all the time.
en: In fact, he never stayed to talk, or did orders he didn't have to, and he argued with Sirius all the time.
ja: 実際、あいつは話すために残ったりしなかったし、頼まれてもいない命令をこなしたり、いつもシリウスと言い争ったりしてた。

key: But even then... you wouldn't do something like that, right?
en: But even then... you wouldn't do something like that, right?
ja: でも、それでも……キミがそんなことするはずないよね?

key: TAKA: You know, I think there's someone in Team Meteor who really had it out for you-- more than normal, that is.
en: TAKA: You know, I think there's someone in Team Meteor who really had it out for you-- more than normal, that is.
ja: タカ: あのさ、チームメテオの中に、キミのことを本気で恨んでる人がいたと思うんだ――普通よりずっとね。

key: Elias brought in this new recruit, and for a while he was always saying how he was going to get back at you for something...
en: Elias brought in this new recruit, and for a while he was always saying how he was going to get back at you for something...
ja: イライアスが連れてきた新入りがいて、しばらくの間、キミに何かの仕返しをするってずっと言ってたんだ……

key: Then suddenly he changed.
en: Then suddenly he changed.
ja: それが突然、変わったんだよ。

key: Maybe he just got over it?
en: Maybe he just got over it?
ja: もう気持ちの整理がついたのかな?

key: TAKA: I'm not sure if I'd even still be out here now if it weren't for you and that red-haired menace back at the Water Treatment Center.
en: TAKA: I'm not sure if I'd even still be out here now if it weren't for you and that red-haired menace back at the Water Treatment Center.
ja: タカ: キミと、あの水質浄化センターにいた赤髪の厄介者がいなかったら、僕、今ここにいられてすらないと思う。

key: Thanks for dealing with me all this time.
en: Thanks for dealing with me all this time.
ja: 今までずっと、僕に付き合ってくれてありがとう。

key: TAKA: So what's up with that Fern guy?
en: TAKA: So what's up with that Fern guy?
ja: タカ: それで、あのファーンって奴、どうなってるの?

key: He joined recently, but everyone just complains about him.
en: He joined recently, but everyone just complains about him.
ja: 最近入ったばかりなのに、みんな彼の文句ばっかり言ってるんだ。

key: Weren't you two friends?
en: Weren't you two friends?
ja: キミたち、友達だったんじゃないの?

key: TAKA: I'm not the first one you've helped turn tail from Meteor, huh?
en: TAKA: I'm not the first one you've helped turn tail from Meteor, huh?
ja: タカ: 僕は、キミがメテオから逃がした最初の一人ってわけじゃないんだね。

key: I heard that Cal went off with you, too.
en: I heard that Cal went off with you, too.
ja: キャルもキミと一緒に行ったって聞いたよ。

key: You really have a way of pulling people apart, don't you?
en: You really have a way of pulling people apart, don't you?
ja: キミって、本当に人を引き離すのがうまいんだね。

key: TAKA: So like... what's your secret?
en: TAKA: So like... what's your secret?
ja: タカ: それで……キミの秘けつって何?

key: Is it why you hardly say anything?
en: Is it why you hardly say anything?
ja: それが、ほとんど何も話さない理由?

key: TAKA: Being out here is a lot more interesting than staying cooped up in Meteor's drama, that's for sure.
en: TAKA: Being out here is a lot more interesting than staying cooped up in Meteor's drama, that's for sure.
ja: タカ: ここにいる方が、メテオのドロドロしたもめ事に閉じこもってるより、絶対に面白いよ。

key: Most of the people around there are the opposite of fun.
en: Most of the people around there are the opposite of fun.
ja: あそこにいる人たちのほとんどは、楽しさとは正反対だし。

key: Well, I guess Blake was pretty funny.
en: Well, I guess Blake was pretty funny.
ja: まあ、ブレイクはけっこう面白かったかな。

key: He's been with us for a while, and used to look after me when I was younger sometimes.
en: He's been with us for a while, and used to look after me when I was younger sometimes.
ja: 彼はずっと僕らと一緒にいて、僕が小さいころ、たまに面倒を見てくれてたんだ。

key: He'd die before he'd admit it, but I think he actually likes kids.
en: He'd die before he'd admit it, but I think he actually likes kids.
ja: 死んでも認めないだろうけど、あの人、実は子どもが好きなんだと思う。

key: TAKA: You've pretty much ransacked all of our bases by now, huh...
en: TAKA: You've pretty much ransacked all of our bases by now, huh...
ja: タカ: キミ、もうほとんど僕らの拠点を全部荒らし回ったよね……

key: Lin's been moving everything into Labradorra.
en: Lin's been moving everything into Labradorra.
ja: リンは、あらゆるものをラブラドラに移してる。

key: Before that, we mostly stuck around the Devon Building, the Workstation, and the Sanctum.
en: Before that, we mostly stuck around the Devon Building, the Workstation, and the Sanctum.
ja: それまでは、僕らは主にデボンビルディングと、ワークステーションと、聖域の周りにいたんだ。

key: Most of my childhood memories are around those places.
en: Most of my childhood memories are around those places.
ja: 僕の子ども時代の記憶のほとんどは、あの辺りにあるよ。

key: TAKA: Listen, \PN... We have one more base up in the Carnelia Region-- besides Labradorra City, that is.
en: TAKA: Listen, \PN... We have one more base up in the Carnelia Region-- besides Labradorra City, that is.
ja: タカ: ねえ\PN……もう一つ、カルネリア地方に拠点があるんだ――ラブラドラシティ以外にね。

key: I feel like, even if I tell you not to go there, you won't listen.
en: I feel like, even if I tell you not to go there, you won't listen.
ja: 行くなって言っても、キミは聞かない気がするけど。

key: But, seriously... don't go.
en: But, seriously... don't go.
ja: でも、本当に……行かないで。

key: They'll probably try and lure you there.
en: They'll probably try and lure you there.
ja: きっと連中は、そこにキミをおびき寄せようとするから。

key: It would be really bad if you went... and I don't mean for Team Meteor.
en: It would be really bad if you went... and I don't mean for Team Meteor.
ja: もしキミが行ったら、本当にまずいことになる……それはチームメテオのためを言ってるんじゃないよ。

key: TAKA: I really hope Ace is okay...
en: TAKA: I really hope Ace is okay...
ja: タカ: エースが無事だといいんだけど……

key: It's not unlike them to disappear for a while, but never for this long...
en: It's not unlike them to disappear for a while, but never for this long...
ja: しばらく姿を消すのはあいつらしくないことじゃないけど、こんなに長くはさすがに……

key: They really livened the place up, and got along with almost everyone.
en: They really livened the place up, and got along with almost everyone.
ja: あの子がいると、場が本当に明るくなって、ほとんど誰とでも仲良くなれるんだ。

key: ...Everyone except Terra and Lin, basically.
en: ...Everyone except Terra and Lin, basically.
ja: ……テラとリンを除いては、まあほとんどね。

en: GLACEON: Glayy~!
ja: グレイシア: グレイ~!

en: Glaceon used Heal Bell!
ja: グレイシアのいやしのすずが発動!

ja: 味方全員の状態異常が治った!

ja: グレイシアに「いやしのすず」を使わせる?
